'saṃtāpamapariprāptaiḥ kṛtamīśvaramārgaṇaiḥ | manujairyatkarotīva tripurasya jigīṣutām || 36 || sudhārasasamāsaṃgapāṇḍurāgārapaṅktibhiḥ | ṭaṅkakalpitaśītāṃśuśīlābhiriva kalpitam ||37|| madirāttava nitābhūṣaṇasvanasaṃbhṛtam | kuberanagarasyeva dvitīyaṃ saṃniveśanam ||38|| tapovanaṃ muniśreṣṭheśyābhiḥ kāmamandiram | lāsakairnṛ ttabhavanaṃ śatrubhiryamapattanam ||39|| śastribhirvīranilayo'bhilāṣamaṇirarthimiḥ | vidyārthibhirguroḥ sadma vandibhidhūrtapattanam || 40 || gandharvanagaraṃ gītaśāstrakauśala kovidaiḥ | vijñānagrahaṇodyuktairmandiraṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ || 41 || sādhūnāṃ saṃgamaḥ sadbhirbhūbhirlābhasya vāṇijaiḥ | pañjaraṃ śaraṇaprāptairvajradāruvinirmitam ||42|| vārtikerasuracchidraṃ vidagdhairviṭamaṇḍalī | pariṇāmo manojñasya karmaṇo mārgavartibhiḥ || 43 || cauraṇairutsavāvāsaḥ kāmukairapsaraḥ puram | siddhalokaśca viditaṃ yatsadā sukhibhirjanaiḥ || 44 || yatra mātaṅgagāminyaḥ śīlavatyaśca yoṣitaḥ | śyāmāśca padmarāgiṇyo gauryaśca vibhavāśrayāḥ || 45 || candrakāntaśarīrāśca śirīṣa sukumārikāḥ | bhujaṅgānāmagamyāśca kañcukānṛtavigrahāḥ || 46 ||

vidyānāṃ yaḥ samastānāṃ parameśvaratāṃ gataḥ | viśuddhasphaṭikacchāyaṃ chāyāmapi na yadvapuḥ ||12|| pakṣmaspandavinirmukte praśānte yasya locane | samā nakhā mahānīlasnigdhacchāyāśca mūrddhajā ||13|| maitrī samastaviṣayā vihārānugavāyutā | vihṛtiśca prabhoryasya bhuvanānandakāraṇam || 94 || sarvartuphalapuṣpāṇi dhārayanti mahīruhāḥ | yasminnāsannamāyāte dharaṇī darpaṇāyate ||15|| sugandhimaruto yasya yojanāntarabhūtalam | kurvate pāṃsupāṣāṇakaṇṭakādibhirujjhitam ||96|| vidyunmālākṛtābhikhyaistadeva stanitāmaraiḥ | sugandhisalilaiḥ siktaṃ sotsāhairyasya sādaraiḥ ||97|| aprameyamṛdutvāni yasya padmāni gacchataḥ | dharaṇyāmupajāyante yasya vyomavihāriṇaḥ || 98 || atyantaphalasaṃpattinamraśālyādibhūṣitā | dharaṇī jāyate yasmin samete sasyakāraṇam ||19|| śaratsaraḥsamākāraṃ jāyate vimalaṃ nabhaḥ | dhūmakādivinirmuktā diśastu sukhadarśanāḥ ||100 || sphuritārasahasreṇa prabhāmaṇḍalacāruṇā | yatpuro dharmacakreṇa sthīyate ' jitabhānunā || 105 || avasthānaṃ cakārāsau vipule vipulāhvaye | nānānirjharanisyandamadhurārāvahāriṇi || 102 || puṣpopaśobhitoddeśe latāliṅgitapādape | adhityakāsu visrabdhanirvairanyālasevite || 103 || namatīva sadāyānaṃ ghūrṇitodārapādapaiḥ | hasatīva samutsarpanirjharāmalaśīkaraiḥ || 104||
nahīṃ thā || 91 || jo samasta vidyāoṃkī parameśvaratāko prāpta the, sphaṭikake samāna nirmala kāntivālā jinakā śarīra chāyāko prāpta nahīṃ hotā thā arthāt jinake śarīrakī parachāī nahīṃ paḍa़tī thī || 12 || jinake netra ṭimakārase rahita atyanta śānta the, jinake nakha aura mahānīla maṇike samāna snigdha kāntiko dhāraṇa karanevāle bāla sadā samāna the arthāt vṛddhise rahita the ||93|| samasta jīvoṃmeṃ maitrībhāva rahatā thā, vihārake anukūla manda manda vāyu calatī thī, jinakā vihāra samasta saṃsārake ānandakā kāraṇa thā || 94 || vṛkṣa saba ṛtuoṃke phala-phūla dhāraṇa karate the aura jinake pāsa āte hī pṛthivī darpaṇa ke samāna ācaraṇa karane lagatī thī || 15 || jinake eka yojanake antarālameṃ vartamāna bhūmiko sugandhita pavana sadā dhūli, pāṣāṇa aura kaṇṭaka ādise rahita karatī rahatī thī ||16|| bijalī kī mālāse jinakī śobhā baḍha़ rahī hai aise stanitakumāramegha kumāra jātike deva baḍa़e utsāha aura ādara ke sātha usa yojanāntarālavartī bhūmiko sugandhita jalase sīṃcate rahate the ||97|| jo ākāśameṃ vihāra karate the aura vihāra karate samaya jinake caraṇoṃke tale deva loga atyanta komala kamaloṃkī racanā karate the || 18 || jinake samīpa ānepara pṛthivī bahuta bhārī phaloṃke bhārase namrībhūta dhāna ādike paudhoṃse vibhūṣita ho uṭhatī thī tathā saba prakārakā anna usameṃ utpanna ho jātā thā || 19|| ākāśa śarad ṛtuke tālābake samāna nirmala ho jātā thā aura diśāe~ dhūmaka ādi doṣoṃse rahita hokara baḍa़ī sundara mālūma hone lagatī thīṃ ||100|| jisameṃ hajāra āre dedīpyamāna haiṃ, jo kāntike samūhase jagamagā rahā hai aura jisane sūryako jīta liyā hai aisā dharmacakra jinake āge sthita rahatā thā || 101 ||

dvitīyaṃ pavaṃ
kūjitaiḥ pakṣisaṃghānāṃ jalpatīva manoharam | bhramarāṇāṃ ninādena gāyatīva madaśritām ||105 || āliṅgatīva sarvāśāḥ 'samīreṇa sugandhinā | nānādhātuprabhājālamaṇḍitottuṅgaśṛṅgake ||106|| guhāmukhasukhāsīna dṛṣṭānanasṛgādhipe | dhanapādapakhaṇḍādhaḥ sthitayūthapatidvipe || 107|| mahimnā sarvamākāśaṃ saṃchādyeva vyavasthite | parvate'ṣṭāpade ramye bhagavāniva nābhijaḥ ||108 || tatrāsya jagatī jātā yojanaṃ parimāṇataḥ | nāmnā samavapūrveṇa saraṇena prakīrtitā || 109|| āsanābhimukhe tatra jine jitabhavadviṣi | cukṣobha tridaśendrasya mṛgendrarūḍhamāsanam ||11|| prabhāvāt kasya me kampaṃ siṃhāsanamidaṃ gatam | ityālokya vibuddho'sau jñānenāvadhinā tataḥ || 111|| ājñāpayardenudhyātakṣaṇāyātaṃ kṛtāñjalim | senāpatiṃ yathā devāḥ kriyantāmiti vedinaḥ || 112 || jinendroṃ bhagavān vīraḥ sthito vipulabhūdhare | tadvandanāya yuṣmābhiḥ sametairgamyatāmiti ||113|| tataḥ śāradajīmṛtamahānicayasaṃnibham | jambūnadataṭāghātapiṅga koṭimahāradam || 114|| suvarṇakakṣā yuktaṃ kailāsamiva jaṅgamam | sairitā rajasābjānāṃ piñjarīkṛtatoyayā || 115 || madāndhamadhupaśreṇīśritagaṇḍavirājitam | dhūlīkadambasaṃvādi saurabhavyāptaviṣṭapam || 116|| karṇatālasamāsaktasamīpālakṣyaśaṅkhakam | vamantamiva padmānāṃ vanānyaruṇatālunā || 117 ||
nirmala chīṃṭoṃse jo aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno ha~sa hī rahā ho, pakṣiyoṃke kalaravase aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno madhura bhāṣaṇa hī kara rahā ho, madonmatta bhramaroṃ kī guṃjārase aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno gā hī rahā ho, sugandhita pavanase jo aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno āliṃgana hī kara rahā ho| jisake ū~ce-ū~ce śikhara nānā dhātuoṃkī kāntike samūhase suśobhita the, jisakī guphāoṃke agrabhāgameṃ sukhase baiṭhe hue siṃhoṃ ke mukha dikha rahe the, jisakī saghana vṛkṣāvalī ke nīce gajarāja baiṭhe the aura jo apanī mahimāse samasta ākāśako ācchādita kara sthita thā| jisa prakāra atyanta ramaṇīya kailāsa parvatapara bhagavān vṛṣabhadeva virājamāna hue the usī prakāra ukta vipulācalapara bhagavān vardhamāna jinendra virājamāna hue ||102 - 108 || usa vipulācalapara eka yojana vistāravālī bhūmi samavasaraṇake nāmase prasiddha thī || 109 || saṃsārarūpī śatruko jītanevāle vardhamāna jinendra jaba usa samavasaraṇa bhūmimeṃ siṃhāsanārūḍha़ hue taba indrakā āsana kampāyamāna huā ||110|| indrane usī samaya vicāra kiyā ki merā yaha siṃhāsana kisake prabhāvase kampāyamāna huā hai | vicāra karate hī use avadhijñānase saba samācāra vidita ho gayā || 11 || indra ne senāpatikā smaraṇa kiyā aura senāpati tatkāla hī hātha joḍa़kara khaḍa़ā ho gayā | indrane use ādeśa diyā ki saba devoṃko yaha samācāra mālūma karāo ki bhagavān vardhamāna jinendra vipulācalapara virājamāna haiṃ isalie āpa saba loga ekatrita hokara unakī vandanā ke lie calie ||112-113|| tadanantara indra svayaṃ usa airāvata hāthīpara ārūḍha़ hokara calā jo ki śarada ṛtuke meghoṃke kisī baḍa़e samūha ke samāna jāna paḍa़tā thā, suvarṇamaya taṭoṃke āghātase jisakī khīsoṃkā agrabhāga pīlā-pīlā ho rahā thā, jo suvarṇakī mālāoṃse yukta thā aura usase aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno kamaloṃ kī parāgase jisakā jala pīlā ho rahā hai aisī nadīse parivṛta kailāsa giri hī ho | jo madāndha bhramaroṃ kī paṃktise yukta gaṇḍasthaloṃse suśobhita thā, kadambake phūloṃ kī parāgase milatī-julatī sugandhise jisane samasta saṃsārako vyāpta kara liyā thā, jisake kānoṃke samīpa śaṃkha nāmaka ābharaṇa dikhāī de rahe the, jo apane lāla tāluse kamaloṃke vanako ugalatā huā-sā jāna paḍa़tā thā, jo darpake kāraṇa aisā

padmapurāṇe dalantamiva darpaṇa śvasantamiva śauryataḥ | madānmūrchāmivāyāntaṃ guhyantamiva yauvanāt ||118|| snigdhaṃ nakhapradeśeṣu paruṣaṃ romagocare | sacchiṣyaṃ vinayāvāptau paramaṃ gurumānane ||119|| mṛdumūrdhānamatyantadṛḍhaṃ paricayagrahe | dīrghamāyuṣi hasvatvaṃ dadhataṃ skandhabandhane ||120|| daridramudare nityaṃ pravṛttaṃ dānavamani | nāradaṃ kalahaprītī garuḍaṃ nāganāśane ||121|| pradoṣamiva rājantaṃ cārunakṣatramālayā| mahāghaṇṭākṛtārāvaṃ raktacāmaramaṇḍitam ||122|| sindūrāruṇitottuṅgakumbhakūṭamanoharam | airāvataṃ samāruhya prāvartata surādhipaḥ ||123|| prāptaśca sahito devairārūḍhanijavāhanaiḥ | jinendrādarśanotsāhotphullānanasaroruhaiḥ ||124|| kamalāyudhamukhyāśca nabhaścarajanādhipāḥ | saṃprāptāḥ sahapalīkā nānālaṃkāradhāriṇaḥ ||125|| tatastuṣṭāva devendro vacasāścaryamīyuṣā | guṇairavitathairdivyairatyantavimalairiti ||126|| tvayā nātha jagatsutaṃ mahāmohaniśāgatam | jñānabhāskarabimbena bodhitaṃ purutejasā ||127|| namaste vītarāgāya sarvajñāya mahātmane | yātāya durgamaṃ kūlaṃ saṃsārodanvataḥ param ||128|| bhavatā sārthavāhena bhavyacetanavāṇijāḥ | yāsyanti vitanusthānaṃ doṣacārairaluṇṭitāḥ ||129||
pravartitastvayā panthā vimala: siddhagābhinām | karmajālaṃ ca nirdagdhaṃ jvalitadhyānavahninā ||130|| jāna paḍa़tā thā māno sā~sa hī le rahā ho, madase aisā pratīta hotā thā māno mūrchāko hī prāpta ho rahā ho aura yauvanase aisā vidita hotā thā māno mohita hī ho rahā ho| jisake nakhoke pradeśa cikane aura śarīrake roma kaṭhora the, vinayake grahaṇa karanemeṃ jo samīcīna śiṣyake samāna jāna paḍa़tā thā, jo mukhameṃ parama guru thā arthāt jisakā mukha bahuta vistṛta thā, jisakā mastaka komala thā, jo paricayake grahaṇa karane meṃ atyanta dṛḍha़ thā, jo āyumeṃ dīrghatā aura skandhameṃ hrasvatā dhāraṇa karatā thā arthāt jisakī āyu viśāla thī aura garadana choṭī thī, jo udarameṃ daridra thā arthāt jisakā peṭa kaśa thā. jo dānake mārgameṃ sadā pravatta rahatā thā arthāta jisake gaṇḍasthaloṃse sadā mada jharatā rahatā thā, jo kalahasambandhī premake dhāraṇa karanemeṃ nārada thā arthāt nāradake samāna kalahapremī thā, jo nāgoṃkā nāśa karaneke lie garuḍa़ thā, jo sundara nakṣatramālā ( sattāīsa dānoṃvālī mālā pakṣameṃ nakṣatroṃke samūha ) se pradoṣa-rātrike prārambhake samāna jāna paḍa़tā thā, jo baḍa़e-baḍa़e ghaṇṭāoṃkā śabda kara rahā thā, jo lālaraṃgake camaroṃse vibhūṣita thā aura jo sindūrake dvārā lāla-lāla dikhanevāle unnata gaṇḍasthaloṃke agrabhāgase manohara thā ||114-123|| jinendra bhagavānke darśana sambandhī utsāhase jinake mukhakamala vikasita ho rahe the aise samasta deva apane-apane vāhanoṃpara savāra hokara indrake sātha ā mile ||124|| devoṃke sivāya nānā alaṃkāroṃko dhāraṇa karanevāle kamalāyudha ādi vidyādharoṃke rājā bhī apanī-apanī patniyoṃke sātha ākara ekatrita ho gaye ||125||
tadanantara bhagavānke vāstavika, divya tathā atyanta nirmala guṇoṃke dvārā āścaryako prāpta hue vacanoṃse indrane nimna prakāra stuti kī ||126|| he nātha ! mahāmoharūpī niśāke bīca sote hue isa samasta jagatko āpane apane viśāla tejake dhāraka jñānarūpī sūryake bimbase jagāyā hai ||127|| he bhagavan ! āpa vītarāga ho, sarvajña ho, mahātmā ho, aura saṃsārarūpī samudrake durgama antima taṭako prāpta hue ho ataḥ āpako namaskāra ho ||128|| āpa uttama sārthavāha ho, bhavya jīvarūpī vyāpārī āpake sātha nirvāṇa dhāmako prāpta kareṃge aura mārgameṃ doṣarūpī cora unheṃ nahīṃ lūṭa sakeṃge ||129|| āpane mokṣābhilāṣiyoṃko nirmala mokṣakā mārga

dvitīyaṃ parva
nirbandhūnāmanāthānāṃ duḥkhāgniparivartinām | bandhu thaśca jagatāṃ jāto'si paramodayaḥ ||131|| kathaṃ kuryāttava stotraṃ yasyāntaparivarjitāḥ | upamānena nirmuktā guṇāḥ kevaligocarāḥ ||132|| īti stutiṃ prayujyāsau vidhāya ca namaskṛtim | mūrddhajānukarāmbhojamukulaprāptabhūtalaḥ ||133|| vismayaṃ prāptavān dṛṣṭvā sthānaṃ tajinapuṅgavam | iti yasya samāsena kathyate rūpavarṇanam ||134|| indrasya puruṣarasya prakāratritayaṃ kṛtam | nānāvarṇamahāratnasuvarṇamayamuttamam ||135|| pradhānāśāmukhaistuṅgairmahāvāpīsamanvitaiḥ | caturmigopurairyuktaṃ ratnacchāyāpaiṭāvṛtaiḥ ||136|| āvṛtaṃ tena tatsthānamaṣṭamaṅgalakācitam | vacasāṃ gocarātītāmadadhat kāmapi śriyam ||137|| tatra sphaṭikabhittyaṅgā vimāgā dvādaśābhavan | prādakṣiṇyapathatyatapradeśasamavasthitāḥ ||138|| tasthurekatra nirgranthā gaṇanāthairadhiṣṭhitāḥ | anyatra sendra patnīkāḥ kalpavāsisurāṅganāḥ ||139|| aparatrāryikāsaṃgho gaṇapālīsamanvitaḥ | dyotiṣāṃ yoṣito'nyatra vaiyanto'paratra ca ||14|| ekatra bhāvanastrīṇāmanyatra dyotiṣāṃ gaṇaḥ | vyantarāṇāṃ gaṇo'nyatra saṅgho'nyatra ca bhāvanaḥ ||14|| kalpavāsina ekasminnaparatra ca mānuṣāḥ | ' vairānubhāvanirmuktāstiryañco'nyatra susthitāḥ ||142|| tato magadharājo'pi niścakrāma mahābalaḥ | saṃpatatsurasaṃghātajāta vismayamānasaḥ ||143||
dikhāyā hai aura dhyānarūpī dedīpyamāna agnike dvārā karmoṃke samūhako bhasma kiyā hai ||130|| jinakā koī bandha nahīṃ aura jinakā koī nātha nahīṃ aise daḥkharūpī agni meṃ vartamāna saṃsārake jīvoṃke āpa hī bandhu ho, āpa hī nātha ho tathā āpa hī parama abhyudayake dhāraka ho ||131|| he bhagavan ! hama āpake guṇoṃkā stavana kaise kara sakate haiṃ jaba ki ve ananta haiṃ, upamāse rahita haiṃ tathā kevalajñāniyoṃke viṣaya haiṃ ||132|| isa prakāra stuti kara indrane bhagavānko namaskāra kiyā| namaskāra karate samaya usane mastaka, ghuṭane tathā donoṃ hastarūpī kamaloṃke kuḍamaloṃse pṛthivītalakā sparśa kiyā thā ||133|| vaha indra bhagavānkā samavasaraṇa dekhakara āścaryako prāpta huā thā isalie yahā~ saṃkṣepase usakā varṇana kiyā jātā hai||134||
___ indrake ājñākārī puruṣoṃne sarvaprathama samavasaraṇake tīna koṭoṃkī racanā kī thī jo aneka varṇake baḍa़e-baḍa़e ratnoṃ tathā suvarṇase nirmita the ||135|| una koṭoṃko cāroṃ diśāoṃmeṃ cāra gopura dvāra the jo bahuta hī ūṃce the, baḍa़ī-baḍa़ī bāvaḍa़iyoṃse suśobhita the, tathā ratnoṃkī kāntirūpī paradāse āvṛta the ||136||
gopuroṃkā vaha sthāna aṣṭa maṃgaladravyoṃse yukta thā tathā vacanoṃse agocara koī adbhuta śobhā dhāraṇa kara rahā thā ||137|| usa samavasaraṇameṃ sphaṭikakī dīvāloṃse bāraha koṭhe bane hue the jo pradakṣiṇā rūpase sthita the ||138|| una koṭhoṃ se prathama koṭhemeṃ gaṇadharoṃse suśobhita munirāja baiṭhe the, dūsaremeṃ indrāṇiyoṃke sātha-sātha kalpavāsī devoṃkī devāṃganāe~ thīṃ, tīsaremeṃ gaṇiniyoṃse sahita āyikāoṃkā samaha baiṭhā thā, 'cauthemeṃ jyotiṣī devoṃkī devāṃganāe~ thoṃ pā~caveṃ meṃ vyantara devoṃkī aṃganāe~ baiṭhī thīṃ. chaṭhemeṃ bhavanavāsī devoṃkī aṃganāe~ baiṭhī thīṃ. sātavameṃ jyotiṣī deva the, āṭhaveṃmeṃ vyantara deva the, nauveṃmeṃ bhavanavāsī deva the, dasaveṃmeṃ kalpavāso deva the, gyārahaveṃ meṃ manuṣya the aura bārahaveṃ meṃ vairabhāvase rahita tithaṃca sukhase baiṭhe the ||139-142|| tadanantara saba orase ānevāle devoṃke samūhase jisake manameṃ āścarya utpanna ho rahā thā aisā mahābalavān athavā bahuta baḍa़ī senākā nāyaka rājā śreṇika bhī apane nagarase bāhara nikalā 1. kuryāstava ma.| 2. paristuti kha.| 3. tajjaina-ma.| 4. paṭairvṛtaḥ ma.| 5. -kānvitam ma. | 6. anyatrāsan sapatnīkāḥ ka., kha. | 7. jyotiṣāṃ ma.| 8. jyotiṣāṃ ma.| 9. gaṇo ma.| 10. vairānubhava ma. |

pākyāpākyatayā māṣasasyavatpravibhāgataḥ | setsyanto gaditā bhavyā abhavyāstu tato'nyathā ||156|| bhavya bhavyadvayenātra jīvārthāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | dharmādharmādibhirbhedairdvitīyo bhidyate punaḥ || 157 || jinadeśitatattvānāṃ śraddhā śraddhānametayoḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ tatprabhedaḥśca punarekendriyādayaḥ || 158 || gatyā kāyaistathā yogairvedairleśyā kaṣāyataḥ | jñānadarśanacāritrairguṇaśreṇyadhirohaṇaiḥ ||159|| nisargaśāstrasamyaktvairnāmādinyāsabhedataḥ | sadādyaṣṭānuyogaiśca bhidyate cetanaḥ punaḥ || 160|| tatra saṃsārijīvānoṃ kevalaṃ duḥkhavedinām | sukhaṃ saṃjñāvamūḍhānāṃ tatraiva viṣayodbhave ||161|| cakṣuṣaḥ puṭasaṃkoco yāvanmātreṇa jāyate | tāvantamapi no kālaṃ nārakāṇāṃ sukhāsanam || 162 || damanaistāḍanairdovāhādibhirupadravaiḥ | tiraśrāṃ satataṃ duḥkhaṃ tathā śītātapādibhiḥ || 163 || priyāṇāṃ viprayogena tathāniṣṭasamāgamāt | īpsitānāmalābhācca duḥkhaṃ mānuṣagocaram ||164|| yathotkṛṣṭasurāṇāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā bhogaṃ mahāguṇam | cyavanācca paraṃ duḥkhaṃ devānāmupajāyate || 165 || gheṃnaduḥkhāvabaddheṣu caturgatigatedhviti | karmabhūmiṃ samāsādya dharmo pārjanamuttamam || 166|| manuṣya bhāvamāsādya sukṛtaṃ ye na kurvate | teṣāṃ karatalaprāptamamṛtaṃ nāśamāgatam || 167 || saṃsāre paryaṭanneṣa bahuyonisamākule | manuṣyabhāvamāyāti cireṇātyantaduḥkhataḥ || 168 ||
bhī
kucha jīva to aise hote haiṃ jo karma naṣṭa kara siddha avasthāko prāpta ho sakate haiṃ aura kucha aise hote haiṃ jo prayatna karanepara bhī siddha avasthāko prāpta nahīṃ ho sakate| jo siddha ho sakate haiṃ ve bhavya kahalāte haiṃ aura jo siddha nahīṃ ho sakate haiṃ ve abhavya kahalāte haiṃ | isa taraha bhavya aura abhavyakī apekṣā jīva do taraha ke haiṃ aura ajīva tattvake dharmaṃ, adharmaṃ, ākāśa, kāla tathā pudgala ke bhedase pā~ca bheda haiṃ || 156 - 157 || jinendra bhagavān ke dvārā kahe hue tattvoṃkā śraddhāna honā bhavyoṃ kā lakṣaṇa hai aura unakā śraddhāna nahīṃ honā abhavyoṃkā lakṣaṇa hai | ekendriya, dvīndriya, śrīndriya, caturindriya aura paṃcendriya ye bhavya tathā abhavya jīvoṃke uttara bheda haiṃ || 158 || gati, kāya, yoga, veda, leśyā, kaṣāya, jñāna, darśana, cāritra, guṇasthāna, nisargaja evaṃ adhigamaja samyagdarśana, nāmādi nikṣepa aura sat, saṃkhyā, kṣetra, sparśana, kāla, antara, bhāva tathā alpa bahutva ina āṭha anuyogoṃke dvārā jīva-tattva ke aneka bheda hote haiṃ || 159-160 || siddha aura saṃsārī ina do prakārake jīvoṃ meṃ saṃsārī jīva kevala duḥkhakā hī anubhava karate rahate haiṃ| paṃcendriyoṃke viṣayoṃse jo sukha hotā hai unheṃ saṃsārī jīva bhramavaśa sukha māna lete haiṃ ||169 || jitanī dera meṃ netrakā palaka jhapatā hai utanī derake lie bhī nārakiyoṃko sukha nahīṃ hotā || 162 ( damana, tāḍana, dohana, vāhana ādi upadravoṃse tathā śīta, ghāma, varṣā ādike kāraṇa tiryaṃcoṃko nirantara duḥkha hotā rahatā hai || 163 || priyajanoṃke viyogase, aniṣṭa vastuoṃ ke samāgamase tathā icchita padārthoke na milanese manuṣya gatimeṃ bhārī duḥkha hai || 164 || apanese utkṛṣṭa devoṃke 'bahuta bhārī bhogoṃ ko dekhakara tathā vahā~se cyuta honeke kāraṇa devoṃko duḥkha utpanna hotā hai || 165 || isa prakāra jaba cāroṃ gatiyoṃke jīva bahuta adhika duḥkhase pīḍa़ita haiṃ taba karmabhūmi pākara dharmakā upārjana karanā uttama hai || 166 || jo manuṣya bhava pākara bhī dharma nahīṃ karate haiṃ māno unakī hathelī para āyā amṛta naṣṭa ho jātā hai || 167|| aneka yoniyoṃse bhare isa saṃsāra meṃ paribhramaṇa

padmapurāṇe tatra 'lubdheṣu pāpeṣu śabarādiṣu jāyate | āryadeśe'pi saṃprāpte duḥkuleṣūpajāyate ||16|| labdhe'pi sukule kāṇakuṇṭhāditanusaṃbhavaḥ | saṃpūrṇakāyabandhe'pi durlabhā hīnarogatā ||17|| evaṃ sarvamapi prāpya praśastānāṃ samāgamam | durlabho dharmasaṃvego viṣayāsvādalobhataḥ ||17|| tataḥ kecida bhṛtiṃ kṛtvā jaṭharasyāpi paraṇam | kurvate'tyantaduḥkhena dūrato vibhavodbhavaḥ ||172|| raktakardamabībhatsaśastrasaṃpātamīṣaṇam | kecida viśanti saṃgrāma jihākāmavaśīkṛtāḥ ||173|| samastajantusaṃbādhaṃ kṛtvā'nye bhūmikarṣaṇam | kuṭumbabharaṇakleśāt kurvate nṛpapīḍitāḥ ||17|| evaṃ yadyaprakurvanti karma saukhyābhilāṣiṇaḥ | tatra tatra prapadyante jantavo duḥkhamuttamam ||175|| avāpyāpi dhanaṃ keśācorāgnijalarājataḥ | pālayan paramaṃ duḥkhamavāpnotyākulaḥ sadā ||176|| saṃprāptaṃ racitaṃ dravyaṃ bhuñānasyāpi no śamaḥ | prativāsarasaṃvṛddhagāgniparivartanāt ||177|| prāpnoti dharmasaṃvegaṃ kathaṃcit pūrvakarmataḥ | saṃsārapadavīmeva nīyate'nyadurātmabhiḥ ||17|| anyaiste nāśitāḥ santo nāśayantyaparān janān | dharmasāmānyaśabdena sevamānāḥ paramparām ||179||
kathaṃ cetoviśuddhiḥ syāt parigrahavatāṃ satām | cetoviśuddhimūlā ca teṣāṃ dharme sthitiḥ kutaḥ ||180|| karatā huā yaha jīva bahuta samayake bāda baḍa़e duḥkhase manuṣya bhavako prāpta hotā hai ||168|| usa manuṣya bhavameṃ yaha jīva adhikāṃśa lobhī tathā pāpa karanevāle śabara ādi nīca puruṣoṃmeṃ hī janma letā hai| yadi kadācit āyaṃ deśa prāpta hotā hai to vahā~ bhī nīca kulameṃ hī utpanna hotā hai ||169|| yadi bhāgyavaśa ucca kula bhī milatā hai to kānā-lūlā ādi śarīra prāpta hotā hai | yadi kadācit śarīrako pūrṇatā hotī hai to nīrogatākā honā atyanta durlabha rahatā hai ||170|| isa taraha yadi kadācit samasta uttama vastuoṃkā samāgama bhī ho jātā hai to viṣayoṃke āsvādakā lobha rahanese dharmānurāga durlabha hī rahā ātā hai ||171|| isa saṃsārameṃ kitane hī loga aise haiṃ jo dūsaroṃkī naukarī kara bahuta bhārī kaṣṭase peṭa bhara pāte haiṃ unheṃ vaibhavakī prāpti honā to dūra rahā ||172|| kitane hī loga jihvā aura kāma indriyake vaśībhūta hokara aise saṃgrāmameṃ praveśa karate haiṃ jo ki raktakī kocaḍase ghaṇita tathā śastroṃkī varṣāse bhayaṃkara hotā hai ||173|| kitane hī loga aneka jīvoṃko bādhā pahu~cānevālī bhūmi jotanekī ājīvikā kara baḍa़e kleśase apane kuṭumbakā pālana karate haiṃ aura utanepara bhī rājāoṃkī orase nirantara pīḍa़ita rahate haiṃ||174|| isa taraha sukhakī icchā rakhanevāle jīva jo kārya karate haiṃ ve usī meṃ bahuta bhārī duḥkhako prāpta karate haiṃ ||175||
yadi kisī taraha kaṣṭase dhana mila bhī jātā hai to cora, agni, jala aura rājāse usakī rakṣā karatā huā yaha prāṇī bahuta duḥkha pātā hai aura usase sadā vyākula rahatā hai ||176|| yadi prāpta huā dhana surakṣita bhī rahatā hai to use bhogate hue isa prāṇīko kabhī śānti nahīṃ hotī kyoṃki usakī lālasārūpī agni prati dina baḍha़tī rahatī hai ||177|| yadi kisī taraha pūrvopārjita puṇya karmake udayase dharma bhāvanāko prāpta hotā bhī hai to anya duṣṭajanoṃke dvārā punaḥ usī saṃsārake mārgameṃ lā diyā jātā hai ||178|| anya puruṣoṃke dvārā naṣṭa hue satpuruṣa anya logoṃko bhī naṣṭa kara dete haiṃ-pathabhraṣṭa kara dete haiṃ aura dharmasāmānyakī apekṣā kevala rūḍha़ikā hī pālana karate haiṃ ||179|| parigrahī manuṣyoṃke cittameṃ viśuddhatā kaise ho sakatī hai aura jisameṃ cittakī viśuddhatā hī mūla kāraṇa hai aisī dharmakī sthiti una parigrahī manuṣyoṃ meṃ 1. labdheṣu ma.| 2. hi nirogatā kha., ma. | 3. durlabhaṃ ka. | 4. ananta ma.| 5. kurvanti ma. | 6. garbhāgni ma.| 7. paraṃparam ka | parasparam ma. | 8. mūlācca ma. |

dvitīyaṃ parva yāvatparigrahāsaktistāvatprāṇinipīḍanam | hiṃsātaḥ saṃsṛtermūlaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃsārasaṃjñakam ||18|| parigrahapariṣvaṅgād dveṣo rāgaśca jāyate | rāgadveṣau ca saṃsāre duḥkhasyottamakāraṇam ||182|| labdhvāpi darśanaṃ samyak praśamādarśanāvṛteḥ | cāritraṃ na prapadyante cāritrāvaraṇāvṛtāḥ ||183|| cāritramapi saṃprāptāḥ kurvantaḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ | parīṣahaiḥ punarbhaṅga nīyante "duḥkhavikramaiḥ ||18|| aṇuvratāni sevante kecid bhaṅgamupāgatāḥ | kecidarśanamātreṇa bhavanti paritoṣiṇaḥ ||185|| kecid gambhīrasaṃsārakūpahastāvalambanam | samyagdarśanamutsṛjya mithyādṛṣṭimupāsate ||18|| mithyādarśanasaṃyuktāste punarmavasaṃkaṭe | bhrāmyanti satataṃ jīvā duḥkhāgniparivartinaḥ ||187|| kecittu puṇyakarmāṇaścāritramavalambitam | nirvahanti mahāśūrā yāvayāṇavivarjanam ||18|| te samādhi samāsādya kṛtvā dehavisarjanam | vāsudevāditāṃ yānti nidānakṛtadoṣataḥ ||189|| te punaḥ parapīḍāyāṃ ratā nirdayacetasaḥ | narakeṣu mahāduḥkhaṃ prāpnuvanti sudustaram ||190|| kecittu sutapaḥ kṛtvā yānti gīrvāṇanāthatām | apare baladevatvamanye'nuttaravāsitām ||191|| kecitprāpya mahāsattvā jinakarmāṇi ṣoḍaśa | tīrthakṛttvaṃ prapadyante trailokyakṣobhakāraṇam ||192|| kecinirantarāyeṇa tritayārādhane ratāḥ | dvitrairbhavairvimucyante karmāṣṭakakalaṅkataḥ ||193|| saṃprāptāḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ muktānāmupamojjhitam | anantaṃ niḥpratidvandvaṃ labhante sukhamuttamam ||19||
kahā~se ho sakatī hai ||180|| jaba taka parigrahameṃ āsakti hai taba taka prāṇiyoṃkī hiṃsā honā niścita hai| hiṃsā hī saṃsārakā mūla kāraṇa hai aura duḥkhako hī saṃsāra kahate haiṃ ||181|| parigrahake sambandhase rāga aura dveṣa utpanna hote haiṃ tathā rāga aura dveṣa hī saṃsāra sambandhī duḥkhake prabala kāraṇa haiṃ ||182|| darśanamoha karmakā upaśama honese kitane hī prāṇī yadyapi samyagdarśana prāpta kara lete haiṃ tathāpi cāritra mohake āvaraṇase āvṛta rahaneke kāraṇa ve samyak cāritrako prāpta nahīṃ kara sakate ||183|| kitane hī loga samyak cāritrako pākara śreṣṭha tapa bhī karate haiṃ parantu duḥkhadāyī pariṣahoṃke nimittase bhraṣṭa ho jāte haiṃ ||184|| pariṣahoṃke nimittase bhraṣṭa hue kitane hī loga aṇuvratoṃkā sevana karate haiṃ aura kitane hī kevala samyagdarśanase santuṣṭa raha jāte haiṃ arthāt kisī prakārakā vrata nahīṃ pālate haiṃ ||185|| kitane hī loga saṃsārarūpī gahare kueṃse hastāvalambana dekara, nikālanevāle samyagdarśanako choḍa़kara phirase mithyādarśanakī sevā karane lagate haiṃ ||186|| tathā aise mithyādṛṣṭi jīva nirantara duḥkharūpī agnike bīca rahate hue saṃkaṭapūrṇa saṃsārameṃ bhramaṇa karate rahate haiṃ ||187|| kitane hī aise mahāśūravīra puṇyātmā jīva haiṃ jo grahaṇa kiye hue cāritrako jīvana paryanta dhāraṇa karate haiṃ ||188| aura samādhipūrvaka śarīra tyāga kara nidānake doṣase nārāyaṇa ādi padako prāpta hote haiṃ ||189|| jo nārāyaṇa hote haiṃ ve dūsaroṃko pīḍa़ā pahu~cānemeṃ tatpara rahate haiṃ tathā unakā citta nirdaya rahatā hai isalie ve marakara niyamase narakoṃmeṃ bhārī duḥkha bhogate haiṃ ||190|| kitane hī loga sutapa karake indra padako prāpta hote haiṃ| kitane hī baladeva padavī pāte haiṃ aura kitane hī anuttara vimānoṃmeṃ nivāsa prāpta karate haiṃ ||191|| kitane hī mahādhairyavān manuṣya ṣoḍaśa kāraṇa bhāvanāoṃkā cintavana kara tīnoṃ lokoṃmeṃ kṣobha utpanna karanevāle tīrthaṃkara pada prāpta karate haiṃ ||192|| aura kitane hī loga nirantarāya rūpase samyagdarśana, samyagjñāna tathā samyak cāritrakī ārādhanāmeṃ tatpara rahate hue do-tīna bhavameṃ hī aṣṭa karmarūpa kalaṃkase mukta ho jāte haiṃ ||193|| ve phira mukta jīvoṃke utkṛṣṭa evaṃ nirupama sthānako pākara ananta kāla taka nirbādha uttama sukhakā timirmānuṣairdevaiḥ kṛtvā tṛptiṃ tataḥ punaḥ | svapityeva vimuktānyaniḥśeṣapuruṣa sthitiḥ || 236|| aho kukavibhirmūkhairvidyādharakumārakaḥ | abhyākhyānamidaṃ nīto duḥkṛtagranthakatthakaiḥ || 237|| evaṃvidhaṃ kila granthaṃ rāmāyaṇamudāhṛtam | śṛṇvatāṃ sakalaṃ pāpaṃ kṣayamāyāti tatkṣaṇāt || 238 || tāpatyajanacittasya so'yamagnisamāgamaḥ | śītāpanodakāmasya tuṣārānilasaṃgamaḥ ||239|| haiyaṅgavīna kāṅakṣasya tadidaṃ jalamanthanam | sikatāpīḍainaṃ tailamavāptumabhivāñchataḥ || 240|| mahāpuruṣacāritrakūṭadoṣavibhāviṣu | pāpairadharmaśāstreṣu dharmaśāstramatiḥ kṛtā || 241|| amarāṇāṃ kilādhīśo rāvaṇena parājitaḥ | ākarṇākṛṣṭanirmukairbāṇairmarmavidāribhiḥ || 242 || devānāmadhipaḥ kvāsau varākaḥ kvaiṣa mānuṣaḥ | tasya cintitamātreṇa yāyād yo bhasmarāśitām ||243|| airāvato gajo yasya yasya vajraṃ mahāyudham | sameruvāridhiṃ kṣoṇīṃ yo'nāyāsāt samuddharet || 244|| so'yaṃ mānuṣamātreṇa vidyābhājā'lpaśaktinā | ānīyate kathaṃ bhaṅgaṃ prabhuḥ svarganivāsinām || 245|| bandīgṛha gṛhīto'sau prabhuṇā rakṣasāṃ kila | laṅkāyāṃ nivasan kārāgṛhe nityaṃ susaṃyataḥ || 246 || mṛgaiḥ siṃhavadhaḥ so'yaṃ śilānāṃ peṣaṇaṃ tilaiḥ | vadho gaṇḍūpadenā hergajendra śasanaṃ śunā ||247 ||
I
dhāraṇa karanevālā vaha kumbhakarṇaṃ jaba jāgatā thā taba bhūkha aura pyāsase itanā vyākula ho uṭhatā thā ki sāmane hāthī ādi jo bhī dikhate the unheṃ khā jātā thā | isa prakāra vaha bahuta hī durdhara thā || 235|| tiryaṃca, manuṣya aura devoṃke dvārā vaha tṛpti kara punaḥ so jātā thā usa samaya usake pāsa anya koī bhī puruṣa nahīṃ ṭhahara sakatā thā || 236 || aho ! kitane āścarya kī bāta hai ki pāpavardhaka khoṭe granthoṃ kī racanā karanevāle mūrkha kukaviyoṃne usa vidyādhara kumārakā kaisā bībhatsa carita citraṇa kiyā hai || 237 || jisameṃ yaha saba caritra-citraṇa kiyā gayā hai vaha grantha rāmāyaṇake nāmase prasiddha hai aura jisake viṣayameṃ yaha prasiddhi hai ki vaha sunanevāle manuṣyoṃ ke samasta pāpa tatkṣaṇa meṃ naṣṭa kara detā hai || 238 || so jisakā citta tāpakā tyāga karaneke lie utsuka hai usake lie yaha rāmāyaṇa māno agnikā samāgama hai aura jo śīta dūra karanekī icchā karatā hai usake lie māno himamiśrita śītala vāyukā samāgama hai || 239 || ghīkī icchā rakhanevāle manuṣyakā jisa prakāra pānīkā bilovanā vyartha hai aura tela prāpta karanekī icchā rakhanevāle manuṣyakā bālūkā pelanā niḥsāra hai usī prakāra pāpa tyāgakī icchā karanevāle manuṣyakā rāmāyaṇakā āśraya lenā vyartha hai ||240|| jo mahāpuruṣoṃke cāritrameṃ prakaṭa karate haiṃ aise adharma śāstroṃ meṃ bhī pāpī puruṣoṃne dharmaśāstrakī kalpanā kara rakhī hai || 241 || rāmāyaṇa meṃ yaha bhī likhā hai ki rāvaṇane kāna taka khīṃcakara choḍa़e bāṇoṃ devoṃke adhipati indrako bhī parājita kara diyā thā ||242 || aho ! kahā~ to devoṃkā svāmī indra aura kahā~ vaha tuccha manuṣya jo ki indrakī cintāmātra se bhasmakī rāśi ho sakatā hai ? ||243|| jisake airāvata hāthī thā aura vajra jaisā mahān śastra thā tathā jo sumeru parvata aura samudroṃse suśobhita pṛthivīko anāyāsa hī uṭhā sakatā thā || 244|| | aisā indra alpa śakti ke dhāraka vidyādharake dvārā jo ki eka sādhāraṇa manuṣya hī thā kaise parājita ho sakatā thā || 245 || usameṃ yaha bhī likhā hai ki rākṣasoṃke rājā rāvaṇane indrako apane bandīgṛhameṃ pakaḍa़kara rakhā thā aura usane bandhanase baddha hokara laṃkāke bandīgṛhameṃ cirakāla taka nivāsa kiyā thā ||246 || so aisā kahanā mṛgoṃ dvārā siṃhakā vadha honā, tiloṃke dvārā śilāoṃkā pīsā jānā, paniyā sā~pake dvārā nāgakā mārā jānā aura kuttā ke dvārā gajarājakā damana hone ke samāna hai || 247|| vratake dhāraka

tadanantara—puṣparūpī paṭake bhītara sokara bāhara nikale hue bhramaroṃkī madhura guṃjārase jisakā eka bhāga bahuta hī ramaṇīya thā, jisake bhītara jalate hue niṣprabha dīpaka prātaḥkālako śīta vāyuke jhoṃkese hila rahe the aura jo bahuta hī śobhāsampanna thā aise nivāsagṛha se rājā śreṇika bāhara nikale || 254 || bāhara nikalate hī unhoṃne lakṣmīke samāna kāntivālī tathā karakuḍmaloke dvārā kamaloṃ kī śobhāko prakaṭa karanevālī vārāṃganāoṃke nukīle dā~toṃse daṣṭa śreṣṭha bimbase nirgata jayanādako sunā || 255|| isa prakāra atyanta śubha dhyānake prabhāvase niścalatāko prāpta hue śubha bhāvase jinheṃ tatkālake upayogī samasta śubha bhāvoṃkī prāpti huī thī aise mahārāja śreṇika, sapheda kamalake samāna kāntivāle nivāsagṛhase bāhara nikalakara śarada ṛtuke meghoṃ ke samūha se bāhara nikale hue sūrya ke samāna suśobhita ho rahe the || 256||

tṛtīyaṃ parva niścakrāma tato garmāt pūrṇe kāle jinottamaḥ | malasparśavinirmuktaḥ sphoṭikādiva samataḥ ||159|| tato mahotsavaścakre nāminā sutajanmani | samānanditaniḥśeṣajano yuktyā yathoktayā ||16|| trailokyaṃ śobhamāyātamaindraṃ kampitamāsanam | surāsurāśca saṃjātāḥ kiṃkimetaditisvanāḥ ||16|| anādhmātastataḥ śaṅkho dadhvāna bhavanaśritām | vyantarādhipageheṣu rarāṭa paṭahaḥ svayam ||162|| jyotiṣāṃ nilaye jātamakasmāta siṃhaghaṃhitam | kailpādhipagrahe spaṣṭaṃ ghaṇṭāratnaṃ rairāṇa ca ||13|| evaṃ vidhaśubhotpātaititīrthakarodbhavāḥ | pracalaniḥ kirīṭaiśca prayuktāvadhayastataḥ ||16|| prātiṣṭhanta mahotsāhā indrā nāmīyamālayam | vāraṇendrasamārūḍhāḥ kṛtamaṇḍanavigrahāḥ ||165|| tataḥ kandarpiṇaḥ kecit surā nṛtyaṃ pracakrire | cakrurāsphoṭanaṃ kecid balānāṃ kecidunnatam ||166|| kecit kesariṇo 'nādaṃ mumucuāptaviṣṭapam | vikurvanti bahūn veṣān kecit kecijagurvaram ||167|| utpatabhiḥ pataniśca tato devairidaṃ jagat | mahārāvasamāpūrṇa sthānabhraṃśamivāgatam ||16|| tataḥ sāketanagaraṃ dhanadena vinirmitam | vijayārddhanagākāraprākāreṇa samāvṛtam ||169|| pātālodaragambhīraparikhākṛtaveṣṭanam | tuṅgagopurakūṭāgradūranaṣṭāntarikṣakam ||170|| nānāratnakarodyotapaṭaprāvṛtasamakam | indrāḥ kṣaṇena saṃprāpurmahābhūtisamanvitāḥ ||17|| puraṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya triḥ śakraḥ sahito'maraiḥ | praviṣṭaḥ prasavāgārāt paulomyānāyayajinam ||172||
jaba samaya pūrṇa ho cukā taba bhagavān malakā sparśa kiye binā hī garbhase isa prakāra bāhara nikale jisa prakāra ki kisī sphaṭikamaṇi nirmita gharase bāhara nikale hoṃ ||159||
tadanantara-nābhirājane putrajanmakā yathokta mahotsava kiyā jisase samasta loga harṣita ho gaye ||160|| tīna loka kṣobhako prāpta ho gaye, indrakā āsana kampita ho gayā aura samasta sura tathā asura 'kyā hai ?' yaha śabda karane lage ||161|| usī samaya bhavanavāsī devoṃke bhavanoṃmeṃ binā bajāye hī śaṃkha bajane lage. vyantaroṃke bhavanoṃmeṃ apane āpa hī bheriyoṃke śabda hone lage, jyotiṣī devoṃke gharameṃ akasmāt siṃhoṃkī garjanā hone lagī aura kalpavāsī devoṃke gharoṃmeṃ apane-apane ghaṇṭā śabda karane lage ||162-163|| isa prakārake śubha utpātoṃse tathā mukuṭoṃke namrībhūta honese indroṃne avadhijñānakā upayoga kiyā aura usake dvārā unheṃ tīrthaṃkarake janmakā samācāra vidita ho gayā ||164|| tadanantara jo bahuta bhārī utsāhase bhare hue the tathā jinake śarīra ābhūṣaṇoṃse jagamagā rahe the aise indrane gajarāja-airāvata hāthīpara ārūḍha hokara nābhirājake gharakī ora prasthāna kiyā ||165|| usa samaya kāmase yukta kitane hī deva natya kara rahe the, kitane hī tāliyāṃ bajā rahe the, kitane hī apanī senāko unnata banā rahe the, kitane hī samasta lokameṃ phailanevālā siṃhanāda kara rahe the, kitane hī vikriyāse aneka veṣa banā rahe the, aura kitane hī utkṛṣṭa gānā gā rahe the ||166-167| usa samaya bahuta bhārī śabdoṃse bharā huā yaha saṃsāra ūpara jānevāle aura nīce ānevāle devoṃse aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno svakīya sthānase bhraṣṭa hī ho gayā ho ||168|| tadanantara kuberane ayodhyā nagarīkī racanā kī| vaha ayodhyā nagarī vijayā parvatake samāna ākāravāle viśāla koṭase ghirī huī thī ||169|| pātāla taka gaharī parikhā use cāroṃ orase ghere hue thī aura ū~ce-ū~ce gopuroṃke śikharoṃke agrabhāgase vahā~kā ākāśa dūra taka vidīrṇa ho rahā thā ||170|| mahāvibhūtise yukta indra kṣaṇabharameṃ nābhirājake usa ghara jā pahu~ce jo ki nānā ratnoṃkī kiraṇoṃke prakāśarūpī vastrase āvṛta thā ||171|| indrane pahale devoṃke sātha-sātha nagarakī tīna

dvayaṃ babhāra tadvaktramanyonyasya virodhakam | kāntyā jitaniśānāthaṃ dīptyā ca jitabhāskaram ||227|| karau tasyāruṇacchāyau pallavādapi komalau |'dhūlīkāre samastānāṃ bhūbhṛtāmatha ca kṣamau ||228|| niviḍaḥ keśasaṃghātaḥ snigdho'tyantaṃ babhūva ca| nīlāanaśilākāro muni hemagireriva ||229|| dharmātmanāpi lokasya tena sarvasya locane | upamānamatītena hṛte rūpeṇa śaṃbhunā ||23|| tasmin kāle praṇaṣṭeṣu kalpavṛkṣeṣvaśeṣataḥ | akṛṣṭapacyasasyena mahī sarvā virājate ||23|| vāṇijyavyavahāreṇa śilpaiśca rahitāḥ prajāḥ | abhāvāda dharmasaṃjñāyāḥ pākhaṇḍaiśca vivarjitāḥ ||232|| ālīdikṣarasastāsāmāhāraḥ ṣaḍrasānvitaḥ | svayaṃ chinnacyutaḥ kāntivīryādikaraṇakṣamaḥ ||233|| so'pi kālānubhāvena stayaṃ galati no yadā| yantraniṣpīḍanajñaśca na loko'nupadeśataḥ ||234|| paśyantyo'pi tadā sasyaṃ tatsaṃskāravidhau jaḍāḥ | sudhāsaṃtāpitāḥ satyaḥ prajā vyākulatāṃ gatāḥ ||235|| tataḥ śaraṇamīyustā nābhi saṃghātamāgatāḥ | ūcuśceti vacaḥ stutvā praṇamya ca mahātayaḥ ||236|| nātha yātāḥ samastāste prakṣayaṃ kalpapādapāḥ | kṣudhā saṃtāpitānasmāṃstrāyasva śaraṇāgatān ||237|| bhūmijaṃ phalasaṃpannaṃ kimapyetacca dṛśyate | vidhimasya na jānīmaḥ saṃskāre bhakṣaṇocitam ||23|| svachandacāriṇāmetadgokulānāṃ stanāntarāt | kṣarabhakṣyamamakṣyaṃ kiṃ kathaṃ ceti vada prabho ||239||
mukhane kāntise candramāko jīta liyā thā aura tejane sūryako parāsta kara diyā thā isa taraha vaha parasparake virodhī do padārthoṃ-candramā aura sūryako dhāraṇa kara rahā thā ||227| yadyapi lāla-lāla kāntike dhāraka unake donoṃ hātha pallavase bhī adhika komala the tathāpi ve samasta parvatoṃko cūrṇa karanemeṃ ( pakṣameṃ samasta rājāoṃkā parājaya karanemeṃ ) samartha the ||228|| unake keśoṃkā samūha atyanta saghana tathā sacikkaṇa thā aura aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno meru parvatake śikharapara nīlāṃjanakī śilā hī rakhī ho ||229|| yadyapi ve bhagavān dharmātmā the-haraṇa ādiko adharma mānate the tathāpi unhoṃne apane anupama rūpase samasta logoṃke netra haraṇa kara liye the| bhāvārthabhagavānkā rūpa sarvajananayanābhirāma thā ||230|| usa samaya kalpavṛkṣa pūrṇarūpase naṣṭa ho cuke the isalie samasta pṛthivī akṛṣṭapacya arthāt binā jote, binā boye hī apane āpa utpanna honevālī dhānyase suśobhita ho rahī thī ||231|| usa samayakī prajā vāṇijya-lena-denakā vyavahāra tathā śilpase rahita thī aura dharmakā to nāma bhī nahīṃ thā isalie pākhaṇḍase bhī rahita thī ||232|| jo chaha rasoṃse sahita thā, svayaṃ hī kaṭakara śākhāse jhaḍa़ne lagatā thā aura bala-vīrya ādike karane meṃ samartha thā aisā ikṣurasa hī usa samayakī prajākā āhāra thā ||233|| pahale to vaha jharasa apane āpa nikalatā thā para kālake prabhāvase aba usakā svayaṃ nikalanā banda ho gayā aura loga binā kucha batāye yantroṃke dvārā īkhako pelanekī vidhi jānate nahīṃ the ||234|| isī prakāra sāmane khaḍa़ī huī dhānako loga dekha rahe the para usake saṃskārakī vidhi nahīṃ jānate the isalie bhūkhase pīḍa़ita hokara atyanta vyākula ho uṭhe ||235|| tadanantara bahuta bhārī pīḍa़āse yukta ve loga ikaṭṭhe hokara nābhirājakī śaraṇameṃ pahuṃce aura stuti tathā praṇāma kara nimnalikhita vacana kahane lage ||236|| he nātha ! jinase hamārā bharaṇa-poṣaṇa hotā thā ve kalpavṛkṣa aba sabake saba naṣṭa ho gaye haiṃ isalie bhūkhase santapta hokara āpakī śaraṇameṃ āye hue hama saba logoṃkī āpa rakṣā kījie ||237|| pṛthivīpara utpanna huī yaha koī vastu phaloṃse yukta dikhāī de rahī hai, yaha vastu saṃskāra kiye jānepara khāne ke yogya ho sakatī hai para hama loga isakī vidhi nahīṃ jānate haiṃ ||238|| svacchanda vicaranevālī gāyoṃke stanoṃke bhītarase yaha kucha padārtha nikala rahā hai so 1. parājaye | 2. paśyanto'pi ma. | 3. sadyaḥ ma.|

vyāghrasiṃhādayaḥ pūrva krīḍāsvāliṅganocitāḥ | adhunā trāsayantyete prajāḥ kalahatatparāḥ ||24|| manoharāṇi divyāni sthalāni jalajāni ca | dṛśyante na tu jānīmaḥ sukhamebhiryathā bhavet ||241|| ataḥ saṃskaraṇopāyameteṣāṃ vada deva naḥ | yataḥ sukhena jīvāmastvatprasādena rakṣitāḥ ||242|| evamuktaḥ prajāmiḥ saṃ nāmiḥ kāruṇyasaṃgataḥ| jagāda vacanaṃ dhīro vṛtterdarśanakāraṇam ||243|| utpattisamaye yasya ratnavṛṣṭirabhūciram | āgamaśca surendrāṇāṃ lokakṣomanakāraṇam ||244|| mahātiśayasaṃpannaṃ tamupetya samaṃ vayam | ṛṣabhaṃ paripṛcchāmaḥ kāraṇaṃ jīvanapradam ||245|| tasya devasya loke'smin sadṛśo nāsti mānavaḥ | sarveṣāṃ tamasāmante tasyātmā saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ ||246|| ityuktāstenaṃ tāḥ sākaṃ nābheyasyāntikaṃ gatāḥ| dṛṣṭvā ca pitaraṃ devo vidhiṃ cakre yathocitam ||247|| upaviṣṭastato nābhi bheyaśca yathāsanam | athainaṃ stotumārabdhāḥ prajāḥ praṇatipūrvakam ||248|| lokaṃ sarvamatikramya tejasā jvalitaṃ vapuḥ | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇa tavaitannātha śomate ||249|| guṇastava jagatsarva vyāptamatyantanirmaleḥ | prahādakaraṇodyaktaiḥ śaśāṅkakiraṇeriva ||250|| vayaṃ prabhuṃ samāyātāḥ pitaraṃ tava kāryiṇaḥ | guṇān jñānasamudbhūtān sa caiṣa tava bhāṣate ||251|| sa tvaṃ ko'pi mahāsattvo mahātmātiśayānvitaḥ | evaṃ vidho'pi yaṃ gatvā niścayārtha niṣevate ||252|| sa tvamevaṃvidho bhūtvā rakṣa naḥ kṣutprapīḍitān | upāyasyopadeśena siṃhādibhayatastathā ||253||
vaha bhakṣya hai yā abhakṣya hai ? he svāmin ! yaha batalāie ||239|| ye siṃha, vyāghra ādi jantu pahale krīḍa़āoṃke samaya āliṃgana karane yogya hote the para aba ye kalahameṃ tatpara hokara prajāko bhayabhīta karane lage haiṃ ||240|| aura ye ākāśa, sthala tathā jalameṃ utpanna hue kitane hī mahāmanohara padārtha dikha rahe haiṃ so inase hameṃ sukha kisa taraha hogā yaha hama nahīṃ jānate haiṃ ||241|| isalie he deva ! hama logoṃko inake saṃskāra karanekā upāya batalāie jisase ki prasādase surakṣita hokara hama loga sukhase jīvita raha sakeṃ ||242|| prajāke aisā kahanepara nābhirājākā hṛdaya dayāse bhara gayā aura ve ājīvikāke upāya dikhalāne ke lie dhīratāke sātha nimna prakāra vacana kahane lage ||243|| jinakī utpattike samaya cirakāla taka ratna-vṛṣṭi huī thī aura lokameṃ kṣobha utpanna karanevālā devoṃkā āgamana huā thā ||244|| mahān atiśayoṃse sampanna ṛṣabhadevake pāsa calakara hama loga unase ājīvikāke kāraṇa pūche ||245|| isa saṃsārameṃ unake samāna koī manuṣya nahīṃ hai| unakī ātmā sarva prakārake ajñānarūpī andhakāroṃse pare hai ||246 || nābhirājāne jaba prajāse ukta vacana kahe to vaha unhīṃko sātha lekara ṛṣabhanātha bhagavānke pāsa gayī| bhagavānne pitāko dekhakara unakā yathāyogya satkāra kiyā ||247|| tadanantara nābhirājā aura bhagavān ṛṣabhadeva jaba apane-apane yogya āsanoṃpara ārūḍha़ ho gaye taba prajāke loga namaskāra kara bhagavānkī isa prakāra stuti karaneke lie tatpara hue ||248|| he nātha! samasta lakṣaṇoṃse bharā huā āpakā yaha śarīra tejake dvārā samasta jagatko ākrānta kara dedīpyamāna ho rahā hai ||249|| candramākī kiraṇoṃke samāna ānanda utpanna karanevāle āpake atyanta nirmala guṇoṃse samasta saṃsāra vyāpta ho rahā hai ||250|| hama loga kārya lekara āpake pitāke pāsa āye the parantu ye jñānase utpanna hue āpake guṇoṃkā bakhāna karate haiṃ ||251|| jabaki aise vidvān mahārāja nābhirāja bhī āpake pāsa ākara padārthakā niścaya kara dete haiṃ taba yaha bāta spaṣṭa ho jātī hai ki āpa atiśayoṃse suśobhita, dhairyako dhāraṇa karanevāle koī anupama mahātmā haiṃ ||252|| isalie āpa, bhūkhase pīḍa़ita hue hama logoṃkī rakṣā kījie tathā siṃha ādi duṣṭa jantuoṃse jo bhaya ho rahā hai usakā bhī upāya batalāie ||253||
1. sannābhiḥ ka., ma. | 2. -stena sākaṃ te ma.| 3. tatra ma,|

tataḥ kṛpāsamāsaktahṛdayo nābhinandanaḥ | śaśāsa caraṇeprāptā baddhāñjalipuṭāḥ prajāḥ ||254|| śilpānāṃ śatamuddiṣṭaṃ nagarāṇāṃ ca kalpanam | grāmādisanniveśāśca tathā veśmādikāraṇam ||255|| kṣetatrāṇe niyuktā ye tena nāthena mānavāḥ | kṣatriyā iti te loke prasiddhiṃ guṇato gatāḥ || 256|| vāṇijya kṛṣigorakṣāprabhṛtau ye niveśitāḥ | vyāpāre vaiśyaśabdena te loke parikīrtitāḥ || 257|| ye tu śrutād drutaṃ prāptā nīcakarmavidhāyinaḥ | śūdrasaṃjñāmavāpuste bhedaiḥ preṣyādibhistathā || 258|| yugaṃ tena kṛtaṃ yasmāditthametatsukhāvaham | tasmātkṛtayugaṃ proktaṃ prajābhiḥ prāptasaṃpadam || 259 || nābheyasya sunandā'bhūnnandā ca vanitādvayam | bharatādaya utpannāstayoḥ putrā mahaujasaḥ || 260 || śatena tasya putrāṇāṃ guṇasaṃbandhacāruṇā | abhūdalaṃkṛtā kṣoṇī nityaprāptasamutsavā ||261|| tasyānupamamaiśvaryaṃ bhuñjānasya jagadguroḥ | prayātaḥ sumahān kālo nābheyasyāmitasviṣaḥ ||262|| atha nīlāñjanākhyāyāṃ nṛtyantyāṃ surayoṣiti | iyaṃ tasya samutpannā buddhirvairāgyakāraṇam ||263|| aho janā viḍambayante paratoṣaṇaceṣṭitaiḥ | unmattacaritākāraiḥ svavapuḥ khedakāraṇaiḥ || 264 || atra kaścit parādhīno loke bhṛtyatvamāgataḥ | ājñāṃ dadāti kaścicśca tasmai garvaskhaladvacāḥ ||265|| evaṃ dhigastu saṃsāraṃ yasminnutpādyate paraiḥ | duḥkhameva sukhābhikhyāṃ nītaṃ saṃmūḍhamānasaiḥ || 266|| tasmādidaṃ parityajya kṛtrimaṃ kṣayavatsukham | siddhū saukhyasamāvāptyai karomyāśu viceṣṭitam || 267|| yāvadevaṃ manastasya pravṛttaṃ śubhacintane | tāvalaukāntikairdevairidamāgatya bhāṣitam || 268 ||
tadanantara - jinakā hṛdaya dayāse yukta thā aise bhagavān vṛṣabhadeva hātha joḍa़kara caraṇoṃ meṃ paḍa़ī huī prajāko upadeśa dene lage || 254 || unhoṃne prajāko saikaḍa़oṃ prakārako śilpakalāoṃkā upadeśa diyā | nagaroṃkā vibhāga, grāma ādikā basānā, aura makāna ādike banānekī kalā prajāko sikhāyī || 255 || bhagavān ne jina puruṣoṃko vipattigrasta manuṣyoṃkī rakṣā karanemeṃ niyukta kiyā thā ve apane guṇoṃke kāraṇa lokameṃ 'kṣatriya' isa nāmase prasiddhiko prāpta hue || 256 || vāṇijya, khetī, gorakṣā ādike vyāpārameṃ jo lagāye gaye the ve lokameṃ vaiśya kahalāye || 257|| jo nīca kārya karate the tathā śāstrase dūra bhāgate the unheṃ śūdra saṃjñā prāpta huī | inake preṣya dāsa ādi aneka bheda the || 258 || isa prakāra sukhako prāpta karānevālā vaha yuga bhagavān ṛṣabhadevake dvārā kiyā gayā thā tathā usameṃ saba prakārako sampadāe~ sulabha thīṃ isalie prajā use kṛtayuga kahane lagī thī || 259 || bhagavān ṛṣabhadevake sunandā aura nandā nāmakī do striyā~ thīṃ| unase unake bharata ādi mahāpratāpī putra utpanna hue the || 260 || bharata ādi so bhāī the tathā guṇoṃke sambandhase atyanta sundara the isalie yaha pṛthvī unase alaṃkṛta huī thī tathā nirantara hī aneka utsava prāpta karatī rahatī thī || 261 || aparimita kāntiko dhāraṇa karanevāle jagadguru bhagavān ṛṣabhadevako anupama aiśvaryaṃkā upabhoga karate hue jaba bahuta bhārī kāla vyatīta ho gayā || 262|| taba eka dina nīlāṃjanā nāmaka devīke nṛtya karate samaya unheṃ vairāgyakī utpattimeṃ kāraṇabhūta nimna prakārakī buddhi utpanna huī || 263 || ve vicārane lage ki aho ! saṃsārake ye prāṇī dūsaroṃko santuṣṭa karanevāle kāryoṃse viḍambanā prāpta kara rahe haiṃ | prāṇiyoṃ ke ye kāryaṃ pāgaloṃkī ceṣṭāke samāna haiṃ tathā apane śarīrako kheda utpanna karaneke lie kāraṇasvarūpa haiṃ || 264 || saṃsārakī vicitratā dekho, yahā~ koī to parādhīna hokara dāsavṛttiko prāpta hotā hai aura koī gava~se skhalita vacana hotā huā use ājñā pradāna karatā hai || 265 || isa saṃsārako dhikkāra ho ki jisameṃ mohī jīva duḥkhako hī, sukha samajhakara, utpanna karate haiṃ || 266 || | isalie maiṃ to isa vināśīka tathā kṛtrima sukhako choḍa़kara siddha jīvoṃkā sukha prāpta karaneke lie śīghra hī prayatna karatā hū~ || 267 || isa 1. śaraṇaṃ prāptā ka. | 2. kṣatitrāṇe ma. | 3 śrutā kha | śrutvā hṛti ma | 4 prāptasammadam ma. | 5. nīlāṃñjasā- ma., kha | 6. paritoṣaka ma. | 7. siddhi kha |

tṛtīyaṃ parva sādhu nāthāvabuddhaṃ te trailokyahitakāraṇam | vicchinnasya mahākālo mokṣamārgasya vartate ||269|| ete viparivartante bhavaduḥkhamahārṇave | upadeśasya dātāramantareṇāsudhāriṇaḥ ||27|| vrajantu sāṃprataṃ jīvā deśitena pathotvayā | yuktamakṣayasaukhyena lokāgre'vasthitaṃ padam ||271|| iti tasya prabuddhasya svayameva mahātmanaḥ | surairu dāhṛtā vācaḥ prayātāḥ punaruktatām ||272|| iti niṣkramaṇe tena cintite tadanantaram | āgatāḥ pūrvavaddevāḥ purandarapurassarāḥ ||273|| āgatya ca suraiḥ sarvaiḥ stutaḥ praṇatipūrvakam | cintitaṃ sādhu nātheti bhāṣitaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ||27|| 'tato ratnapramājālajaṭilīkṛtadiṅmukhām | candrāṃśunikarākārapracalaccārucāmarām ||275|| pūrṇacandranimādarśakṛtaśobhā sabubudām | arddhacandrakasaṃyuktāmaṃśukadhvajabhūṣitām ||276|| divyasragbhiḥ kṛtāmodāṃ muktāhāravirājitām | sudarśanāṃ vimānāmā kiṅkiṇībhiḥ kṛtasvanām ||277|| saranāthāpita skandhāṃ devaśilpivinirmitām | āruhya śivikāṃ nātho nirjagāma nijālayāt ||27|| tataḥ śabdena tūryāṇāṃ nṛtyatāṃ ca divaukasām | trilokavivarāpūraścakre pratininādinā ||279|| tato'syantamahābhatyā bhaktyā devaiḥ samanvitaḥ| tilakāha tamadyāna saṃprāpa jinapuṅgavaḥ ||28|| prajāga iti deśo'sau prajābhyo'smin gato yataḥ | prakṛṣṭo vā kṛtastyāgaḥ prayāgastena kīrtitaḥ ||281||
āpṛcchanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitro bandhujanasya ca | namaḥ siddhebhya ityuktvā śrāmaṇyaṃ pratyapadyata ||282|| taraha yahā~ bhagavānkā citta śubha vicārameṃ lagā huā thā ki vahā~ usī samaya laukāntika devoṃne ākara nimna prakāra nivedana karanā prārambha kara diyā ||268|| ve kahane lage ki he nātha! āpane jo tīna lokake jīvoṃkā hita karanekā vicāra kiyā hai so bahuta hī uttama bāta hai| isa samaya mokṣakā mārga banda hae bahata samaya ho gayā hai||269|| ye prāṇī upadeśa-dātāke binā saṃsārarūpī mahāsāgarameṃ gotā lagā rahe haiṃ ||270|| isa samaya prāṇī āpake dvārā batalāye hue mārgase calakara avināśī sukhase yukta tathā lokake agrabhāgameṃ sthita mukta jīvoṃke padako prāpta hoṃ ||271|| isa prakāra devoṃke dvārā kahe hue vacana svayambuddha bhagavān ādināthake samakṣa punaruktatāko prāpta hue the ||272|| jyoṃ hī bhagavānne gṛhatyāgakā niścaya kiyā tyoṃ hī indra ādi deva pahalekī bhā~ti ā pahuṃce ||273|| ākara samasta devoṃne namaskārapūrvaka bhagavānkī stuti kī aura 'he nātha ! āpane bahuta acchā vicāra kiyā hai' yaha śabda bāra-bāra kahe ||274||
tadanantara, jisane ratnoṃkī kāntike samūhase diśāoṃke agrabhāgako vyāpta kara rakhā thā, jisake donoṃ ora candramākī kiraṇoṃke samūhake samāna sundara camara ḍhole jā rahe the, pūrṇa candramāke samāna darpaṇase jisakī śobhā baḍha़ rahī thī, jo buvudake ākāra maṇimaya go sahita thī, arddhacandrākārase sahita thī, patākāoṃke vastrase suśobhita thī, divya mālāoṃse sugandhita thī, motiyoṃke hārase virājamāna thī, dekhane meṃ bahuta sundara thī, vimānake samāna jāna paḍa़tī thī, jisameṃ lagī huī choṭī-choṭī ghaṇṭiyā~ runa-jhuna śabda kara rahī thīṃ, aura indrane jisapara apanā kandhā lagā rakhā thā aisī devarūpī śilpiyoṃke dvārā nirmita pālakīpara savāra hokara bhagavān apane gharase bāhara nikale ||275-278|| tadanantara bajate hue bājoṃ aura nṛtya karate hue devoṃke pratidhvani pūrṇa śabdase tīnoṃ lokoṃkā antarāla bhara gayā ||279|| bahuta bhārī vaibhava aura bhaktise yukta devoṃke sātha bhagavān tilaka nāmaka udyānameṃ pahu~ce ||280|| bhagavān vṛṣabhadeva prajā arthāt jana samahase dūra ho usa tilaka nāmaka udyāna meṃ pahuṃce the isalie usa sthānakā nāma 'prajāga' prasiddha ho gayā athavā bhagavānne usa sthānapara bahuta bhārī yāga arthāt tyāga kiyā thā, isalie usakā nāma 'prayāga' bhī prasiddha huā ||281|| vahā~ pahu~cakara bhagavānne mātā-pitā tathā bandhujanoṃse dīkṣā lenekī ājñā lī aura phira 'namaḥ siddhebhyaḥ'-siddhoṃke lie 1. trailokye ma.| 2. yathā ma. | 3. tāraratna- kha.| 4. pratipadyata ma. |

athānantara suvarṇake samāna prabhāke dhāraka dhyānī bhagavān ṛṣabhadeva prabhu jagat ke kalyāṇake nimitta dāna dharmakī pravṛtti karaneke lie udyata hue ||1|| dhīra-vīra bhagavān ne chaha māhake bāda pratimā yoga samāpta kara pṛthivī talapara bhramaṇa karanā prārambha kiyā | bhagavān samasta doṣoṃse rahita the aura mauna dhāraṇa kara hī vihāra karate the ||2|| jinakā śarīra bahuta hī ū~cā thā tathā jo apane śarīrakī prabhāse āsa-pāsake bhūmaṇḍalako ālokita kara rahe the aise bhramaṇa karanevāle bhagavān ke darśana kara prajā yaha samajhatī thī māno dūsarā sūrya hī bhramaṇa kara rahā hai || 3 || ve jinarāja pṛthivītalapara jahā~-jahā~ caraṇa rakhate the vahā~ aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno kamala hī khila uṭhe hoṃ ||4||
unake kandhe meruparvatake śikharake samāna ū~ce tathā dedīpyamāna the, unapara baḍa़ī-baḍa़ī jāe~ kiraṇoṃkī bhā~ti suśobhita ho rahī thīṃ aura bhagavān svayaṃ baḍa़ī sāvadhānī se -- īryāsamitise nīce dekhate hue vihāra karate the ||5|| jo śobhāse meru parvata ke samāna jāna paḍa़te the aise bhagavān ṛṣabhadeva kisī dina vihāra karate-karate madhyāhnake samaya hastināpura nagara meṃ praviṣṭa hue || 6 || madhyāhna ke sūryake samāna dedīpyamāna una puruṣottama ke darśana kara hastināpurake samasta strī-puruṣa baḍa़e āścaryase mohako prāpta ho gaye arthāt kisīko yaha dhyāna nahīṃ rahā ki yaha āhārakī velā hai isalie bhagavānko āhāra denā cāhie ||7|| vahā~ke loga nānā varṇoṃke vastra, aneka prakārake ratna aura hāthī, ghoḍa़e, ratha tathā anya prakārake vāhana lā lākara unheṃ samarpita karane lage ||8|| vinīta veṣako dhāraṇa karanevāle kitane hī loga pūrṇacandramāke samāna mukhavālī tathā kamaloṃke samāna netroṃse suśobhita sundara-sundara kanyāe~ unake pāsa le āye ||9|| jaba ve pativratā kanyāe~ bhagavān ke lie rucikara nahīṃ huīṃ taba ve nirāśa hokara svayaṃ apane āpase hī dveṣa karane lagīṃ aura ābhūṣaṇa dūra pheṃka bhagavānkā dhyāna karatī huī khaḍa़ī raha gayīṃ ||10||

prakīrṇā sumanovṛṣṭhiramodākṛṣṭaṣaṭpadā | namaḥ sthairamarairnānārūpasaṃ bhavagāminī || 25|| mahādundubhayo neduḥ kṣubdhasāgaranisvanāḥ | adṛṣṭavigrahairdevairāhatāḥ karapallavaiḥ ||26|| yakṣa padmapalāśākṣau sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitau | cālayāñcakratuḥ svairaṃ cāmare candrahāsinī || 27 || merumastakasaṃkāśaṃ mukuṭaṃ bhūmiyoṣitaḥ | siṃhāsanaṃ samutpannaṃ karāhatadivākaraṃm || 28|| trilokavibhutācihnaṃ muktājālakabhūṣitam | chatratrayaṃ samudbhūtaṃ tasyeva vimalaṃ yaśaḥ ||29|| siṃhāsana sthitasyāsya saraṇaṃ samavānvitam | prāptasya gadituṃ śobhāṃ kevalī kevalaṃ prabhuḥ || 30 || tatastamavadhijñānādavagamya surādhipāḥ | vandituṃ sapadi prāptāḥ parivārasamanvitāḥ || 31 || khyāto vṛṣamaseno'sya saṃjāto gaṇabhṛtataḥ | anye ca śramaṇā jātā mahāṃbairāgyayoginaḥ ||32|| yathāsthānaṃ tatasteṣu saraṇe samavānvite | yatyādiṣu niviṣṭeṣu gaṇeśena pracoditaḥ ||33|| chādayantīṃ svanādena devadundubhi niḥsvanam | jagāda bhagavān vācaṃ tattvārthapariśaṃsinīm ||34|| asmiṃstribhuvane kṛtsne jīvānāṃ hitamicchatām | śaraṇaṃ paramo dharmastasmācca paramaṃ sukham ||35|| sukhārthaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ sarvaṃ tacca dharmanimittakam | evaṃ jñātvā janā yatnāt kurudhvaṃ dharmasaṃgraham || 36 || vṛṣṭirvinā kuto mevaiḥ kva sasyaṃ bījavarjitam | jīvānāṃ ca vinā dharmāt sukhamutpadyate kutaḥ || 37|| gantukāmo yathā paṅgurbhūko vaktuṃ samudyataḥ | andho darśanakāmaśca tathā dharmādṛte sukham ||38||
bahuta ho adhika suśobhita ho rahe the ||24|| ākāśameṃ sthita devoṃne sugandhise bhramaroṃ ko ākarṣita karanevālī evaṃ nānā ākārameṃ paḍa़nevālī phūloṃ kī varṣā kī ||25|| jinake śabda, kṣobhako prāpta hue samudra śabda samāna bhārī the aise baḍa़e-baḍa़e dundubhi bāje, adṛśya śarīrake dhāraka devoṃke dvārā karapallavoṃse tāḍita hokara viśāla śabda karane lage ||26|| jinake netra kamalakī kalikāoṃke samāna the tathā jo sarva prakāra ke ābhūṣaṇoṃse suśobhita the aise donoṃ ora khaḍa़e hue do yakṣa, candramākī ha~sī uḍa़ānevāle - sapheda camara icchānusāra calāne lage ||27|| jo meruke śikhara ke samāna ū~cā thā, pṛthivīrūpī strīkā māno mukuṭa hī thā, aura apanī kiraṇoṃse sūryako tiraskṛta kara rahā thā aisā siṃhāsana utpanna huā || 28 || jo tīna lokakī prabhutākā cihnasvarūpa thā, motiyoṃkī laḍa़iyoṃ se vibhūṣita thā aura bhagavān ke nirmala yaśake samāna jāna paḍa़tā thā aisā chatratraya utpanna huā ||29|| ācārya raviṣeṇa kahate haiṃ ki samavasaraṇake bīca siṃhāsanapara virājamāna hue bhagavāna kī śobhākā varṇana karaneke lie mātra kevalajñānī hī samartha haiṃ, hamāre jaise tuccha puruṣa usa śobhākā varṇana kaise kara sakate haiṃ ||30||

tadanantara avadhijñānake dvārā, bhagavān‌ko kevalajñāna utpanna honekā samācāra jānakara saba indra apane-apane parivāroṃke sātha vandanā karaneke lie śīghra hī vahā~ āye ||31|| sarva prathama vṛṣabhasena nāmaka munirāja inake prasiddha gaṇadhara hue the| unake bāda mahāverāgyako dhāraṇa karanevāle anya anya munirāja bhī gaṇadhara hote rahe the ||32|| usa samavasaraṇameṃ jaba muni, śrāvaka tathā deva ādi saba loga yathāsthāna apane-apane koṭhoṃmeṃ baiṭha gaye taba gaṇadharane bhagavān se upadeśa denekī preraṇā kī ||33|| bhagavān apane śabdase deva-dundubhiyoṃ ke śabdako tirohita karate evaṃ tattvārthako sūcita karanevālī nimnāṃkita vāṇī kahane lage ||34|| unhoṃne kahā ki isa trilokātmaka samasta saṃsāra meṃ hita cāhanevāle logoṃko eka dharmaṃ hī parama śaraṇa haiṃ, usīse utkṛṣṭa sukha prāpta hotā hai| ||35|| prāṇiyoṃkī samasta ceṣṭāe~ sukhake lie haiṃ aura sukha dharmake nimittase hotā hai, aisā jānakara he bhavya jana ! tuma saba dharmaṃkā saṃgraha karo || 36 || binā meghoṃ ke vṛṣṭi kaise ho sakatī hai aura binā bīja anāja kaise utpanna ho sakatā hai| isī taraha binā dharmaṃke. jīvoṃko sukha kaise utpanna ho sakatā hai ? ||37|| jisa prakāra paṃgu manuṣya calaneko icchā kare, gū~gā manuṣya bolanekī icchā kare, 1. nisvanām ma. |

padmapurāṇe paramāṇoḥ paraṃ svalpaṃ na cānyanamaso mahat | dharmādanyaśca loke'smin suhṛnnāsti śarīriṇām ||39|| manuṣyabhogaḥ svargaśca siddhasaukhyaṃ ca dharmataḥ | prāpyate yattadanyena gyāpāreṇa kṛtena kim ||40|| ahiṃsānirmalaṃ dharma sevante ye vipaścitaḥ | teṣāmevorddhavagamanaṃ yānti tiryagadho'nyathā ||4|| yadyapyūvaṃ tapaḥśaktyā vrajeyuḥ paraliṅginaḥ | tathāpi kiṅkarā bhūtvā te devān samupāsate ||42|| devadurgatiduḥkhāni prāpya karmavaśāttataḥ | svargacyutāḥ punastiryagyonimāyānti duḥkhinaḥ ||43|| samyagdarśanasaṃpannāḥ svabhyastajinaśāsanāḥ | divaṃ gatvā cyutā bodhi prāpya yānti paraṃ śivam ||44|| sāgārāṇāṃ yatīnāṃ ca dharmo'sau dvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ | tṛtīyaṃ ye tu manyante dagdhāste mohavahinā ||45|| aṇuvratāni pañca syustriprakāraṃ guṇavratam | śikṣāvratāni catvāri dharmo'yaṃ gṛhamedhinām ||46|| sarvārambhaparityāgaṃ kṛtvā dehe'pi niḥspṛhāḥ | kāladharmeṇa saṃyuktā gatiṃ te yānti śobhanām ||47|| mahāvratāni pañca syustathā samitayo matāḥ | guptayastisra udiṣṭā dharmo'yaṃ vyomavāsasām ||48|| dharmaṇānena saṃyuktāḥ śumadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ | yānti nākaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca hisvā pūtikalevaram ||49|| ye'pi jātasvarūpāṇāṃ paramabrahmacāriṇām | stutiṃ kurvanti bhāvena te'pi dharmamavāpnuyuḥ ||50|| tena dharmaprabhāveṇa kugatiṃ na vrajanti te | lamante bodhilāmaṃ ca mucyante yena kilviṣāt ||51|| ityādi devadevena bhāṣitaṃ dharmamuttamam | śrutvā devā manuṣyāśca paramāmodamāgatāḥ ||52||
aura andhā manuṣya dekhanekī icchā kare usī prakāra dharmake binā sukhaprāpta karanā hai ||38|| jisa prakāra isa saṃsārameṃ paramāṇuse choṭī koī cīja nahīṃ hai aura ākāśase baḍa़ī koī vastu nahīṃ hai usī prakāra prāgiyoṃkā dharmase baḍa़ā koī mitra nahīṃ hai ||39|| jaba dharmase hī manuṣya sambandhī bhoga, svarga aura mukta jīvoṃko sukha prāpta ho jātā hai taba dūsarā kārya karanese kyā lābha hai ? ||40|| jo vidvajjana ahiṃsāse nirmala dharmakī sevā karate haiṃ unhīṃkā ūdhvaṃgamana hotā hai anya jīva to tiryagloka athavā adholokameṃ hī jāte haiṃ ||41|| yadyapi anyaliṃgī-haṃsa-paramahaṃsa-parivrājaka
ādi bhī tapaścaraṇakī śaktise ūpara jā sakate haiṃ-svargoṃ meṃ utpanna ho sakate haiṃ tathāpi ve vahā~ kiṃkara hokara anya devoṃkī upāsanā karate haiṃ ||42|| ve vahāṃ deva hokara bhī karmake vaśa durgatike duḥkha pākara svargase cyuta hote haiṃ aura du:khī hote hue tiryaṃca yoni prāpta karate haiṃ ||43|| jo samyagdarśanase sampanna haiṃ tathā jinhoṃne jinaśāsanakā acchī taraha abhyāsa kiyā hai ve svarga jāte haiṃ aura vahā~se cyuta honepara ratnatrayako pākara utkṛṣṭa mokṣako prāpta karate haiṃ ||44|| vaha dharma gahasthoṃ aura muniyoṃke bhedase do prakārakā hai| ina doke sivāya jo tīsare prakārakā dharma mānate haiṃ ve moharūpī agnise jale hue haiṃ ||45|| pā~ca aṇuvrata, tīna guṇavrata aura cāra śikṣāvrata, yaha gṛhasthoṃkā dharma hai ||46|| jo gṛhastha anta samaya saba prakārake ārambhakā tyāga kara śarīrameṃ bhī niḥspṛha ho jāte haiṃ tathā samatā bhāvase maraṇa karate haiṃ ve uttama gatiko prāpta hote haiṃ ||47|| pāṃca mahāvrata, pā~ca samitiyāṃ aura tīna guptiyāṃ yaha muniyoṃkā dharma hai ||48|| jo manuṣya muni dharmase yukta hokara śubha dhyānameṃ tatpara rahate haiṃ ve isa durgandhipūrṇa bībhatsa śarīrako choḍa़kara svarga athavā mokṣako prāpta hote haiṃ ||49|| jo manuṣya utkṛṣṭa brahmacārī digambara muniyoṃkī bhāvapūrvaka stuti karate haiṃ ve bhī dharmako prāpta ho sakate haiṃ ||50|| ve usa dharmake prabhāvase kugatiyoṃmeṃ nahīṃ jāte kintu usa ratnatrayarūpī dharmako prāpta kara lete haiṃ jisake ki prabhāvase pāpabandhanase mukta ho jāte haiṃ ||51|| isa prakāra devādhideva bhagavān vṛṣabhadevake dvārā kahe hue uttama dharmako sunakara deva aura manuṣya sabhī parama harṣako prāpta hue ||52|| 1. śarīriṇaḥ ma. | 2. gṛhasevinām ma. | 3. śobhatām ma. | 4. devamanuṣyāśca ma. | 5. paramaṃ moda- ma. |

caturtha pa rakṣitaṃ yasya yakṣāṇāṃ sahasreṇa prayatnataḥ | sarvendriyasukhaṃ ratnaṃ subhadrākhyaṃ vyarājata ||83|| pañca putraśatānyasya yairidaṃ bharatāhvayam | kṣetraṃ vibhāgato bhuktaṃ pitrā dattamakaṇṭakam ||84|| athaivaṃ kathitaṃ tena gautamena mahātmanā | śreṇikaḥ punarapyāha vākyametatkutūhalī ||85|| varṇatrayasya bhagavansaṃbhavo me tvayoditaḥ | utpattiṃ sūtrakaṇṭhānāṃ jñātumicchāmi sāṃpratam ||86|| prāṇighātādikaṃ kṛtvā karma sādhujugupsitam | paraṃ vahantyamī gavaṃ dharmaprāptinimittakam ||87|| tadeṣāṃ viparītānāmutpattiṃ vaktumarhasi | kathaṃ caiṣāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ bhakto lokaḥ pravartate ||88|| evaṃ pṛṣṭo gaṇeśo'sāvidaṃ vacanamabravīt | kṛpāṅganāpariṣvaktahṛdayo hatamatsaraḥ || 89 || śreṇika śrūyatāmeṣā yathājātasamudbhavaḥ | viparītapravṛttīnāṃ mohāvaṣṭabdhacetasām || 90 || sāketanagarāsane pradeśe prathamo jinaḥ | āsāñcakre'nyadā devatiryagmānavaveṣṭitaḥ ||91|| jñātvā taṃ bharatastuṣṭo prāhayitvā susaṃskṛtam | annaṃ jagāma yatyarthaṃ bahubhedaprakalpitam ||92|| praṇamya ca jinaṃ bhaktyā samastāṃśca digambarān | bhūmau karadvayaṃ kṛtvā vāṇīmetāmabhāṣata || 93 || prasādaṃ bhagavanto me kartumarhatha yācitāḥ | pratīcchata mayā bhikṣāṃ śobhanāmupapāditām ||94|| ityukte bhagavānāha bharateyaṃ na kalpate | sādhūnāmīdṛśī bhikṣā yā taduddeśasaṃskṛtā ||95||
indra svarga meṃ apane śubhakarmakā phala bhogatā hai usī prakāra bharata cakravartī bhī ekachatra pṛthivīpara apane śubhakarmakā phala bhogatā thā || 82|| eka hajāra yakṣa prayatnapūrvaka jisakī rakṣā karate the aisā samasta indriyoṃ ko sukha denevālā usakā subhadrā nāmaka strīratna atiśaya śobhāyamāna thā || 83 || bharata cakravartīke pā~ca sau putra the jo pitāke dvārā vibhāga kara diye hue niṣkaṇṭaka bharata kṣetrakā upabhoga karate the ||84|| isa prakāra mahātmā gautama gaṇadharane bhagavān ṛṣabhadeva tathā unake putra aura pautroṃkā varṇana kiyā jise sunakara kutūhalase bhare hue rājā śreṇikane phirase yaha kahā ||85 || he bhagavan ! āpane mere lie kṣatriya, vaiśya aura śūdra ina tīna varṇoṃ kī utpatti to kahī aba maiṃ isa samaya brāhmaṇoṃ kī utpatti aura jānanā cāhatā hū~ || 86 || ye loga dharmaprāptike nimitta, sajjanoṃke dvārā nindita prāṇihiṃsā ādi kārya kara bahuta bhārī garvako dhāraṇa karate haiṃ ||87|| isalie āpa ina viparīta pravṛtti karanevāloṃ kī utpatti kahaneke yogya haiṃ| sātha hī yaha bhī batalāie ki ina gṛhastha brāhmaṇoṃ ke loga bhakta kaise ho jāte haiṃ ? ||88 || isa prakāra dayārūpī strī jinake hṛdayakā āliṃgana kara rahī thī tathā matsara bhāvako jinhoṃne naṣṭa kara diyā thā aise gautama gaṇadhara ne rājā śreṇika ke pūchanepara nimnāṃkita vacana kahe ||89|| he śreṇika ! jinakā hṛdaya mohase ākrānta hai aura isīlie jo viparīta pravṛtti kara rahe haiṃ aise ina brāhmaṇoṃ kī utpatti jisa prakāra huī vaha maiṃ kahatā hū~ tū suna ||20||
eka bāra ayodhyā nagarīke samīpavartī pradeśa meṃ deva, manuṣya tathā tiryaṃcoṃse veṣṭita bhagavān ṛṣabhadeva ākara virājamāna hue | unheṃ āyā jānakara rājā bharata bahuta hī santuṣṭa huā aura muniyoṃ ke uddeśya se banavāyā huā nānā prakārakā uttamottama bhojana naukaroṃse livākara bhagavān ke pāsa pahu~cā | vahā~ jākara usane bhaktipūrvaka bhagavān ṛṣabhadevako tathā anya samasta muniyoṃko namaskāra kiyā aura pṛthvīpara donoṃ hātha ṭekakara yaha vacana kahe ||91-93 || he bhagavan ! maiṃ yācanā karatā hū~ ki āpa loga mujhapara prasanna hoie aura mere dvārā taiyāra karāyī huī yaha uttamottama bhikṣā grahaṇa kījie | || 94 || bharatake aisā kahanepara bhagavānne kahā ki he bharata ! jo bhikṣā muniyoṃke uddeśyase taiyāra kī jātī hai vaha unake yogya nahīṃ hai - munijana uddiṣṭa bhojana grahaṇa nahīṃ

ete hi tṛṣṇayā muktā nirjitendriyaśatravaḥ | vidhāyāpi bahūn māsānupavāsaṃ mahāguṇāḥ ||96|| frri re movi nirdoṣāṃ maunamāsthitāḥ | bhuñjate prāṇaṣṭatyarthaṃ prāṇā dharmasya hetavaḥ ||97|| dharmaṃ caranti mokṣārthaṃ yatra pīḍā na vidyate | kathaṃcidapi sattvānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sukhamicchatām ||98|| śrutvā tadvacanaṃ samrāḍa़cintayadidaṃ ciram | aho vata mahākaṣṭaṃ jaineśva ramidaṃ vratam || 99 || tiṣṭhanti munayo yatra svasmin dehe'pi niḥspṛhāḥ | jātarūpadharā dhīrāḥ sarvabhūtadayāparāḥ ||100|| idānīṃ bhojayāmyetān sāgāravratamāśritān | lakṣaṇaṃ hemasūtreṇa kṛtvaitena mahāndhasā ||101|| prakāmamanyadapyebhyo dānaṃ yacchāmi bhaktitaḥ | kanīyān munidharmasya dharmo'mībhiḥ samāśritaḥ || 102|| samyagdṛṣṭijanaṃ sarvaṃ tato'sau dharaṇītale | nyamantrayan mahāvegaiḥ puruṣaiḥ svasya saṃmataiḥ || 103 || mahān kalakalo jātaḥ sarvasyāmavanau tataḥ | mo mo narā mahādānaṃ marataḥ kartumudyataḥ || 104 || uttiṣṭhatāśu gacchāmo vastraratnādikaṃ dhanam | ānayāmo narā hyete preṣitāstena sādarāḥ || 105 || uktamanyairidaṃ tatra pūjayatyeṣa saṃmatān | samyagdṛṣṭijanān rājā gamanaṃ tatra no vṛthā || 106 || tataḥ samyagdṛśo yātā harṣaṃ paramamāgatāḥ | samaṃ putraiḥ kalatraiśca puruṣā vinayasthitāḥ || 107|| mithyādṛśo'pi saṃprāptā māyayā vasutṛṣṇayā | bhavanaṃ rājarājasya śakraprāsādasannibham ||108|| aṅgaṇoptayavabrīhimudmāṣāṅkurādibhiḥ | uccitya lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvān samyagdarśanasaṃskṛtān || 109||
ra || 95|| ye muni tṛṣṇāse rahita haiṃ, inhoṃne indriyarūpī śatruoṃko jīta liyā hai, tathā mahān guṇoṃke dhāraka haiṃ | ye eka-do nahīṃ aneka mahīnoṃke upavāsa karaneke bāda bhī śrāvakoṃke ghara hī bhojana ke lie jāte haiṃ aura vahāṃ prāpta huī nirdoṣa bhikṣāko mauna se khaḍa़e rahakara grahaṇa karate haiṃ | unakī yaha pravṛtti rasāsvāda ke lie na hokara kevala prāṇoṃkī rakṣāke lie hī hotī hai kyoṃki prāṇa dharmake kāraṇa haiṃ ||96 - 27|| ye muni mokṣa - prāpti ke lie usa dharmakā ācaraṇa kara rahe haiṃ jisameṃ ki sukhakī icchā rakhanevāle samasta prāṇiyoṃko kisī bhī prakārakī pīḍa़ā nahīṃ dī jātī hai ||18|| bhagavān ke ukta vacana sunakara samrāṭ bharata cirakāla taka yaha vicāra karatā rahā aura kahatā rahā ki aho ! jinendra bhagavān‌kā yaha vrata mahān kaṣṭoṃse bharā hai | isa vrata ke pālana karanevāle muni apane śarīra meṃ niḥspṛha rahate haiṃ, digambara hote haiṃ, dhīravīra tathā samasta prāṇiyoṃpara dayā karanemeṃ tatpara rahate haiṃ ||92 - 100|| isa samaya jo yaha mahān bhojana-sāmagrī taiyāra kī gayī hai isase gṛhasthakā vrata dhāraṇa karanevāle puruṣoṃko bhojana karātā hū~ tathā ina gṛhasthoṃko suvarṇasūtra se cihnita karatā ||| 101 || bhojana ke sivāya anya āvaśyaka vastue~ bhī inake lie bhaktipūrvaka acchī mātrāmeṃ detā hū~ kyoṃki ina logoṃne jo dharmaṃ dhāraṇa kiyā hai vaha muni dharmakā choṭā bhāī hī to hai || 102 ||
tadanantara — samrāṭ bharatane mahāvegaśālī apane iṣṭa puruṣoṃko bhejakara pṛthivītalapara vidyamāna samasta samyagdṛṣṭijanoṃko nimantrita kiyā || 103 || isa kāryaṃse samasta pṛthivīpara baḍa़ā kolāhala maca gayā | loga kahane lage ki aho ! manuṣyajana ho ! samrāṭ bharata bahuta bhārī dāna karane ke lie udyata huā hai || 104 || isalie uṭho, śīghra caleṃ, vastra-ratna ādika dhana lāveṃ, dekho ye ādarase bhare sevakajana usane bheje haiṃ || 105 || yaha sunakara unhīṃ logoṃ meṃ se koī kahane lage ki yaha bharata apane iṣṭa samyagdṛṣṭijanoṃ kā hī satkāra karatā hai isalie hama logoṃ kā vahā~ jānā vṛthā hai || 106 || yaha sunakara jo samyagdṛṣṭi puruṣa the ve parama harṣako prāpta ho strī -putrādikoṃ ke sātha bharata ke pāsa gaye aura vinayase khaḍa़e ho gaye || 107 || jo mithyādṛṣṭi the ve bhī dhanakī tṛṣṇāse māyāmayī samyagdṛṣṭi banakara indrabhavanakī tulanā karanevāle samrāṭ bharata ke bhavana meṃ pahu~ce || 108 || samrāṭ bharatane bhavanake ā~ganameṃ boye hue jo, dhāna, mū~ga, uḍa़da ādike aṃkuroṃse 1. śāntapraśamamūrtayaḥ ma | 2. nyāmantrayan ka. | 2. jātāḥ ka., kha. |

caturtha parva
alakṣayat saratnena sūtracihvena cāruṇā| cāmokaramayenāsau prāveśayadatho gṛham ||11|| mithyādṛśo'pi tṛṣṇārtāścintayā vyākulīkṛtāḥ | jalpanto dīnavākyāni praviṣṭā duḥkhasāgaram ||11|| tato yathepsitaṃ dānaṃ śrāvakenyo dadau nṛpaḥ | pūjitānāṃ ca cinteyaṃ teṣāṃ jātā darātmanāma ||11|| vayaṃ ke'pi mahāpūtā jagate hitakāriṇaḥ | pūjitā yannarendraṇa śraddhayā'tyantataṅgayā ||113|| tataste tena garveṇa samaste dharaṇītale | pravṛttā yācituṃ lokaṃ dṛṣṭvā dravyasamanvitam ||114|| tato matisamudreṇa bharatāya niveditam | yathāyeti mayā jaine vacanaṃ sadasi śrutam ||115|| varddhamānajinasyānte maviṣyanti kalau yuge | ete ye bhavatā sṛṣṭāḥ pākhaṇḍino mahoddhatāḥ ||116|| prāṇino mārayiṣyanti dharmabunyā vimohitāḥ| mahākaṣāyasaṃyuktāḥ sadā pāpakriyodyatāḥ ||117|| kugranthaṃ vedasaṃśaṃ ca hiṃsāmāṣaṇatatparam | vakṣyanti kartṛnirmuktaṃ mohayanto'khilāḥ prajāḥ ||118|| mahārambheṣu saṃsaktāḥ pratigrahaparāyaṇāḥ | kariṣyanti sadā nindāṃ jinabhāṣitaśāsane ||119|| nirgranthamagrato dṛṣṭvā krodhaṃ yāsyanti pāpinaḥ | upadravāya lokasya viṣavṛkṣāṅkurā iva ||120|| tacchutvā bharataḥ kruddhaḥ tān sarvān hantumudyataḥ | brāsitāste tatastena nābheyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||121|| yasmānmā hananaṃ putra kārṣīriti 'nivāritam | ṛṣabheṇa tato yātā 'māhanā' iti te śrutim || 122|| rakṣitāste yatastena jinena śaraṇāgatāḥ | vātāramindramityuccaistatastaṃ vibudhā jaguḥ ||123||
samasta samyagdṛṣṭi puruṣoṃkī chā~ṭa alaga kara lī tathā unheṃ jisameṃ ratna piroyā gayā thā aise suvarṇamaya sundara sūtrake cihnase cihnita kara bhavanake bhītara praviṣṭa karā liyā ||109-110|| tṛṣṇāse pīḍa़ita mithyādṛṣṭi loga bhī cintāse vyākula ho dona vacana kahate hue duḥkharūpī sāgarameṃ praviṣṭa hura ||111|| tadanantara-rājā bharatane una śrāvakoṃke lie icchānusāra dāna diyā| bharatake dvārā sammāna pākara unake hṛdayameṃ durbhāvanā utpanna huī aura ve isa prakāra vicāra karane lage ||112|| ki hama loga vāstavameṃ mahāpavitra tathā jagatkā hita karanevāle koī anupama puruṣa haiṃ isīlie to rājādhirāja bharatane baḍa़ī śraddhāke sātha hama logoṃkī pūjā kī hai ||113|| tadanantara ve isī garvase samasta pṛthivītalapara phaila gaye aura kisī dhana-sampanna vyaktiko dekhakara yācanā karane lage ||114|| tatpaścāt kisī dina matisamudra nāmaka mantrīne rājādhirāja bharatase kahā ki āja maiṃne bhagavānke samavasaraṇameṃ nimnāṃkita vacana sunā hai ||115|| vahā~ kahā gayā hai ki bharatane jo ina brāhmaṇoṃkī racanā kī hai so ve varddhamāna tīrthaṃkarake bāda kaliyuga nāmaka paṃcama kāla ānepara pākhaṇḍī evaṃ atyanta uddhata ho jāyeṃge ||116|| dharma buddhise mohita hokara arthāt dharma samajhakara prāṇiyoṃko māreṃge, bahuta bhārī kaṣāyase yukta hoṃge aura pāpa kāryake karane meṃ tatpara hoṃge ||117|| jo hiṃsākā upadeśa dene meṃ tatpara rahegā aise veda nāmaka khoṭe śāstrako kartāse rahita arthāt īśvara praṇīta batalāveṃge aura samasta prajāko mohita karate phireṃge ||118|| baḍa़e-baḍa़e ārambhoṃmeṃ līna raheṃge, dakṣiṇā grahaṇa kareṃge aura jinaśāsanakī sadā nindā kareṃge ||119|| nirgrantha muniko āge dekhakara krodhako prāpta hoṃge aura jisa prakāra viṣavṛkṣake aṃkura jagatke upadrava arthāt apakārake lie haiṃ usī prakāra ye pāpī bhī jagatke upadravake lie hoṃge-jagatmeṃ sadā anartha utpanna karate raheṃge ||120|| matisamudra mantrīke vacana sunakara bharata kupita ho una saba viproṃko māraneke lie udyata huā| tadanantara ve bhayabhīta hokara bhagavān ṛṣabhadevakī śaraṇa meṃ gaye ||121!! bhagavān ṛṣabhadevane 'he putra ! inakā ( mā hananaṃ kārṣīḥ ) hanana mata karo' yaha śabda kahakara inakī rakṣā kī thī isalie ye āge calakara 'māhana' isa prasiddhiko prāpta ho gaye arthāt 'māhana' kahalāne lage ||122|| cūṃki ina śaraṇāgata brāhmaṇoṃkī ṛṣabha jinendrane rakṣā ko thī isalie devoṃ athavā vidvānoṃne bhagavānko 1. nivāritaḥ papapurāṇe ye ca te prathamaṃ bhagnā nṛpā nāthānugāminaḥ | vratāntaramamī cakruḥ svabuddhiparikalpitam ||12|| teṣāṃ śiṣyāḥ praśiṣyāśca mohayantaḥ kuhetumiḥ | jagad garvaparāyattāḥ kuśāstrāṇi pracakrire ||125|| bhṛguraṅgiśirā vahniḥ kapilo'trirvidastathā | anye ca bahavo'jñānājātā valkalatāpasāḥ ||126|| sviyaṃ dṛṣṭvā kucittāste puṃliṅga prāptavikriyam | pidadhurmohasaṃchamāḥ kaupīnena narādhamāḥ ||127|| sūtrakaṇṭhā purā tena ye sṛṣṭāścakravartinā| bījavatprasṛtāste'tra saṃtānena mahītale ||28|| prastāvagatametatte kathitaṃ dvijakalpanam | idānīṃ prakṛtaṃ vakṣye rājan śṛṇu samāhitaḥ ||129|| athāsau lokamuttārya prabhūtaṃ bhavasāgarāt | kailāsaśikhare prāpa nirvṛtiṃ nāminandanaḥ ||130|| tato bharatarājo'pi pravrajyā pratipannavān | sāmrājyaṃ tṛṇavat tyaktvā lokavismayakāraṇam ||131||

vaṃśādhikāramadhunā puruṣarave viddhi sādaraṃ vacmi ||132|| ityāce raviṣeṇācāryaprokta padmacarite ṛṣabhamāhātmyābhidhānaṃ nāma caturtha parva ||4||
trātā arthāt rakṣaka kahakara unakī bahuta bhārī stuti kī thī ||123|| dīkṣāke samaya bhagavān ṛṣabhadevakā anukaraṇa karanevāle jo rājā pahale hī cyuta ho gaye the unhoṃne apanī-apanī buddhike anusāra dūsare-dūsare vrata calāye the ||124|| unhīṃke śiṣya-praśiṣyoṃne ahaṃkārase cūra hokara khoṭīkhoṭī yuktiyoṃse jagatko mohita karate hue aneka khoṭe śāstroṃkī racanā kī ||125|| bhṛgu, aṃgiśirasa, vahni, kapila, atri tathā vida ādi aneka sādhu ajñānavaśa valkaloṃko dhāraṇa karanevāle tāpasī hue ||126|| strīko dekhakara unakā citta dūṣita ho jātā thā aura jananendriyameṃ vikāra dikhane lagatā thā isalie una adhama mohī jīvoṃne jananendriyako laṃgoṭase ācchādita kara liyā ||127|| kaṇṭhameṃ sūtra arthāt yajñopavītako dhāraṇa karanevāle jina brāhmaṇoṃko cakravartī bharatane pahale bījake samāna thoḍa़ī hī racanā kī thī ve aba santatirūpase baḍha़te hue samasta pṛthvī talapara phaila gaye ||128|| gautama gaṇadhara rājā śreṇikase kahate haiṃ ki he rājan ! yaha brāhmaṇoṃkī racanā prakaraṇavaśa maiṃne tujhase kahī hai| aba sāvadhāna hokara prakṛta bāta kahatā hū~ so suna ||129|| bhagavān ṛṣabhadeva saṃsāra-sāgarase aneka prāṇiyoṃkā uddhāra kara kailāsa parvatakī śikharase mokṣako prāpta hue ||130|| tadanantara cakravartī bharata bhī logoṃko āścaryameṃ ḍālanevāle sāmrājyako tṛṇake samāna choḍa़kara dīkṣāko prāpta hue ||131|| he śreṇika ! yaha sthiti nāmakā adhikāra maiṃne saṃkṣepase tujhe kahā hai, he śreṣṭha puruṣa ! aba vaṃśādhikārako kahatā hū~ so ādarase śravaṇa kara ||132||

pañcamaṃ parva
jagatyasmin mahāvaṃśāścatvāraḥ prathitā nṛpa | eṣāṃ rahasyasaṃyuktāḥ prabhedā bahudhoditāḥ ||1|| ikṣvākuḥ prathamasteṣāmunnato lokabhūṣaṇaḥ | ṛṣivaṃśo dvitīyastu śaśāṅkakaranirmalaḥ || 2 || vidyābhṛtāṃ tṛtīyastu vaṃśo'tyantamanoharaḥ | harivaṃśo jagarakhyātaścaturthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 3 || tasyādityayaśāḥ putro bharatasyodapadyata | tataḥ sitayaśā jāto valāṅkastasya cābhavat ||4|| jajñe ca subalastasmāttataścāpi mahābalaḥ | tasmādatibalo jātastataścāmṛtaśabditaḥ ||5|| subhadraḥ sāgaro bhadro ravitejāstathā śaśī | prabhūtatejāstejasvī tapano'tha pratāpavān ||6|| ativīryaḥ suvīryaśca tathoditaparākramaḥ | mahendravikramaḥ sūrya indradyumno mahendrajit ||7|| prabhurvibhuravidhvaṃsī vītabhīrṛṣabhadhvajaḥ | garuḍāko mṛgāṅkaśca tathānye pṛthivībhṛtaḥ ||8|| rājyaṃ suteṣu nikṣipya saṃsārārṇava bhīravaḥ | śarīreṣvapi niḥsaṃgā nirmanthavratamāśritāḥ ||9|| ayamādityavaṃśaste kathitaḥ kramato nṛpe | utpattiḥ somavaṃśasya sāmprataṃ parikīrtyate ||10|| ṛṣabhasyābhavat putro nāmnā bāhubalīti yaḥ | tataḥ somayaśā nāma saumyaḥ sūnurajāyata ||11|| tato mahābalo jātastato'sya subalo'bhavat | smṛto bhujabalī tasyādevamādyā nṛpādhipāḥ || 12 || " śaśivaṃśe samutpannāḥ krameṇa sitaceṣṭitāḥ | śrāmaṇyamanubhūyāśu saṃprāptāḥ paramaṃ padam ||13||
|
athānantara, gautama svāmī rājā śreṇikase kahate haiṃ ki he rājan ! isa saṃsārameṃ cāra mahāvaṃśa prasiddha haiṃ aura ina mahāvaṃśoṃ ke aneka avāntara bheda kahe gaye haiṃ | ye sabhī bheda aneka prakāra ke rahasyoṃse yukta haiṃ || 1 || una cāra mahāvaṃśoṃ meṃ pahalā ikṣvākuvaṃśa hai jo atyanta utkṛṣṭa tathā lokakā ābhūṣaṇasvarūpa hai | dūsarā ṛṣivaṃśa athavā candravaṃśa hai jo candramākī kiraṇoṃke samāna nirmala hai || 2 || tīsarā vidyādharoṃkā vaṃśa hai jo atyanta manohara hai aura cauthā harivaṃśa hai jo saṃsārameṃ prasiddha kahā gayā hai || 3 || ikṣvākuvaṃśameṃ bhagavān ṛṣabhadeva utpanna hue, unake bharata hue aura unake akaṃkīrti mahāpratāpī putra hue| arka nāma sūryakā hai isalie inakā vaṃśa sūryavaṃśa kahalāne lagā | arkakīrtike sitayaśā nāmā putra hue, unake balāṃka, balāṃkake subala, subalake mahābala, mahābalake atibala, atibalake amṛta, amṛtake subhadra, subhadrake sāgara, sāgara ke bhadra, bhadrake raviteja, ravitejake śaśī, śaśīke prabhūtateja, prabhūtatejake tejasvī, tejasvī ke pratāpī tapana, tapanake ativīryaṃ, ativīryaṃke suvārya, suvīryaka uditaparākrama, uditaparākramake mahendravikrama, mahendravikramake sūrya, sūryake indradyumna, indradyumnake mahendrajit, mahendrajit ke prabhu, prabhuke vibhu, vibhu vidhvaṃsa, avidhvaṃsa ke vītabhī, vītabhīke vṛṣabhadhvaja, vṛṣabhadhvajake garuḍāṃka aura garuḍāṃkake mṛgāṃka putra hue| isa prakāra isa vaṃśameṃ anya aneka rājā hue| ye sabhī saṃsārase bhayabhīta the ataḥ putroṃke lie rājya sauṃpakara śarīra se bhī niḥspṛha ho nirgrantha vratako prāpta hue ||4 - 9 || he rājan ! maiṃne kramase tujhe sūryavaṃśakā nirūpaṇa kiyā hai aba somavaṃśa athavā candravaṃśakī utpatti kahī jātī hai ||10||
bhagavān ṛṣabhadevakī dūsarī rānīse bāhubalī nāmakā putra huā thā, usake somayaśa nāmakā sundara putra utpanna huā thā | soma nāma candramākā hai so usī somayaśase somavaṃśa athavā candravaṃśakī paramparā calī hai | somayaśake mahābala, mahābalake subala aura subala ke bhujabala isa 1. nṛpaḥ ma. | 2. śaśivaṃśasamutpannāḥ kha., ma. |

kecittu tanukarmāṇo bhuñjānāstapasaḥ phalam | svarge cakruravasthānamāsannabhavanirgamāḥ || 14|| eṣa te somavaṃśo'pi kathitaḥ pṛthivīpate | vaidyādharamato vaṃśaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ ||15|| namervidyādharendrasya ratnamālī suto'bhavat | ratnavajrastato jātastato ratnaratho'bhavat || 16 || ratnacitro'bhavattasmājjātaścandrarathastataḥ | jajñe'to vajrajaṅghākhyo vajrasenaśrutistataḥ ||17|| udbhūto vajradaṃṣṭo'tastato vajradhvajo'bhavat | vajrāyudhaśca vajraśca suvajro vajrabhṛttathā ||18|| vajrābho vajrabāhuca vajrāṅko vajrasaṃjñakaḥ | vajrāsyo vajrapāṇiśca vajrajātuśca vajravān || 19 || vidyunmukhaḥ suvaktraśca vidyudaṃṣṭraśca tatsutaḥ | vidyudvān vidyudāmaśca vidyudvego'tha vaidyutaḥ ||20|| ityādyā bahavaḥ śūrā vidyādharapurādhipāḥ | gatā dīrgheṇa kālena ceṣṭitocitamāśrayam ||21|| suteṣu prabhutāṃ nyasya jinadīkṣāmupāśritāḥ | hitvā dveṣaṃ ca rāgaṃ ca kecitsiddhimupāgatāḥ ||22|| kecidvināśamaprāpte samaste karmabandhane | saṃkalpakṛtasāṃnidhyaṃ saurabhogamabhuñjata || 23 || kecittu karmapāśena baddhāḥ snehagarīyasā | tatraiva nidhanaṃ yātā vāgurāyāṃ mṛgā iva || 24|| atha vidyuḍho nāmnā prabhuḥ śreṇyordvayorapi | vidyābalasamunnaddho babhūvonnatavikramaḥ ||25|| anyadā sa gato'paśyad videhaṃ gaganasthitaḥ | nirgranthaṃ yogamārūḍhaṃ śailaniścalavigraham ||26|| sthāpitastena nītvāsau nāmnā pañcagirau girau | kurudhvaṃ vadhamasyeti vidyāvantaśca coditāḥ ||27|| prakāra inheṃ ādi lekara aneka rājā isa vaṃśameṃ kramase utpanna hue haiṃ | ye sabhī rājā nirmala ceṣṭāoṃke dhāraka the tathā munipadako dhāraṇa kara hī paramapada ( mokṣa ) ko prāpta hue || 11-13|| kitane hī alpakarma avaśiṣṭa raha jāneke kāraṇa tapakā phala bhogate hue svagaṃmeṃ deva hue tathā vahā~se ākara śīghra hī mokṣa prāpta kareṃge ||14|| he rājan ! yaha maiṃne tujhe somavaṃśa kahā aba āge saṃkṣepase vidyādharoṃke vaṃśakā darṇana karatā hū~ ||15||
vidyādharoṃkā rājā jo nami thā usake ratnamālī nāmakā putra huā | ratnamālīke ratnavajra, ratnavajra ke ratnaratha, ratnarathake ratnacitra, ratnacitra ke candraratha, candrarathake vajrajaṃgha, vajrajaṃghake vajrasena, vajrasenake vajradaṃṣṭa, vajradaṃṣṭra ke vajradhvaja, vajradhvajake vajrāyudha, vajrāyudha ke vajra, vajrake suvajra, suvajrake vajrabhṛt, vajrabhṛt ke vajrābha, vastrābhake vajrabāhu, vajrabāhuke vajrasaṃjña, vajrasaṃjñake vajrāsya, vajrāsyake vajrapāṇi, vajrapāṇike vajrajātu, vajrajātuke vajravān vajravān ke vidyunmukha, vidyunmukhake suvaktra, suvaktra ke vidyudaṃṣṭra, vidyudaṃṣṭrake vidyutvān, vidyutvān ke vidyudābha, vidyudābha vidyudvega aura vidyudvega vaidyuta nāmaka putra hue| ye hī nahīṃ, inheṃ ādi lekara aneka śūravīra vidyāgharoṃke rājā hue| ye sabhī dīrgha kāla taka rājya kara apanī-apanī ceṣṭāoṃke anusāra sthānoṃko prāpta hue ||16 - 21 || inameṃ se kitane hī rājāoṃne putroṃke lie rājya sauṃpakara jinadīkṣā dhāraṇa kī aura rāga-dveṣa choḍa़kara siddhipada prāpta kiyā ||22|| kitane hī rājā samasta karmabandhanako naṣṭa nahīṃ kara sake isalie saṃkalpa mātra se upasthita honevāle devoṃke sukhakā upabhoga karane lage ||23|| kitane hī loga snehake kāraṇa gurutara karmarūpī pāśase ba~dhe rahe aura jālameṃ ba~dhe hariṇoṃke samāna usī karmarūpī pāśameṃ ba~dhe hue mṛtyuko prāpta hue ||24||
athānantara isī vidyādharoṃke vaṃśameṃ eka vidyudṛḍha़ nāmakā rājā huā jo donoṃ śreṇiyoṃkā svāmī thā, vidyābalameṃ atyanta uddhata aura vipula parākramakā dhārī thā || 25 || kisī eka samaya vaha vimāna meṃ baiṭhakara videha kṣetra gayā thā vahā~ usane ākāśase hī nirgrantha mudrāke dhārī saṃjayanta muniko dekhā, usa samaya ve dhyānameṃ ārūḍha़ the aura unakā śarīra parvatake samāna niścala thā ||26|| vidyudṛḍha़ vidyādharane una munirājako lākara paṃcagiri nāmaka parvatapara rakha diyā aura 1. -māśramam ma. | 2. vidyuṣṭro ma. |
