pañcamaṃ parva
tasya loṣṭumiranyaiśca hanyamānasya yoginaḥ | babhūva samacittasya saṃkleśo na manāgapi ||28|| tato'sya sahamānasya saṃjayantasya duḥsaham | upasarga samutpannaṃ kevalaṃ sarvabhāsanam ||29|| dharaṇena tato vidyā hṛtā vidyudṛḍhasthitāḥ | tato'sau hṛtavidyaḥ san yayāvupaśamaṃ param ||30|| tato'nayā punarlabdhā vidyānena vyavasthayā | praṇatenāñjaliṃ kṛtvā saṃjayantasya pādayoḥ ||31|| tapaḥkleśena bhavatāṃ vidyāḥ setsyanti bhūriṇā | siddhā api tathā satyaśchedaṃ yāsyanti duṣkṛtāt ||32|| arhadvimbasanāthasya caityasyopari gacchatām | sādhūnāṃ ca pramāde'pi vidyā naṃkṣyanti vaḥ kṣaṇāt ||33|| dharaṇena tata: pṛṣṭaḥ saṃjayantaḥ kutūhalāt | vidyudṛḍhena bhagavan kasmādevaṃ viceṣṭitam ||34|| uvāca bhagavānevaṃ saṃsāre'smin caturgatau | bhrāmyannahaṃ samutpanno grāme śakaṭanāmani ||35|| vaṇigdhitakaro nāmnā priyavādī dayānvitaḥ | svabhāvārjavasaṃpannaḥ sādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ ||36|| kāladharma tataḥ kṛtvā rājā śrīvarddhanāhvayaḥ | abhavat kumudāvatyāṃ vyavasthāpālanodyataḥ ||37|| grāme tatraiva vipro'bhat sa kṛtvā kutsitaṃ tapaḥ | kudevo'tra tataścyutyā rājñaḥ śrīvarddhanasya tu ||38|| khyāto vahniśikho nāmnā satyavādīti viśrutaḥ | abhūt purohito raudro guptākāryakaro mahān ||39|| vaṇiniyamadattasya saṃ ca dravyamapāta | rāśyā dyūtaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nirjitaḥ so'ṅgulīyakam ||40||
'inakā vadha karo' isa prakāra vidyādharoṃko prerita kiyā ||27|| rājākī preraṇā pākara vidyādharoṃne unheṃ patthara tathā anya sādhanoṃse māranā śurū kiyā parantu ve to sama cittake dhārī the ataḥ unheṃ thoḍa़ā bhī saṃkleśa utpanna nahīṃ huā ||28|| tadanantara duḥsaha upasargako sahana karate hue una saṃjayanta munirājako samasta padārthoṃ ko prakāśita karanevālā kevalajñāna utpanna ho gayā ||29|| usī samaya munirājakā pūrva bhavakā bhāī dharaṇendra āyā| usane vidyudṛḍha़kī saba vidyāe~ hara lī jisase vaha vidyārahita hokara atyanta śānta bhāvako prāpta huā ||30|| vidyāoṃke abhāvameṃ bahuta duḥkhī hokara usane hātha joḍa़kara namra bhāvase dharaṇendrase pūchā ki aba hameṃ kisī taraha vidyāe~ siddha ho sakatī haiṃ yā nahīṃ ? taba dharaṇendrane kahā ki tumheṃ inhīṃ saṃjayanta munirājake caraṇoṃmeṃ tapaśvaraṇa sambandhī kleśa uṭhānese phira bhī vidyāe~ siddha ho sakatī haiṃ parantu khoṭā kārya karanese ve vidyāe~ siddha honepara bhī punaḥ naṣṭa ho jāyeṃgī| jinapratimāse yukta mandira aura muniyoṃkā ullaṃghana kara pramādavaśa yadi ūpara gamana karoge to tumhārī vidyāe~ tatkāla naṣṭa ho jāyeṃgī| dharaṇendrake dvārā batāyī huī vyavasthāke anusāra vidyudṛḍha़ne saṃjayanta munirājake pādamūlameṃ tapaścaraṇa kara phira bhī vidyā prāpta kara lī ||31-33||
yaha saba hone ke bāda dharaṇendrane kutūhalavaśa saṃjayanta munirājase pūchā ki he bhagavan ! vidyudṛḍha़ne āpake prati aisī ceṣṭā kyoṃ kī hai ? vaha kisa kāraṇa āpako hara kara lāyā aura kisa kāraṇa vidyādharoṃse usane upasarga karāyā ? ||34|| dharaṇendrakā praśna sunakara bhagavān saṃjayanta kevalī isa prakāra kahane lage-isa caturgatirūpa saṃsārameṃ bhramaṇa karatā huā maiṃ eka bāra śakaṭa nāmaka gā~vameṃ hitakara nāmaka vaiśya huā thā| maiṃ atyanta madhurabhāṣī, dayālu, svabhāvasambandhī saralatāse yukta tathā sādhuoṃkī sevāmeṃ tatpara rahatā thā ||35-36|| tadanantara maiṃ kumudāvatī nāmakī nagarīmeṃ maryādāke pālana karane meṃ udyata śrīvaddhaṃna nāmakā rājā huā ||37|| usī grāmameṃ eka brāhmaṇa rahatā thā jo khoṭā tapa kara kudeva huā thā aura vahā~se cyuta hokara mujha śrīvarddhana rājākā vahniśikha nāmakā purohita huā thā| vaha purohita yadyapi satyavādī rūpase prasiddha thā parantu atyanta duṣṭapariṇāmī thā aura chipakara khoṭe kārya karatā thā ||38-39|| usa purohitane eka bāra
1. caitasyopari ma. | 2. svaṃ ca kha., svayaṃ ka. | 3. rājñā ma., ka.|

padmapurāṇe tenāmijñānadānena dāsyā gatvā tadālayam | upanītāni ratnāni vaiṇije duḥkhavartine ||4|| tato gṛhītasarvasvaḥ khalīkṛtya dvijādhamaḥ | puro nirvāsito dīnastapaḥ paramamācarat ||42|| mṛtvā kalpaṃ sa māhendra prāptastasmātparicyutaḥ | khecarāṇāmadhīśo'yamadviādṛḍhadhvaniḥ ||3|| śrīvarddhanastapaḥ kṛtvā mṛtvā kalpamupāgataḥ | saṃjayantaśrutirjāto 'videhe'haṃ tataścyutaḥ ||44|| tena doṣānubandhena dṛṣṭvā māṃ krodhamūrcchitaḥ | upasarga vyadhādeṣa karmaṇāṃ vaśatāṃ gataḥ ||45|| yo'sau niyamadatto'bhūt sa kṛtvā tapaso'rjanam | rājā nāgakumārāṇāṃ jātastvaṃ śubhamānasaḥ ||46|| atha vidyu dṛḍhasyābhannāmnā dṛḍharathaḥ sutaḥ | tatra rājyaṃ sa nikṣipya tapaḥ kṛtvā gato divam ||47|| aśvadharmā'bhavattasmādaśvāyurabhavattataḥ | aśvadhvajastato jātastato padmanibho'bhavat ||48|| padmamālī tato bhūto'bhavat pārathastataḥ | siṃhayāno mṛgoddharmā meghāstraḥ siṃhasaprabhuḥ ||19|| siṃhaketuḥ śaśāṅkāsyaścandrāhvaścandraśekharaḥ | indracandrarathābhikhyau cakradharmā tadāyudhaḥ ||50|| cakradhvajo maṇigrīvo maṇyako maṇibhāsuraḥ | maṇisyandanamaṇyāsyau bimboṣṭho lambitādharaḥ ||51|| raktoṣṭho haricandraśca pūścandraḥ pūrṇacandramāḥ| bālenduścandramaścūḍo vyomenduruḍupālanaḥ ||52|| ekacūḍo dvicūḍaśca tricūḍaśca tato'bhavat | vajracūḍastatastasmādbharicūḍārkacūḍakau ||53||
tasmādvahnijaṭī jāto vahnitejāstato'bhavat | bahavaścaivamanye'pi kālena kṣayamāgatāḥ ||54|| niyamadatta nāmaka vaṇikkā dhana chipā liyā taba rānīne usake sātha juā khelakara usakī aṃgūṭhī jīta lī ||40|| rānīkī dāsī aṃgaṭhī lekara pūrohitake ghara gayī aura vahā~ usakī strīko dikhākara usase ratna le āyo| rānīne ve ratna niyamadatta vaṇikko jo ki atyanta duḥkhī thā vāpasa de diye | tadanantara maiṃne usa duṣṭa brāhmaṇakā saba dhana chīna liyā tathā use tiraskṛta kara nagarase bāhara nikāla diyā| usa dīna-hīna brāhmaṇako subuddhi utpanna huī jisase usane utkṛṣṭa tapaścaraṇa kiyā ||41-42|| antameṃ marakara vaha māhendra svargameṃ deva huā aura vahā~se cyuta hokara yaha vidyudṛḍha़ nāmaka vidyādharoṃkā rājā huā hai ||43|| merā jīva śrīvarddhana bhī tapaścaraṇa kara marā aura svargameṃ deva huā| vahā~se cyuta hokara maiṃ videha kṣetrameṃ saṃjayanta huā hūṃ ||44|| usa pūrvokta doṣake saṃskārase ho yaha vidyādhara mujhe dekhakara krodhase ekadama macchita ho gayā aura karmoṃke vaśībhūta hokara usī saṃskārase isane yaha upasagaṃ kiyā hai ||45|| aura jo vaha niyamadatta nāmaka vaṇik thā vaha tapaścaraṇa kara usake phalasvarūpa ujjvala hṛdayakā dhārī tū nāgakumāroṃkā rājā dharaṇendra huā hai ||46||
athānantara-vidyudṛḍha़ke dṛḍha ratha nāmaka putra huā so vidyudṛḍha़ usake lie rājya sauṃpakara tathā tapaścaraṇa kara svagaṃ gayā ||47|| idhara dṛḍharathake aśvadharmā, aśvadharmāke aśvāyu, aśvāyuke aśvadhvaja, aśvadhvajake padmanibha, padmanibhake padmamālī, padmamāloke padmaratha, padmarathake siṃhayāna, siṃhayānake mṛgoddharmā, mṛgoddhaka siṃhasaprabhu, siṃhasaprabhuke siṃhaketu, siṃhaketuke śaśāṃkamukha, śaśāṃkamukhake candra, candrake candraśekhara, candraśekharake indra, indrake candraratha, candrarathake cakradharmā, cakradharmāke cakrāyudha, cakrāyudhake cakradhvaja, cakradhvajake maṇigrīva, maṇigrīvake maṇyaṃka, maṇyaṃkake maṇibhāsura, maṇibhāsurake maṇisyandana, maṇisyandanake maṇyāsya, maṇyāsyake bimboṣṭha, bimboṣṭhake lambitādhara, lambitādharake raktoṣṭha, raktoṣṭhake haricandra, haricandrake pūścandra, pūścandrake pūrṇacandra, pūrṇacandrake bālendu, bālenduke candracūḍa, candracūḍake vyomendu, vyomenduke uḍupālana, uḍupālanake ekacūḍa, ekacūḍake dvicūḍa, dvicūḍake tricūḍa, tricūḍake vanacūḍa, vajracūḍake bhūricūḍa, bhūricūḍake arkacūḍa, akaṃcūḍake vahnijaṭī, vahnijaṭoke vahniteja nāmakā putra huā| isī prakāra aura bhī bahuta-se 1. vāṇije ma., ka. | 2. -mācaran ma. | 3. jātā ma., kha. | 4. padmanabho ma. | 5. mṛgadvarmā ma.| mṛgādharmān kha. | 6. lavitādharaḥ ma., kha. |

pañcamaṃ parva pālayitvā śriyaṃ kecinnyasya putreṣu tāṃ punaḥ | kṛtvā karmakṣayaṃ yātāḥ siddharadhyāsitāṃ mahom ||55|| evaṃ vaidyādharo'yaṃ te rājan vaṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | avatāro dvitīyasya yugasyātaḥ pracakṣyate ||56|| asya nābheyacihnasya yugasya vinivartane | hīnāḥ purātanā māvāḥ praśastā ana bhūtale ||57|| śithilāyitumārabdhā paralokakriyāratiḥ | kāmārthayoḥ samutpannā janasya paramā matiḥ ||5|| athekṣvākukulottheṣu teṣvatīteṣu rājasu | putraḥ śriyāṃ samutpanno dharaṇīdharanāmataḥ ||59|| ayodhyānagare śrīmān prakhyātastridaśaṃjayaḥ | indurekhā priyā tasya jitaśatrastayoḥ sutaḥ ||60|| pure podanasaṃjñe'tha vyānandasya mahīpateḥ | jātāmambhojamālāyāṃ nāmato 'vijayāṃ sutām ||61|| jitaśatroḥ samāyojya pravrajya tridaśaṃjayaḥ | nirvāṇaṃ ca pariprāptaḥ kailāsadharaṇīdhare ||6|| athājitajino jātastayoḥ pūrvavidhānataḥ | amiṣekādidevendraḥ kṛtaṃ nābheyavarṇitam ||63|| tasya pitrā jitāḥ sarve tajanmani yato dviṣaḥ| tato'sāvajitābhikhyāṃ saṃprāpto dharaṇītale||64|| āsan sunayanānandetyādayastasya yoṣitaḥ | yāsāṃ śacyapi rūpeṇa śaktā nānukṛti prati ||65|| anyadā ramyamudyānaṃ gataḥ sāntaḥpuro'jitaḥ | pūrvāhne phullamaikṣiṣṭaṃ paṅkajānāṃ vanaṃ mahat ||66|| tadeva saṃkucadvīkṣya bhāskare'staṃ yiyāsati | anityatāṃ śriyo gatvā nivedaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||67|| tataḥ pitaramāpṛcchaya mātaraṃ ca sa bāndhavān | nāthaḥ pūrvavidhānena pravrajyāṃ pratipannavān ||18||
putra hue jo kālakramase mṛtyuko prāpta hote gaye ||48-54|| inameṃ se kitane hī vidyādhara rājā lakṣmīkā pālana kara tathā antameṃ putroṃko rājya sauṃpakara karmoṃkā kṣaya karate hue siddhabhūmiko prāpta hue ||55|| gautamasvāmī kahate haiṃ ki he rājan ! isa prakāra yaha vidyādharoṃkā vaṃśa kahā| aba dvitīya yugakā avatāra kahā jātā hai so suna ||56||
bhagavān ṛṣabhadevakā yuga samāpta honepara isa pṛthivīpara jo prācīna uttama bhāva the ve hīna ho gaye, logoṃkī paraloka sambandhī kriyāoṃmeṃ prīti śithila hone lagī tathā kāma aura artha puruṣārthameṃ hī unakī pravara buddhi pravṛtta hone lagī ||57-58|| athānantara ikṣvāku vaṃśameṃ utpanna hue rājā jaba kālakramase atīta ho gaye taba ayodhyā nagarīmeṃ eka dharaṇīdhara nāmaka rājā utpanna hue| unakī śrīdevī nāmaka rānīse prasiddha lakṣmīkā dhāraka tridaśaṃjaya nāmakā putra huā| isakī strīkā nāma indurekhā thā, una donoṃke jitaśatru nāmakā putra huā ||59-60|| podanapura nagarameṃ vyānanda nāmaka rājā rahate the, unakī ambhojamālā nāmaka rānīse vijayā nāmakī putrī utpanna huī thī| rājā tridaśaṃjayane jitaśatrukā vivāha vijayāke sātha karākara dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī aura tapaścaraṇa kara kailāsa parvatase mokṣa prāpta kiyā ||61-62|| athānantara rājā jitaśatru
ra rānī vijayāke ajitanātha bhagavānakā janma huā| indrādika devoṃne bhagavāna ṛṣabhadevakā jaisā abhiṣeka ādi kiyā thā vaisā hī bhagavān ṛṣabhadevakā kiyā ||63|| cū~ki unakā janma hote hī pitāne samasta śatru jīta liye the isalie pṛthivītalapara unakā 'ajita' nāma prasiddha huā ||64|| bhagavān ajitanāthakī sunayanā, nandā ādi aneka rāniyā~ thīṃ| ve saba rāniyā~ itanī sundara thīṃ ki indrāṇī bhī apane rūpase unakī samānatā nahīṃ kara sakatī thī ||65||
athānantara-bhagavān ajitanātha eka dina apane antaḥpurake sātha sundara upavanameṃ gaye | vahāṃ unhoṃne prātaḥkālake samaya phūlā huā kamaloṃkā eka viśāla vana dekhā || 66 || usī vanako unhoṃne jaba sūrya asta honeko huā taba saṃkucita hotā dekhā| isa ghaṭanāse ve lakṣmīko anitya mānakara parama vairāgyako prāpta ho gaye || 67 || tadanantara-pitā, mātā aura bhāiyoṃse pūchakara

padmapurāṇe kṣatriyāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi daśānena samaṃ tataḥ | niṣkrāntāni parityajya rājyabandhuparigraham ||69|| ṣaṣṭopavāsayuktāya tasmai nāthāya 'pāraṇām | brahmadatto dadau maktyā sāketanagarodbhavaḥ ||70|| caturdaśasvatīteṣu varṣeṣvasya tato'bhavat | kevalajñānamārhantyaṃ tathā viśvasya pūjitam ||7|| tataścātiśayāstasya catustriṃśatsamutthitāḥ | aṣṭau ca prātihāryāṇi draṣṭavyānīha pūrvavat ||72|| navatistasya saṃjātā gaṇeśāḥ pādasaṃśritāḥ | sādhūnāṃ coditaṃ lakṣa divākarasamatviṣām ||73|| kanīyān jitaśatrostu khyāto vijayasāgaraḥ | patnī sumaṅgalā tasya tatsutaḥ sagaro'bhavat ||74|| babhūvāsau śubhākāro dvitīyaścakravartinām | nidhānanavamiḥ khyāti yo gato vasudhātale ||75|| asmin yadantare vṛtta śreṇikedaṃ niśamyatām | astīha cakravālākhyaṃ puraṃ dakṣiṇagocaram ||76|| tatra pūrṇaghano nāma vibhuyomavihāriṇām | mahāpramāvasaṃpanno vidyābalasamunnataḥ ||77|| vihāyastilakeśaṃ sa yayāce varakanyakām | naimittikājñayā dattā sagarāya tu tena sā ||78|| yuddhaṃ sulocanasyograṃ yāvatpūrṇadhanasya ca | gṛhītvā bhaginoṃ tāvatsahasranayano'gamat ||79|| nipūdya ca sunetraṃ sa puraṃ pūrṇaghano'viśat | adṛṣṭvā ca sa tāṃ kanyāṃ svapuraṃ punarāgataḥ ||8|| tataḥ pitṛvadhāt kraddhaḥ sahasranayano'balaḥ | araṇye śaramākrānte sthitaśchidrekṣaṇāvṛteḥ ||8|| tataścakradharo'śvena hṛtastaṃ deśamāgataḥ | diṣṭyā cotpalamatyāsau dṛṣṭvā bhrātre niveditaḥ ||82||
tuṣṭena tena sā tasmai dattā sagaracakriṇe | cakriṇāpyayamānīto vidyādharamahīśatām ||83|| unhoṃne pūrva vidhike anusāra dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī ||68|| inake sātha anya dasa hajāra kṣatriyoṃne bhī rājya, bhāī-bandhu tathā saba parigrahakā tyāga kara dīkṣā dhāraṇa kī thī || 69 || bhagavānne telākā upavāsa dhāraṇa kiyā thā so tīna dina bāda ayodhyā nivāsī brahmadatta rājāne unheṃ bhaktipūrvaka pāraṇā karāyī thī-āhāra diyā thā||70|| caudaha varṣa honepara unheṃ kevalajñāna tathā samasta saṃsārake dvārā pūjanīya arhantapada prāpta huā || 71 || jisa prakāra bhagavān ṛṣabhadevake cauṃtīsa atiśaya aura āṭha prātihārya prakaṭa hue the usī prakāra inake bhī prakaṭa hue | 72 || inake pādamalameṃ rahanevāle nabbe gaṇadhara the tathā sūryake samāna kāntiko dhāraṇa karanevāle eka lākha sādha the || 73 || jitaśatruke choṭe bhāī vijayasāgara the, unakī strīkā nāma sumaṃgalā thā, so una donoṃke sagara nāmakā putra utpanna huā |74|| yaha sagara śubha ākārakā dhāraka dūsarā cakravartī huā aura pṛthvītalapara nau nidhiyoṃke kāraṇa parama prasiddhiko prāpta huā thā | 75 || he śreṇika ! isake samaya jo vṛttānta huā use tū suna | bharatakṣetrake vijayācaṃkī dakṣiṇa śreṇī meṃ eka cakravāla nāmakā nagara hai ||76|| usameṃ pūrṇadhana nāmakā vidyādharoṃkā rājā rājya karatā thā| vaha mahāprabhāvase yukta tathā vidyāoṃke balase unnata thā| usane vihāyastilaka nagarake rājā sulocanase usakī kanyākī yācanā kī para sulocanane apanī kanyā pūrṇaghanako na dekara nimittajñānīkī ājñānusāra sagara cakravartīke lie dī ||77-78|| idhara rājā sulocana aura pūrṇadhanake bīca jabataka bhayaṃkara yuddha hotā hai tabataka sulocanakā pūtra sahasranayana apanī bahanako lekara anyatra calā gayā ||79|| pūrṇadhanane sulocanako mārakara nagarameṃ praveśa kiyā parantu jaba kanyā nahīṃ dekhī to apane nagarako vāpasa lauṭa āyā ||8|| tadanantara pitākā vadha sunakara sahasranayana pūrṇameghapara bahuta hī kupita huā parantu nirbala honese kucha kara nahīṃ sakā| vaha aṣṭāpada ādi hiṃsaka jantuoṃse bhare vana meṃ rahatā thā aura sadā pūrṇameghake chidra dekhatā rahatā thā || 81 || tadanantara eka māyāmayī aśva sagara cakravartīko hara le gayā so vaha usī vanameṃ āyā jisameṃ ki sahasranayana rahatā thā| saubhāgyase sahasranayanakī bahana utpalamatīne cakravartīko dekhakara bhāīse yaha samācāra kahā || 82 || sahasranayana yaha samācāra sunakara bahuta hī santuṣṭa huā aura usane utpalamatī, 1. pāraṇam ma.,kha.| 2. vṛte ka., dṛtaḥ ma. |

pakrama parva
strīratna tadasau labdhvā paraṃ toṣamupāgataḥ | ṣaṭkhaṇḍādhipatiḥ sarvaiḥ pārthivaiḥ kṛtaśāsanaḥ ||8|| prāptavidyābhṛdaiśyena puraṃ paurṇadhanaṃ tataḥ | ruddhaṃ sahasranetreṇa prākāreṇeva sarvataḥ ||45|| tato mahati saṃgrāme pravṛtte janasaṃkṣaye | nītaḥ sahasranetreṇa pūrṇameghaḥ parāsutām ||86|| putraḥ pūrṇaghanasyātha nāmnā toyadavāhanaḥ | parairudvāsitaścakravālād bhrāmyan namo'ṅgaṇe ||7|| khecarairbahubhiḥ kruddharanuyātaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ | ajitaṃ śaraṇaṃ yātastrailokyasukhakāraṇam ||48|| tato vajradhareṇāsau praṣṭasvāsasya kāraṇam | abravīt sagaraṃ prāpya mama bandhukṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ ||89|| asmatpitrorabhūd vairaṃ naikajīvavināśanam | tenānubandhadoṣeṇa nitāntakaracetasā ||10|| sahasranayanenāhaṃ vāsitaḥ śatruṇā bhṛśam | haṃsaiḥ samaṃ samutpatya prāsādādāgato drutam ||11|| tato jinasamīpe taṃ gṛhītumasahaina paiḥ| nivedite sahasrākṣaḥ saṃpratasthe svayaṃ ruṣā ||12|| ko'paro'sti madudvīryo yenāsau parirakṣyate | iti saṃcintayan prāpto jinasya dharaṇīmasau ||13|| prabhāmaṇḍalamevāsau dṛṣṭvā dūre jinodbhavam | sarva gavaṃ parityajya praṇanāmājitaṃ vibhum ||14|| jinapādasamīpe to muktavairau tataḥ sthitau | tatpitroścaritaṃ pṛṣṭo gaṇinā ca jinādhipaḥ ||15||
idaṃ provāca bhagavān jambūdvīpasya mārate | pure sadṛtusaṃjñāke bhāvano nāma vāṇijaḥ ||16|| sagara cakravartī ke lie pradāna kara dī| cakravartīne bhī pūrṇadhanako vidyādharoṃkā rājā banā diyā||83|| jo chaha khaṇḍakā adhipati thā tathā samasta rājā jisakā śāsana mānate the aisā cakravartī sagara usa strīko pākara bahuta bhārī santoṣako prāpta huā ||84|| vidyādharoṃkā ādhipatya pākara sahasranayanane pūrṇaghanake nagarako cāroṃ orase koṭake samāna ghera liyā ||85|| tadanantara donoṃke bīca manuṣyoṃkā saṃhāra karanevālā bahuta bhārī yuddha huā jisameṃ sahasranayanane pūrṇameghako māra ḍālā ||8|| tadanantara pūrṇaghanake pūtra meghavāhanako śatruoṃne cakravāla nagarase nirvāsita kara diyā so vaha ākāśarūpī āṃganameṃ bhramaṇa karane lagā ||87|| use dekhakara bahuta-se kupita vidyādharoṃne usakā pīchā kiyā so vaha atyanta duḥkhī hokara tīna lokake jīvoṃko sukha utpanna karanevāle bhagavān ajitanāthakī śaraṇameṃ pahuṃcā ||88|| vahāṃ indrane usase bhayakā kāraṇa pūchā| taba meghavāhanane kahā ki hamāre pitā pūrṇadhana aura sahasranayanake pitā sulocanameṃ aneka jīvoṃkā vināśa karanevālā vaira-bhāva calā ā rahā thā so usī saṃskārake doṣase atyanta krūracittake dhāraka sahasranayanane sagara cakravartīkā bala pākara mere bandhujanoṃkā kṣaya kiyā hai| isa śatrune mujhe bhī bahuta
trāsa pahu~cāyā hai so maiṃ mahalase haṃsoṃke sātha uḍakara śīghra hī yahā~ āyā haiṃ||89-91|| tadanantara jo rājā meghavāhanakā pīchā kara rahe the unhoṃne sahasranayanase kahā ki vaha isa samaya bhagavān ajitanāthake samīpa hai ataḥ hama use pakaḍa़ nahīṃ sakate| yaha sunakara sahasranayana roṣavaśa svayaṃ hī calā aura mana hī mana socane lagā ki dekheṃ mujhase adhika balavān dūsarā kauna hai jo isakī rakṣā kara sake| aisā socatā huā vaha bhagavānke samavasaraṇameṃ āyā ||92-93|| sahasranayanane jyoṃ hī dūrase bhagavānkā prabhāmaṇḍala dekhā tyoṃ hī usakā samasta ahaṃkāra cūra-cūra ho gayā| usane bhagavān ajitanāthako praṇāma kiyā| sahasranayana aura meghavāhana donoṃ hī parasparakā vairabhāva choḍa़kara bhagavānke caraṇoṃke samīpa jā baiṭhe| tadanantara gaṇadharane bhagavānase una donoṃke pitākā caritra pūchā so bhagavān nimna prakāra kahane lage ||94-95||
jambūdvīpake bharata kṣetrameṃ sadṛtu nāmakā nagara thā| usameṃ bhāvana nāmakā eka vaṇik rahatā thā| usakī ātakī nāmaka strī aura haridāsa nāmaka putra thā| vaha bhāvana yadyapi cāra karoḍa़
bhārī trāsa
1. meghavāhanaḥ | 2. saduḥkhitaḥ ma.| 3. vāsaka ma.| 4. bandhuḥ kṣayaṃ kṛtaḥ ma.| 5. kopare'sti ma. |

padmapurāṇe
bhākītyaṅganā tasya haridāsaśca tatsutaḥ | catuḥ koṭīśvaro bhūtvā yātrodyuktaḥ sa bhāvanaḥ || 97 || putrāya sakalaṃ dravyaṃ nyāsatvena samarpayan | dyūtādivarjanārthaṃ ca śikṣāmasmai dadau param ||98|| sahetusarvadoṣebhya upadiśya nivartanam | putrāya vāṇijo yātaḥ potena dhanatṛṣṇayā ||99|| upacāreṇa veśyāyāmāsaktyā dyūtamaṇḍale | surāyāmabhimānena catuḥ kokyo'pi nāśitāḥ || 100 || yadāsau nirjito ca te tadā rājño gṛhaṃ gataḥ | haridāso durācāro draviṇārthaṃ suraṅgayā || 101 || ānīyāsau tato dravyaṃ kriyāḥ sarvāścakāra saḥ | sa bhāvano'nyadā gehabhāyāto nekṣate sutama || 102 || haridāso gataḥ kveti tena pṛṣṭā kuṭumbinī | sāvocadanayā yātaścauryāthaṃ ca suraṅganyā ||103|| tato'sau tasya maraṇaṃ śaṅkamānaḥ suraṅgayā | prasthitaścauryaśāntyarthaṃ gṛhābhyantaradattayā || 104 || āgacchatā ca putreṇa ko'pi vairī mametyasau | maṇḍalāgreṇa pāpena varāko vinipātitaḥ || 105 || vijñāto'sau tatastena nakhaśmaśrusaṭādibhiḥ | spṛṣṭvā mama pitetyeṣa prāpto duḥkhaṃ ca duḥsaham ||106|| janakasya tato mṛtyuṃ kṛtvāsau bhayavidrutaḥ | paryaṭan duḥkhato deśān yātaḥ kālena pañcatām ||107|| atment śṛgālau ca vṛṣadaṃśau vṛṣau tathā | nakulau mahiṣāvetau jātau ca vṛṣabhau punaḥ || 108 || anyo'nyasya tato ghātaṃ kṛtvā tau bhavasaṃkaṭe | videhe puṣkalāvasyāṃ manuṣyatvamupāgatau ||109|| ugraṃ kṛtvā tapastasminnuttarānuttarāhvayau | gatvā satāramāyātau janakau bhavatorimau ||110|| aisi bhāvananāmāsījāto'sau pūrṇatoyadaḥ | āsīttasya tu yaḥ putraḥ saṃjātaḥ sa sulocanaḥ || 111 ||
dravyakā svāmī thā to bhī dhana kamānekī icchāse deśāntarakī yātrāke lie udyata huā ||96-97|| usane apanā saba dhana dharoharake rūpameṃ putrake lie sauṃpate hue, juā ādi vyasanoṃke choḍa़ne kī utkṛṣṭa śikṣā dī | usane kahā ki 'he putra ! ye juā ādi vyasana samasta doṣoṃke kāraṇa haiṃ isalie inase dūra rahanā hī śreyaskara hai' aisā upadeśa dekara vaha bhāvana nāmakā vaṇik dhanakī tṛṣṇāse jahāja meṃ baiṭhakara deśāntarako calā gayā || 98-99 || pitāke cale jānepara haridāsane veśyāsevana, juākī āsakti tathā madirāke ahaṃkāravaśa cāroṃ karoḍa़ dravya naṣṭa kara diyā || 100 || isa prakāra jaba vaha juāmeṃ saba kucha hāra gayā aura anya juvāḍa़iyoṃkā denadāra ho gayā taba vaha durācārī dhanake lie suraṃga lagākara rājāke gharameṃ ghusā tathā vahā~se dhana lākara apane saba vyasanoṃkī pūrti karane lagā | athānantara kucha samaya bāda jaba usakā pitā bhāvanā deśāntarase ghara lauṭā taba usane putrako nahīṃ dekhakara apanī strīse pūchā ki haridāsa kahā~ gayā hai ? strīne uttara diyā ki vaha isa suraṃgase corī karaneke lie gayā hai || 101 - 103 || tadanantara bhāvanako śaṃkā huī ki kahīṃ isa kāryameṃ isakā maraṇa na ho jāve isa śaṃkāse vaha corī chuḍa़āneke lie gharake bhītara dī huī suraṃgase calā || 104 || udharase usakā putra haridāsa vāpasa lauṭa rahā thā, so usane samajhā ki yaha koī merā vairī ā rahā hai aisā samajhakara usa pāpīne becāre bhāvanako talavārase māra ḍālā ||105 || pīche jaba nakha, dāḍha़ī, mū~cha tathā jaṭā ādike sparśase use vidita huā ki are ! yaha to merā pitā hai, taba vaha duḥsaha duḥkhako prāpta huā || 106 || pitākī hatyā kara vaha bhayase bhāgā aura aneka deśoṃmeṃ duḥkhapūrvaka bhramaṇa karatā huā marā || 107|| pitā-putra donoṃ śvāna hue, phira śṛgāla hue, phira mārjāra hue, phira baila hue, phira nevalā hue, phira bhaiṃsā hue aura phira baila hue| ye donoṃ hī parasparameṃ eka dūsarekā ghāta kara mare aura saṃsārarūpī vanameṃ bhaṭakate rahe | antameṃ videha kṣetrakī puṣkalāvatī nagarīmeṃ manuṣya hue || 108 - 109 || phira ugra tapaścaraṇa kara śatāra nāmaka gyārahaveṃ svargaṃmeṃ uttara aura anuttara nāmaka deva hue| vahā~se ākara jo bhāvana nāmakā pitā thā vaha pūrṇamegha vidyādhara huā aura jo usakā putra thā vaha sulocana 1. so'bhayavidrutaḥ |

pañcamaṃ parva
pitrorevaṃ parijñāya mayaduḥkhavivartanam | bhejataṃ mamamujitvā vairaṃ saṃsārakāraṇam ||112|| cakravartī tato'pṛcchadetayoḥ pūrvajanmani | bairakāraṇamevaṃ ca māṣitaṃ dharmacakriṇā ||13|| jambūdvīpasya bharate pure padmakanāmani | sāṃkhyiko rambhanāmāsīd viṣaye prathito dhanī ||114|| śaśyāvalisamāhvānau tasya maitrīsamanvitau | śiṣyāvatyantavikhyātau dhanavantau guṇotkaṭau ||115|| mā bhūdābhyāṃ mamodvartaḥ saṃhatābhyāmiti drutam | tayoḥ se bhedamakaronayaśāstravicakṣaṇaḥ ||116|| gopālakena saṃmanya śaśī mūlyārthamanyadā | cikrīṣugāṃ gṛhaṃ yāvadāyāto nijalīlayā ||117|| krītvā devaniyogāttāmāgacchannāvalī puram | gacchatā śaśinā krodhānnihato mlecchatāmitaḥ ||118|| mṛtaḥ śaśī balīva> jāto mlecchena tena ca | hatvā vairānubandhena bhakṣyatāmupapāditaḥ ||119|| tiryagnārakapānthaḥ sanmleccho mūṣakatāṃ gataḥ| abhūcchaśyapi mārjārastena hatvā sa makṣitaḥ ||12|| pāpakarmaniyogena prāptī narakabhūmiṣu | prāpyate sumahad duḥkhaṃ jantumirbhavasāgare ||12|| bhūyaḥ saṃsṛtya kāśyāṃ tau dāsau jātau sahodarau | dāsyāḥ saṃbhramadevasya kūṭakārpaṭikāyau ||122|| jinaveśmani tau tena niyuktau pretya puṇyataḥ | rūpānandaḥ surūpaśca jātau bhūtagaṇādhipau ||123||
śaśipūrvo rajovalyāṃ cyutvā'bhūt kulaputrakaḥ | kulaṃdharo'paraḥ puṣpabhūtiḥ putraḥ purodhasaḥ ||124|| nāmakā vidyādhara huā| isī vairake kāraṇa pūrṇameghane sulocanako mārā hai ||110-111|| gaṇadhara devane sahasranayana aura meghavāhanako samajhāyā ki tuma donoṃ isa taraha apane pitāoṃke sāṃsārika duḥkhamaya paribhramaṇako jānakara saṃsārakā kāraṇabhūta vairabhāva choḍa़kara sāmyabhāvakā sevana karo ||112|| tadanantara sagara cakravartīne pūchā ki he bhagavan ! meghavāhana aura sahasranayanakā pūrva janmameṃ vaira kyoṃ huā? taba dharmacakrake adhipati bhagavānne unake vairakā kāraṇa nimna prakāra samajhāyā ||113| unhoṃne kahā ki jambūdvīpake bharata kṣetra sambandhī padmaka nāmaka nagarameṃ gaṇita śāstrakā pāṭhī mahādhanavān rambha nāmakā eka prasiddha puruṣa rahatā thā ||114|| usake do śiṣya the-eka candra aura dūsarā āvali| ye donoṃ hī paraspara maitrī bhāvase sahita the| atyanta prasiddha dhanavān aura guṇoṃse yukta the ||115|| nītiśāstrameṃ nipuṇa rambhane yaha vicārakara ki yadi ye donoṃ parasparameṃ mile raheṃge to hamārā pada bhaṃga kara deṃge, donoṃmeṃ phūṭa ḍāla dī ||116|| eka dina candra gāya kharīdanā cāhatā thā so gopālake sātha salāha kara mūlya lene ke lie vaha sahaja hī apane ghara āyā thā ki bhāgyavaśa āvali usī gāyako kharīdakara apane gāṃvakī ora ā rahā thā| bīcameṃ candrane krodhavaśa use māra ḍālā| āvali marakara mleccha huā ||117-118|| aura candra marakara baila huā so mlecchane pūrva vairake kāraṇa use mārakara khā liyā ||119|| mleccha tithaṃca tathā naraka yonimeṃ bhramaṇa kara cūhā huā aura candrakā jīva baila marakara bilāva huā so bilāvane caheko mārakara bhakṣaṇa kiyā ||120|| pāpa karmake kāraṇa donoṃ hī marakara narakameṃ utpanna hue so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki prāṇī saṃsārarūpī sāgarameṃ bahuta bhārī duḥkha pāte hī haiṃ ||121|| narakase nikalakara donoṃ hī banārasameṃ saṃbhramadevakī dāsīke kūṭa aura kāpaṃṭika nāmake putra hue| ye donoṃ hī bhāī dāsa the-dāsavṛttikā kāma karate the so saṃbhramadevane unheṃ jinamandira meṃ niyukta kara diyā | antameṃ marakara donoṃ hī puṇyake prabhāvase rūpānanda aura surūpa nāmaka vyantara deva hue ||122-123|| rūpānanda candrakā jīva thā aura surūpa āvalikā jīva thā so rūpānanda caya kara rajovalī nagarīmeṃ kulandhara nāmakā kulaputraka huā aura surūpa, purohitakā putra puṣpabhūti huā|124|| 1. bhajataḥ ma.| 2. saṃbheda ma.| 3. purā kha.| 4. rūpānandasurūpaśca sa.| 5. rajovālyām ma. | 6. putrapurodhasaḥ ka.|

mitrau tau sairikasyārthe prāptau vairaṃ tataḥ sthitam | puṣpabhūrti tato hantuṃ prāvartata kulaṃdharaḥ || 125|| vṛkṣamūlasthasādhośca dharmaṃ śrutvā praśāntavān | rājñā parīkṣitaścābhūt sāmantaḥ puṇyayogataḥ || 126 || puṣpabhūtirimaṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmād vibhavamāgatam | jaino bhūtvā mṛto jātastṛtīye suraviṣṭape ||127|| kuladharo'pi tatraiva cyutau tau mandarāvare | videhe dhātakīkhaṇḍe jayavasyāmajiye || 128 || sahasraśiraso bhṛtyo krūrāmaradhanaśrutī | jātāvasyantavikrāntāvantaraṅgau suviśrutau || 129 || anyadeśaḥ samaṃ tābhyāṃ badhuṃ prātiṣṭhata dvipam | prītimaikṣiṣṭa sattvānāṃ janmanaiva virodhinām ||130|| śamino mī kathaṃ vyālā iti vismayamāgataḥ | aviśat sa mahāraṇyamapaśyacca mahāmunim || 131 || tato rājā samaṃ tābhyāṃ tasya kevalino'ntike | pravrajya nirvṛtiṃ prāpacchatāraṃ tu gatāvimau ||132|| śaśipūrvastataścyutvā jāto'yaṃ meghavāhanaḥ | āvalī tu sahasrākṣo vairaṃ tenānayoridam ||133|| prītirmamādhikā kasmāt sahasranayane vibho | iti pṛṣṭo jino'vocat sagareṇa tataḥ punaḥ || 134|| bhikṣādānena sādhūnāṃ rambho'marakuruṃ gataḥ | saudharmaṃ ca tataścyutvā jātaścandrapure hareḥ || 135 || narendrasya dharādevyāṃ dayitavratakīrtanaḥ | śrāmaṇyānnākamāruhya videhe tvavare cyutaḥ ||136|| mahāghoṣeṇa candriṇyāmutpanno ratnasaṃcaye | payobalo munībhūya prāṇataṃ kalpamāśritaḥ || 137 ||
yadyapi kulandhara aura puṣpabhūti donoṃ hī mitra the tathāpi eka halavāhaka ke nimittase una donoṃmeṃ śatrutā ho gayī | phalasvarūpa kulandhara puṣpabhūtiko māraneke lie pravṛtta huā || 125 || mārga meṃ use eka vṛkṣa ke nīce virājamāna munirāja mile so unase dharmaṃ śravaṇa kara vaha śānta ho gayā | rājāne usakī parīkṣā lī aura puṇyake prabhāva se use maṇḍaleśvara banā diyā || 126|| puṣpabhūtine dekhā ki dharmaṃ prabhāvase hī kulandhara vaibhavako prāpta huā hai isalie vaha bhī jainī ho gayā aura marakara tīsare svargameṃ deva huā || 127|| kulandhara bhī usī tīsare svargameṃ deva huā| donoṃ hī cyuta hokara dhātakī khaṇḍa dvīpa ke paścima videha kṣetra meṃ arijaya pitā aura jayavatī mātāke putra hue | ekakā nāma krūrāmara, dūsarekā nāma dhanaśruti thā | ye donoṃ bhāī atyanta śūravīra evaṃ sahasraśīrṣaṃ rājā ke viśvāsapātra prasiddha sevaka hue || 128 - 129 || kisī eka dina rājā sahasraśīrṣa ina donoṃ sevakoṃ ke sātha hāthī pakaḍa़neke lie vanameṃ gayā | vahā~ usane janmase hī virodha rakhanevāle siṃhamṛgādi jīvoṃko paraspara prema karate hue dekhā || 130 || 'ye hiṃsaka prāṇī śānta kyoṃ haiṃ ?' isa prakāra āścaryako prāpta hue rājā sahasraśīrṣane jyoṃ hī mahāvanameṃ praveśa kiyā tyoṃ hī usakī dṛṣṭi mahāmuni kevalī bhagavān‌ke ūpara paḍa़ī || 131 || tadanantara rājā sahasraśīrṣane donoṃ sevakoṃ ke sātha kevalī bhagavān ke pāsa dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī | phalasvarūpa rājā to mokṣako prāpta huā aura krūrāmara tathā dhanaśruti śatāra svargaṃ gaye || 132 || inameṃ candrakā jīva krūrāmara to svargase cayakara meghavāhana huā hai aura āvalikā jīva dhanaśruti sahasranayana huā hai| isa prakāra pūrvabhavake kāraṇa ina donoṃmeṃ vairabhāva hai ||133||
tadanantara sagara cakravartīne bhagavān se pūchā ki he prabho ! sahasranayanameṃ merī adhika prīti hai so isakā kyā kāraṇa hai ? uttara meṃ bhagavānne kahā ki jo rambha nāmā gaṇita śāstrakā pāṭhī thā vaha muniyoṃko āhāradāna deneke kāraṇa devakulameṃ ārya huā, phira saudharma svarga gayā, vahā~se cyuta hokara candrapura nagarameṃ rājā hari aura dharā nāmakī rānīke vratakīrtana nāmakā pyārā putra huā| vaha munipada dhāraṇa kara svarga gayā, vahā~se cyuta hokara paścima videha kṣetrake ratnasaṃcaya nagara meṃ rājā mahāghoṣa aura candriṇī nāmakī rānīke payobala nāmakā putra huā| vaha muni

pracyutya bharate jāto nagare pṛthivīpure | yaśodharanarendreṇa jayāyāṃ jayakīrtanaḥ || 138 || pravrajya ca pituḥ pārśve mṛtvā vijayamāśritaḥ | cyutvā tato bhavān jātaḥ sagaraścakralānchanaḥ || 139|| rambhasya bhavato yasmādāvalī dayito'bhavat | tatpūrvo'yaṃ priyo'dyāpi sahasrākṣastatastava || 140|| avagamya jinendrasyādātmapitrorbhavāntaram | utpanno dharmasaṃvegastayoratyantamunnataḥ || 141 || mahato dharmasaṃvegājjātau jātismṛtau tataḥ | śraddhāvantau samārabdhau stotuṃ tāvajitaṃ jinam ||142|| vāliśānāmanāthānāṃ sattvānāṃ kāraṇād vinā | upakāraṃ karoṣi tvamāścarya kimataḥ param || 143 || upamāmuktarūpasya vīryeṇāpramitasya te | nirīkṣaṇena kastṛpto vidyate'smin jagattraye ||144|| labdhārthaḥ kṛtakṛtyo'pi sarvadarśī sukhātmakaḥ | acintyo jñātavijñeyastathāpi jagate hitaḥ || 145 || "sāradharmopadeśākhyaṃ jīvānāṃ tvaṃ jinottama | patatāṃ bhavapātāle hastālambaṃ prayacchasi ||146|| iti tau gadgadālāpa vāṣpavipluta locanau | paramaṃ harṣamāyātau praṇamya vidhivasthitau || 147|| śakrādyā devavṛṣabhāḥ sagarādyā nṛpādhipāḥ | sādhavaḥ siṃhavīryādyā yayuḥ paramamadbhutam || 148|| sadasyatha jinendrasya rakṣasāmadhipāvidam | ūcaturvacanaṃ bhīmasubhīmāviti viśrutau || 149 || khecarārbhaka dhanyo'si yastvaṃ śaraṇamāgataḥ | sarvajñamajitaṃ nāthaṃ tuṣṭāvāvāmatastava || 150 || śṛṇu saṃprati te svāsthyaṃ yathā bhavati sarvataḥ | taṃ prakāraṃ pravakṣyāvaḥ pālanīyastvamāvayoḥ || 151 ||
hokara prāṇata nāmaka caudahaveṃ svargameṃ deva huā || 134 - 137|| vahā~se cyuta hokara bharata kṣetrake pṛthivīpura nagara meṃ rājā yaśodhara aura jayā nāmakī rānīke jayakīrtana nāmakā putra huā || 138 || vaha pitā ke nikaṭa jinadīkṣā le vijaya vimānameṃ utpanna huā aura vahā~se caya kara tū sagara cakravartī huā hai ||139||| jaba tū rambha thā taba āvalike sātha terā bahuta sneha thā | aba āvali hī sahasranayana huā hai | isalie pūrvasaṃskāra ke kāraṇa aba bhī terā usake sātha gāḍha़ sneha hai ||140|| isa prakāra jinendra bhagavān ke mukhase apane tathā pitāke bhavāntara jānakara meghavāhana aura sahasrākṣa donoṃ ko dharma meṃ bahuta bhārī ruci utpanna huī || 141 || usa dhārmika rucike kāraṇa donoṃko jātismaraṇa bhī ho gayā | tadanantara śraddhāse bhare meghavāhana aura sahasranayana ajitanātha bhagavānkī isa prakāra stuti karane lage || 142 || he bhagavan ! jo buddhise rahita haiṃ tathā jinakā koī nātharakṣaka nahīṃ hai aise saṃsārī prāṇiyoṃkā āpa binā kāraṇa hī upakāra karate haiṃ isase adhika āścaryaṃ aura kyā ho sakatā hai || 143 || āpakā rūpa upamāse rahita hai tathā āpa atulya vīryake dhāraka haiṃ | he nātha ! ina tīnoṃ lokoṃmeṃ aisā kauna puruṣa haiṃ jo āpake darśanase santṛpta huā ho || 144 || he bhagavan ! yadyapi āpa prāpta karane yogya samasta padārtha prāpta kara cuke haiṃ, kṛtakṛtya haiṃ, sarvadarśī haiṃ, sukhasvarūpa haiṃ, acintya haiṃ, aura jānane yogya samasta padārthoṃko jāna cuke haiṃ tathāpi jagatkā hita karane ke lie udyata haiṃ || 145 || he jinarāja ! saṃsārarūpī andhakūpameṃ paḍa़te hue jīvoṃko āpa śreṣṭha dharmopadeśarūpī hastāvalambana pradāna karate haiṃ ||146 || isa prakāra jinakī vāṇī gadgada ho rahī thī aura netra ā~suoṃ se bhara rahe the aise parama harṣako prāpta hue meghavāhana aura sahasranayana vidhipūrvaka stuti aura namaskāra kara yathāsthāna baiṭha gaye || 147 || sihavīryaṃ ādi muni, indra ādi deva aura sagara ādi rājā parama āścaryako prāpta hue || 148 ||
athānantara - jinendra bhagavān ke samavasaraṇameṃ rākṣasoṃke indra bhīma aura subhīma prasanna hokara meghavāhana se kahane lage ki he vidyādharake bālaka ! tū dhanya hai jo sarvajña ajita jinendrakī śaraṇameṃ āyā hai, hama donoṃ tujhapara santuṣṭa hue haiṃ ataḥ jisase terī sarva prakāra se svasthatā ho sakegī vaha bāta hama tujhase isa samaya kahate haiṃ so tū dhyānase suna, tū hama donoṃkī rakṣākā pātra hai || 149 - 151 || 1. sāraṃ kha. |

prathamo bharato'tītassagarastvaṃ ca vartase | cakralānchitamogeśā bhaviṣyanti pare nṛpāḥ ||222|| sanatkumāravikhyātirmaghavā nāmato'paraḥ | śāntikunthvaranāmānaḥ subhūmadhvanikīrtitaḥ ||223|| mahāpadmaḥ prasiddhaśca hariṣeṇadhvanistathā | jayasenanṛpaścānyo brahmadatto bhaviṣyati ||224|| vāsudevā bhaviṣyanti nava sādhaṃ pratīśvaraiḥ | baladevāśca tāvanto dharmavinyastacetasaḥ ||225|| proktā ete'vasarpiṇyāṃ jinaprabhṛtayastathā | tathaivotsarpiṇīkāle bharatairāvatākhyayoḥ ||226|| evaṃ karmavaśaṃ śrutvā jīvānāṃ bhavasaṃkaṭam | mahāpuruṣabhūtiṃ ca kālasya ca vivartanam ||227|| aṣṭakarmavimuktānāṃ sukhaṃ copamayojjhitam | jīmūtavāhanaścakre cetasīdaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||228|| kaṣṭaṃ yaireva jīvo'yaṃ karmabhiḥ paritapyate | tānyevotsahate katu' mohitaḥ karmamāyayā ||229|| āpātamātraramyeṣu viṣavad duḥkhadāyiṣu | viṣayeṣu ratiḥ kā vā duḥkhotpādanavṛttiṣu ||230|| kṛtvāpi hi ciraṃ saṅgaṃ dhane kāntāsu bandhuṣu | ekākinaiva kartavyaṃ saṃsāre parivartanam ||231|| tāvadeva janaḥ sarvaḥ 'priyatvenānuvartate | dānena gṛhyate yāvatsārameyaśiśuryathā ||232|| iyatā cāpi kālena ko gataḥ saha bandhubhiḥ | paralokaṃ kalatrairvā suhṛdbhirbāndhavena vā ||233|| nāgabhogopamā mogā bhīmā narakapātinaḥ | teṣu kuryānaraḥ saṅga ko vā yaḥ syātsacetanaḥ ||234|| aho paramidaṃ ciḥ sadbhāvena yadāśritān | lakṣmīḥ pratārayatyeva duṣṭatvaṃ kimataḥ param ||235||
cukā hai, atyanta śaktiśālī dvitīya cakravartī tuma ho aura tuma do ke sivāya dasa cakravartī aura hoṃge ||221|| cakravartiyoṃmeṃ prathama cakravartī bharata ho cuke haiṃ, dvitīya cakravartī sagara tuma vidyamāna hī ho aura tuma doke sivāya cakracihnita bhogoṃke svāmī nimnāṃkita dasa cakravartī rājā aura bhī hoṃge ||222|| 3 sanatkumāra, 4 maghavā, 5 śānti, 6 kunthu, 7 ara, 8 subhūma, 9 mahāpadma, 10 hariṣeṇa, 11 jayasena aura 12 brahmadatta ||223|| nau pratinārāyaṇoṃke sātha nau nārāyaṇa hoṃge aura dharmameṃ jinakā citta laga rahā hai aise balabhada bhī nau hoṃge ||224-225|| he rājana! jisa prakāra hamane avasarpiṇī kālameṃ honevāle tīrthaṃkara, cakravartī ādikā varṇana kiyā hai usī prakārake tīrthaṃkara ādi utsarpiṇī kālameṃ bhī bharata tathā airāvata kṣetrameṃ hoṃge ||226|| isa prakāra karmoṃke vaśa honevālā jīvoṃkā saṃsārabhramaṇa, mahāpuruṣoṃkī utpatti, kālacakrakā parivartana aura āṭha karmose rahita jīvoṃko honevālā anupama sukha ina sabakā vicārakara buddhimān meghavāhanane apane manameṃ nimna vicāra kiyā ||227-228|| hāya hāya, baḍa़e duḥkhakī bāta hai ki jina karmoke dvārā yaha jīva ātāpako prāpta hotā hai kamarūpī madirāse unmatta huā yaha unhīṃ karmoko karaneke lie utsāhita hotā hai ||229|| jo prārambhameṃ hī manohara dikhate haiṃ aura antameṃ viṣake samāna duḥkha dete haiṃ athavā duḥkha utpanna karanā hī jinakā svabhāva hai| aise viṣayoṃmeṃ kyā prema karanā hai ? ||230|| yaha jīva dhana, striyoṃ tathā bhāī-bandhuoṃkā cirakāla taka saṃga karatā hai to bhī saṃsārameṃ ise akele hī bhramaṇa karanā paḍa़tā hai ||231|| jisa prakāra kuttāke pilleko jabataka roṭīkā ṭukaḍa़ā dete rahate haiṃ tabhī taka vaha prema karatā huā pīche lagā rahatā hai isī prakāra ina saṃsārake sabhī prāṇiyoṃko jaba taka kucha milatā rahatā hai tabhī taka ye premī banakara apane pīche lage rahate haiṃ ||232|| itanā bhārī kāla bīta gayā para isameṃ kauna manuṣya aisā hai jo bhāī-bandhuoṃ, striyoṃ, mitroṃ tathā anya iṣṭa janoṃke sātha paralokako gayā ho ||233|| ye paṃcendriyoṃke bhoga sā~pake śarīrake samāna bhayaṃkara evaṃ narakameṃ girānevāle haiṃ| aisā kauna sacetana-vicāraka puruṣa hai jo ki ina viṣayoṃmeṃ āsakti karatā ho ? ||234|| aho, sabase baḍa़ā āścarya to isa bātakā hai ki jo manuṣya lakṣmīkā

isa mahārākṣasarūpī candramā bhī dānarūpī kiraṇoṃke samūhase bandhujanarūpī samudrako hulasātā huā laṃkārūpī ākāśāṃgaṇake bīca suśobhita hone lagā ||241|| usakā aisā prabhāva thā ki baḍa़ebaḍa़e vidyādharoṃke adhipati svapnameṃ bhī usakī ājñā prāpta kara haḍa़baḍa़ākara jāga uṭhate the aura hātha joḍa़kara mastakase lagā lete the ||242|| usakī vimalābhā nāmakī prāṇapriyā vallabhā thī jo chāyāke samāna sadā usake sātha rahatī thī ||243|| usake amararakṣa, udadhirakṣa aura bhānurakṣa nāmaka tīna putra hue| ye tīnoṃ hī putra saba prakārake arthoṃse paripūrṇa the ||244|| vicitra-vicitra kāryoṃse yukta the, uttuṃga arthāt udāra the aura jana-dhanase vistārako prāpta the isalie aise jāna paḍa़te māno tīna loka hī hoṃ ||245|| bhagavān ajitanātha bhī muktigāmī bhavya jīvoṃko mokṣakā mārga pravartākara sammeda śikharapara pahu~ce aura vahā~se ātmasvabhāvako prāpta hae-siddha padako ||246|| sagara cakravartīke indrāṇīke samāna tejako dhāraṇa karanevālī chayānabe hajāra rāniyā~ thīṃ aura uttama śaktiko dhāraṇa karanevāle evaṃ ratnamayī khambhoṃke samāna dedīpyamāna sāṭha hajāra putra the| una putroṃke bhī aneka putra the ||247-248|| kisī samaya ve sabhī putra vandanāke lie kailāsa

padmapurāṇe āsatāṃ tāvadete vā nākalokeśvarā api | jvalitā vimavairyātāḥ kṣaṇād duḥkhena bhasmatām ||263|| ye'pi tīrthakarā nāma trailokyasyābhinandakāḥ | śarīraṃ te'pi saṃtyajya gacchantyāyuḥparikṣaye ||264|| mahātarau yathaikasminnuṣitvā rajanī punaḥ | prabhāte pratipadyante kakubho daśa pakṣiṇaḥ ||265|| evaṃ kuṭumba ekasmin saṃgama prāpya jantavaḥ | punaḥ svāṃ svāṃ prapadyante gatiṃ karmavaśānugāḥ ||266|| kaiścittacceṣṭitaṃ teṣāṃ vapuścātyantaśobhanam | viṣayīkṛtamakṣibhyāmasmākaṃ tu kathāgatam ||267|| balavadbhayo hi sarvebhyo mṛtyureva mahābalaḥ | ānītā nidhanaṃ yena balavanto balīyasā ||26|| kathaṃ sphuṭati no vakṣaḥ smṛtvā teṣāṃ mahātmanām | vināśaṃ bharatādīnāmaho citramidaṃ param ||269|| phenormīndradhanuḥsvapnavidyububudasaṃnimāḥ | saṃpadaḥ priyasaṃparkā vigrahāśca śarīriṇām ||270|| nāsti kaścinnaro loke yo vrajedupamānatām | yathāyamamarastadvadvayaṃ mṛtyūjjhitā iti ||27|| ye'pi śoṣayituṃ śakkāḥ samudraṃ grāmasaṃkulam | kuryurvā karayugmena cūrṇa merumahīdharam ||272|| uddhartuṃ dharaṇī śaktā grasituṃ 'candrabhāskarau | praviṣṭāste'pi kālena kṛtāntavadanaṃ narāḥ ||273|| mṛtyordurlakitasyāsya trailokye vaśatāṃ gate | kevalaṃ vyujjhitāḥ siddhā jinadharmasamudbhavāḥ ||27|| yathā te bahavo yātāḥ kālena nidhanaṃ nṛpāḥ | yāsyāmo vayamapyevaṃ sāmānya jagatāmidam ||275|| tatra trilokasāmānye vastunyasmin samāgate | śokaṃ kuryādvibuddhātmā ko naro bhavakāraṇam ||276|| kathāyāmiti jātāyāṃ vīkṣyāpatyadvayaṃ punaḥ | mānase cakravartīdaṃ cakāreṅgitakovidaḥ ||277||
nahīṃ haiṃ ||262|| athavā ina sabako rahane do, svargalokake adhipati bhī jo ki vaibhavase dedīpyamāna rahate haiṃ kṣaṇabharameṃ duḥkhase bhasma ho jāte haiṃ ||263|| athavā inheṃ bhī jāne do, tīna lokako ānandita karanevāle jo tīrthaṃkara haiṃ ve bhī āyu samāpta honepara śarīrako choḍa़kara cale jāte haiṃ ||264|| jisa prakāra pakṣī rātrike samaya kisī baḍa़e vṛkṣapara basakara prātaḥkāla daśoṃ diśāoṃmeṃ cale jāte haiṃ usī prakāra aneka prāṇī eka kuṭumbameṃ ekatrita hokara karmoṃ ke anusāra phira apanī gatiko cale jāte haiṃ ||265-266|| kinhīṃne una pūrva puruṣoṃkī ceṣṭāe~ tathā unakā atyanta sundara śarīra apanī āṃkhoṃse dekhā hai parantu hama kathāmātrase unheṃ jānate haiṃ ||267|| mṛtyu sabhī balavānoṃse adhika balavān hai kyoṃki isane anya sabhī balavānoṃko parāsta kara diyā hai ||268|| aho ! yaha baḍa़ā āścarya hai ki bharata ādi mahāpuruṣoṃke vināśakā smaraṇa kara hamārī chātī nahīṃ phaṭa rahī hai ||269|| jīvoṃkī dhanasampadāe~, iṣṭasamāgama aura śarīra, phena, taraṃga, indradhanuṣa, svapna, bijalī aura babūlāke samāna haiṃ ||270|| saṃsārameṃ aisā koī bhī manuṣya nahīṃ hai jo isa viṣayameṃ upamāna ho sake ki jisa taraha yaha amara hai usī taraha hama bhī amara raheṃge ||271|| jo magaramacchoṃse bhare samudrako sukhāneke lie samartha haiṃ athavā apane donoṃ hāthoṃse sumeru parvatako cūrṇa karanemeṃ samartha haiṃ athavā pṛthvīko ūpara uṭhānemeṃ aura candramā tathā sūryako grasane meṃ samartha haiṃ ve manuṣya bhī kāla pākara yamarājake mukhameṃ praviṣṭa hue haiṃ ||272-273|| tīnoṃ lokoṃke prāṇī isa dulaṃghanīya mṛtyuke vaśa ho rahe haiṃ| yadi koī bākī chūṭe haiṃ to jinadharmase utpanna hue siddha bhagavān hī chūṭa haiṃ ||274||

gijāī hue so rājāke hāthīse cūrṇa hokara ve saba giṃjāiyoṃke jīva saṃsārameṃ bhramaṇa karate rahe
||291|| kumbhakārake jīva rājāne muni hokara devapada prāpta kiyā aura vahā~se cyuta hokara tū bhagīratha huā hai tathā gā~vake saba loga marakara sagara cakravartī ke putra hue haiṃ ||292|| muni saṃghakī nindā kara yaha manuṣya bhava-bhavameṃ mṛtyuko prāpta hotā hai| isī pāpase gā~vake saba loga bhī eka sātha mṛtyuko prāpta hue the aura saṃghakī stuti karanese tū isa taraha sampanna tathā dīrghāyu huā hai ||293|| isa prakāra bhagīratha bhagavānke mukhase pūrvabhava sunakara atyanta śānta ho gayā aura muniyoṃmeṃ mukhya banakara tapake yogya padako prāpta huā ||224|| gautama svāmī rājā śreṇikase kahate haiṃ ki he rājan ! prakaraṇa pākara yaha sagarakā caritra maiṃne tujhase kahā| aba isa samaya prakṛta kathā kahū~gā so suna ||295||
athānantara-jo mahārakṣa nāmā vidyādharoṃkā rājā laṃkāmeṃ niṣkaṇṭaka rājya karatā thā vidyābalase samunnata vaha rājā eka samaya antaḥpurake sātha krīḍa़ā karaneke lie baḍa़e vaibhavase usa pramadavanameṃ gayā jo ki kamaloṃse ācchādita vāpikāoṃse suśobhita thā, jisake bīcameṃ nānā ratnoṃkī prabhāse ū~cā dikhanevālā krīḍa़āparvata banā huā thā, khile hue phūloṃse suśobhita vṛkṣoṃke samūha jisakī śobhā baḍha़ā rahe the, avyakta madhura śabdoṃke sātha idhara-udhara maṃḍarāte hue pakṣiyoṃke samūhase vyāpta thā, jo ratnamayī bhūmise veṣṭita thā, jisameṃ nānā prakārakī kānti vikasita ho rahī thī, aura jo saghana pallavoṃkī samīcīna chāyāse yukta latāmaṇḍapoṃse suśobhita thā ||296-300| rājā mahārakṣa usa pramadavanameṃ apanī striyoṃke sātha kīḍa़ā karane lagā| kabhī striyā~ use phūloṃse tāḍa़nā karatī thīṃ aura kabhī vaha phaloṃse striyoṃko tāḍa़nā karatā thā ||301|| koī strī anya strīke pāsa jāneke kāraṇa yadi īrṣyāse kupita ho jātī thī to use vaha caraṇoṃmeṃ jhukakara śānta kara letā thā| isī prakāra kabhī āpa svayaṃ kupita ho jātā thā to līlāse bharī strī ise prasanna kara leto thī ||302|| kabhī yaha trikūṭācalake taṭake samāna suśobhita apane vakṣaḥsthalase kisī strī ko preraṇā detā thā to anya strī use bhī apane sthala stanoṃke āliṃganase preraṇā detī thī ||303|| isa taraha kroḍa़āmeṃ nimagna striyoṃke pracchanna śarīroṃko dekhatā huā yaha 1. duti ma. | 2. -gīrṣayā ma.|

atha vaktre triyāmāyāḥ paraṃ saṃkocamīyuṣi | rājīvasaṃpuṭe'paśyad dvirephaṃ sa nipīḍitam || 305 || dṛṣṭvā cāsya samutpannā cinteyaṃ mavanāśinī | karmaṇo mohanīyasya yāte śithilatāṃ guṇe || 306 || makarandarasāsakto mūḍhastṛptimanāgataḥ | mṛrti madhukaraḥ prāpto vigicchāmantavarjitām ||307|| yathāyamatra saṃsaktaḥ' prāpto mṛtyuṃ madhuvrataḥ | prāpsyāmo vayamapyevaṃ saṃktāḥ strīmukhapaṅkaje || 308 || yadi tāvadayaṃ dhvasto ghrāṇena rasanena ca | kaitra vārtā tadāsmāsu pañcendriyavaśātmasu ||309 || tiryagjātisametasya yuktaṃ vāsyedamīhitum | vayaṃ tu jñānasaṃpannāḥ saṅgamatra kathaṃ gatāḥ || 310 || madhudigdhā sidhārāyā lene kīdṛśaṃ sukham | rasanaṃ pratyutāyāti śatadhā yatra khaṇḍanam ||311|| viṣayeṣu tathā saukhyaṃ kīdṛśaṃ nāma jāyate | yatra pratyuta duḥkhānāmuparyupari saṃtatiḥ || 312 || kimpākaphala tulyebhyo viṣayebhyaḥ parāṅmukhāḥ | ye narāstānnamasyāmi kāyena vacasā dhiyā ||313 || hā kaṣṭaṃ vañcitaḥ pāpo dīrghakālamahaṃ khalaiḥ | viṣayairviṣamāsaṅgairviṣavanmāraṇātmakaiḥ || 314 || athā samaye prāptastadudyānaṃ mahāmuniḥ | arthānugatayā yuktaḥ śrutasāgarasaṃjñayā ||315|| pūrṇaḥ paramarūpeṇa dvepayan kāntito vidhum | tiraskurvan raviṃ dīptyā jayaṃ sthairyeṇa mandaram || 316 || dharmadhyānaprasaktātmā rāgadveṣavivarjitaḥ | bhagnastridaṇḍasaṃparkaḥ kaṣāyāṇāṃ śaime rataḥ || 317||
rājā ratirūpa sāgarake madhya meṃ sthita hotā huā pramadavanameṃ isa prakāra krīḍa़ā karatā rahā jisa prakāra ki nandana vanameṃ indra krīḍa़ā karatā hai || 304||
athānantara sūrya asta huā aura rātrikā prārambha hote hī kamaloṃke sampuṭa saṃkocako prāpta hone lage | rājā mahārakṣane eka kamala sampuṭake bhītara marā huā bhauṃrā dekhā || 305 || usī samaya mohanīya karmakā udaya śithila honese usake hṛdayameṃ saṃsāra - bhramaṇako naṣṭa karanevālī nimnāṃkita cintā utpanna huī ||306|| vaha vicāra karane lagā ki dekho makarandake rasameṃ āsakta huā yaha mūḍha़ bhauṃrā tṛpta nahīṃ huā isalie maraṇako prāma huā | ācāryaṃ kahate haiṃ ki isa antarahita ananta icchāko dhikkāra ho ||307 || jisa prakāra isa kamalameṃ āsakta huā yaha bhauṃrā mṛtyuko prāpta huā hai usī prakāra striyoṃ ke mukharūpī kamaloṃmeṃ āsakta hue hama loga bhī mṛtyuko prāpta hoṃge || 308 || To fo yaha bhauṃrā ghrāṇa aura rasanā indriyake kāraṇa hī mṛtyuko prāpta huā hai taba hama to pā~coṃ indriyoṃ ke vaśībhūta ho rahe haiṃ ataḥ hamārī bāta hī kyā hai ? || 309 || athavā yaha bhauṃrā tiyaṃca jātikā hai - ajñānī hai ataḥ isakā aisā karanā ṭhīka bhī hai parantu hama to jñānase sampanna haiṃ phira bhī ina viṣayoṃmeṃ kyoṃ āsakta ho rahe haiṃ ? || 310 || śahada lapeṭī talavārakī usa dhārake cāṭane meṃ kyā sukha hotā hai ? jisapara paḍa़te hī jībhake saikaḍa़oṃ ṭukaḍa़e ho jāte haiṃ ||311 || viṣayoṃ meṃ kaisā sukha hotā hai so jāna paḍa़tā hai una viṣayoṃmeṃ jinameṃ ki sukhakī bāta dūra rahī kintu duḥkhakī santati hī uttarottara prāpta hotī hai || 312 || kipāka phalake samāna viṣayoṃse jo manuṣya vimukha ho gaye haiṃ maiṃ una saba mahāpuruṣoṃko mana-vacana-kāyase namaskāra karatā hū~ || 313|| hāya-hāya, baḍa़e kheda kī bāta hai ki maiṃ bahuta samaya taka ina duṣṭa viṣayoṃse vaṃcita hotā rahā- dhokhā khātā rahā | ina viṣayoṃkī āsakti atyanta viṣama hai tathā viṣake samāna māranevālī hai ||314||

vaśīkartā hṛṣīkāṇāṃ ṣaṭkāyaprāṇivatsalaḥ | bhītibhiḥ saptabhirmukto madāṣṭakavivarjitaḥ || 318 || sākṣādiva śarīreṇa dharmaḥ saṃbandhamāgataḥ | sahito yatisaṅghana mahatā cāruceṣṭinā || 319 || sa tatra vipule śuddhe bhūtale jantuvarjite | upaviṣṭastanucchāyāstha gitāśeṣadiṅmukhaḥ || 320 || tatrāsīnaṃ viditvainaṃ mukhebhyo vanarakṣiṇām | abhīyāya mahārakṣo bibhradutkaṇṭhitaṃ manaḥ ||321|| athāsyātiprasannāsyakāntitoyena pādayoḥ | kurvan prakṣālanaṃ rājā papāta śivadāyinoḥ || 322 || praṇamya śeṣasaṅgha ca pṛṣṭvā kṣemaṃ ca dharmaṃgam | avasthāya kṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ paryapṛcchat sa bhaktitaḥ || 323|| athopaśamacandrasya cittasthasyeva nirmalaiḥ | dantāṃśupaṭalaiḥ kurvan jyotsnāṃ munirabhāṣata || 324 || ahiṃsā nṛpa sadbhāvo dharmasyokto jineśvaraiḥ | parivāro'stu śeṣo'sya satyabhāṣādiriṣyate || 325|| yāṃ yāṃ jīvāḥ prapadyante gatiṃ karmānubhāvataḥ | tatra tatra ratiṃ yānti jīvanaṃ pratimohitāḥ ||326|| trailokyaisya parityajya lābhaṃ maraṇabhīravaḥ | icchanti jīvanaṃ jīvā nānyadasti tataḥ priyam || 327|| kimatra bahunoktena svasaṃvedyamidaṃ nainu | yathā svajīvitaṃ kāntaṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā || 328 || tasmādevaṃvidhaṃ mūḍhā jīvitaṃ ye śarīriṇām | haranti raudrakarmāṇaḥ pāpaṃ tairna ca kiṃ kṛtam ||329|| jantūnāṃ jīvitaṃ nītvā karmabhāragurūkṛtāḥ | patanti narake jīvā lohapiṇḍavadambhasi ||330||
mana-vacana-kāyako nirarthaka pravṛttirūpī tīna daṇḍoṃko bhagna kara diyā thā, kaṣāyoṃke śānta karane meṃ ve sadā tatpara rahate the ||317 || ve indriyoṃko vaśa karanevāle the, chaha kāyake jīvoṃse sneha rakhate the, sāta bhayoṃ aura āṭha madoṃse rahita the || 318 || unheṃ dekhakara aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno sākṣāt dharmaṃ hī śarīra ke sātha sambandhako prāpta huā hai | ve munirāja uttama ceṣṭāke dhāraka bahuta baḍa़e
saṃgha sahita || 319 || jinhoṃne apane śarīrakī kāntise samasta diśāoṃke agrabhāgako ācchādita kara diyā thā aise ve munirāja usa udyānake vistṛta, śuddha evaṃ nirjantuka pṛthivītalapara virājamāna ho gaye || 320|| jaba rājā mahārakṣako vanapāloṃke mukhase vahā~ virājamāna ina munirājakā patā calā to vaha utkṛṣṭa hṛdayako dhāraṇa karatā huā unake sammukha gayā || 321||
athānantara - atyanta prasanna mukhako kāntirūpī jalake dvārā prakṣālana karatā huā rājā mahārakṣa munirāja ke kalyāṇadāyī caraṇoṃmeṃ jā paḍa़ā || 322|| usane śeṣa saṃghako bhī namaskāra kiyā, sabase dharmaṃ sambandhī kuśala-kṣema pūchī aura phira kṣaṇabhara ṭhaharakara bhaktibhāvase dharmakā svarūpa pūchā || 323|| tadanantara munirājake hṛdayameṃ jo upaśama bhāvarūpī candramā vidyamāna thā usakī kiraṇoṃke samāna nirmala dā~toṃkī kiraṇoṃke samūhase cā~danīko prakaṭa hue munirāja kahane lage || 324 || unhoṃne kahā ki he rājan ! jinendra bhagavānne eka ahiṃsāke sadbhāvako hī dharmaṃ kahā hai, bākī satyabhāṣaṇa ādi sabhī isake parivāra haiṃ || 325 || saṃsārī prāṇī karmoṃke udayase jisa-jisa gatimeṃ jāte haiṃ jīvanake prati mohita hote hue ve usī usīmeṃ prema karane lagate haiṃ || 326 || eka ora tīna lokakī prāpti ho rahī ho aura dūsarī ora maraṇako sambhāvanā ho to maraṇase ḍaranevāle ye prāṇī tīna lokakā lobha choḍa़kara jīvita rahanekī icchā karate haiṃ isase jāna paḍa़tā hai ki prāṇiyoṃko jīvanase baḍha़kara aura koī vastu priya nahīṃ hai || 327|| isa viṣayameṃ bahuta kahane se kyā lābha hai ? yaha bāta to apane anubhavase hī jānī jā sakatī hai ki jisa prakāra hameṃ apanā jīvana pyārā hai usī prakāra samasta prāṇiyoṃ ko bhī apanā jīvana pyārā hotā hai || 328 || isalie jo krūrakarma karanevāle mūrkha prāṇī, jīvoṃke aise priya jīvanako naṣṭa karate haiṃ unhoṃne kauna-sā pāpa nahīṃ kiyā ? || 329 || jīvoṃ ke jīvanako naṣṭa kara prāṇī karmoṃke bhārase itane vajanadāra ho jāte haiṃ ki ve pānīmeṃ lohapiṇḍa

aṣṭabhirdivasaḥ sa tvaṃ kathaṃ prāpsyasi tarpaṇam | svapnajālopamairmogairadhunā bhajyatāṃ śamaḥ ||359|| tatastasya viṣādo'bhūmāyuḥkṣayasamutthitaḥ | kiṃtu saṃsāracakrasthajanmāntaravivartanāt ||360|| sthāpayitvā tato rājye tanayaṃ devarakṣasam | yuvarājapratiṣṭhāyāṃ tathā bhāskararakṣasam ||361|| tyaktvā parigrahaṃ sarva paramārthaparāyaṇaḥ | stammatulyo mahārakṣā lobhenābhavadujhitaḥ ||362|| pānāhārādikaṃ tyaktvā sarva dehasya pālanam | samaḥ śatrau ca minne ca manaḥ kṛtvā suniścalam ||36|| maunavrataṃ samāsthāya jinaprāsādamadhyagaḥ | kṛtvā samahatī pūjāmahaṃtāmabhiṣekiṇīm ||364|| arhatpadaparidhyānapavitrīkṛtacetanaḥ | kṛtvā samādhinā kālaṃ sa babhūva surottamaḥ ||365|| atha kinneragītākhye pure śrīdharanāmataḥ | vidyājātāṃ ratiṃ jāyāṃ devarakṣāḥ prapannavān ||366|| gandharvagītanagare surasaṃnimanāmataḥ | gāndhārīgarmasaṃbhūtāṃ gandharvā mānurūḍhavān ||367|| sutā daśa samutpannā manojñā devarakṣasaḥ | devāṅganāsarūpāśca ṣaṭ kanyā guṇabhūṣaṇāḥ ||368|| tāvanta eva cotpannāḥ sutāḥ kanyāśca tatsamāḥ | ādityarakṣaso rājñaḥ kīrtivyāptadigantarāḥ ||369|| svanāmasahanāmāni mahānti nagarāṇi naiḥ | niveśitāni ramyāṇi śreṇikaitāni jitvaraiḥ ||370|| sandhyākāraḥ suvelaśca manohlādo manoharaḥ | haṃsadvīpo hariyodhaḥ samudraḥ kāñcanastathā ||371|| ardhasvargotkaṭaścāpi niviśāḥ svargasaṃnibhāḥ | gīrvāṇarakṣasaḥ putrarmahābuddhiparākramaiḥ ||372||

athānantara amararakṣane, kinnaragīta nāmaka nagarameṃ śrīdhara rājā aura vidyā rānīse samutpanna rati nāmaka strīko prāpta kiyā arthāt usake sātha vivāha kiyā ||366|| aura bhānurakṣane gandharvagīta nagarameṃ rājā surasannibha aura gāndhārī rānīke garbhase utpanna, gandharvā nāmakī kanyāke sātha vivāha kiyā ||367|| amararakṣake atyanta sundara dasa putra aura devāṃganāoṃke samāna sundara rūpavālī, guṇarūpa ābhūṣaṇoṃse sahita chaha putriyā~ utpanna huīṃ ||368|| isa prakāra bhānurakṣake bhī apanī kīrtike dvārā didigantako vyāpta karanevāle dasa putra aura chaha putriyāṃ utpanna huī ||369|| he śreṇika ! una vijayī rājaputroṃne apane nāmake samāna nāmavāle baḍa़e-baḍa़e sundara nagara basāye ||370|| una nagaroṃke nāma suno-1 sandhyākāra, 2 suvela, 3 manohlāda, 4 manohara, 5 haṃsadvīpa, 6 hari, 7 yodha, 8 samudra, 9 kāṃcana aura 10 ardhasvargotkṛṣṭa | svargakī samānatā rakhanevāle ye dasa nagara, mahābuddhi aura parākramako dhāraṇa karanevāle amararakṣake putroṃne basāye the ||371-372||

vaṃśo rakṣonabhogānāṃ mayā te parikīrtitaḥ | śṛṇu vānaraketūnāṃ saṃtānamadhunā nṛpa ||1|| vijayā gire ge dakṣiṇe svargasaṃnibhe| puraṃ meghapuraṃ nāmnā tuṅgaprāsādaśobhitam ||2|| vidyābhṛtāṃ patistasminnatīndro nāma viśrutaḥ | 'atikramyeva yaḥ śakraṃ sthito bhogādisaṃpadā ||3|| śrīmatī nāma tasyāsīt kāntā śrīsamavibhramā| yasyāḥ sati mukhe pakṣo jyotsnayeva sadābhavat ||4|| tayoḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāmābhat sutaḥ śrativiśāradaḥ | yasya nāmni gate karṇa harṣamīyarvicakṣaṇāḥ ||5|| svasā tasyābhavaccārvī devī nāma kanīyasī | bāṇatāṃ nayane yasyā gate kusumadhanvanaḥ ||6|| atha ratnapuraṃ nāma puraṃ tatra manoharam | tatra puṣpottaro nāma vidyādhārī mahābaleḥ ||7|| tasya padmottarāmikhyaḥ suto yena vilocane | viṣayāntarasaṃbandhājanānāṃ vinivartite ||8|| tasmai puṣpottaraḥ kanyāṃ bahuśastāmayācata | śrīkaṇṭhena na sā tasmai dattā karmānubhāvataḥ ||9|| sā tena kīrtiśubhrāya dattā bāndhavavākyataḥ| vivāhaṃ ca pareṇāsyā vidhinā niravartayat ||10|| na me'mijanato doṣo na me dāridrayasaṃbhavaḥ | na ca putrasya vairūpyaṃ na kiṃcidverakāraṇam ||11|| tayāpi mama putrāya vitīrṇa tena na svasā| iti puṣpottaro dhyātvā kopāveśaṃ paraṃ gataḥ ||12||

||5|| usake mahāmanoharadevī nāmakī choṭī bahana thī| usa devīke netra kyā the māno kāmadevake bāṇa hī the ||6|| athānantara-ratnapura nāmakā eka sundara nagara thā jisameṃ atyanta balavān puṣpotara padmottara itanā sundara thā ki usane anya manuṣyoṃke netra dūsare padārthoṃke sambandhase dūra haṭā diye the arthāt saba loga use hī dekhate rahanā cāhate the ||8|| rājā puṣpottarane apane putra padmottarake lie rājā atīndrakī putrī devīkī bahuta bāra yācanā kī parantu śrīkaṇṭha bhāīne apanī bahana padmottarake lie nahīṃ dī, laṃkāke rājā kīrtidhavalake lie dī aura baḍa़e vaibhavake sātha mere putrameṃ kurūpapanā hai aura na merā unase kucha vaira bhī hai phira bhī śrīkaṇṭhane mere putrake lie apanī bahana nahīṃ dī ||11-12|| 1. atikramya ca ma.| atikramyaiva kha.| 2. saṃpadaḥ ka.| 3. tayoḥ kuśalavṛttāntapraśno yāvatpravartate | tāvarapuṣpottaraḥ prāpto mahābalasamanvitaḥ ||27|| kīrtiśuklastato'paśyad gaganaṃ sarvataścitam | vidyādharasamūhena pradīptamurutejasā ||28|| asikuntādimiḥ śastravikarālaṃ mahāravam | sthānabhraṃśamivāgacchad balaṃ khecarasaṃgamāt ||29|| vājibhirvāyurahobhirgajaiśca jaladopamaiḥ | vimānaiśca mahāmānaiḥ siṃhaśca pracalatsaṭaiḥ ||30|| dṛṣṭvottarāṃ diśaṃ vyāpta vihasya krodhamiśritam | sacivānāṃ samādeśaṃ kīrtiśuklo yudhe dadau ||31|| akāyaṇa tataḥ svena śrīkaṇṭho'yaṃ pānataḥ | kīrtiśubhramidaṃ vākyaṃ jagāda tvarayānvitam ||32|| eta bandhujanaṃ rakṣa tvaṃ madīyamihādhunā| karomi nirjitaṃ yāvatpratipakṣaṃ tavāśrayāt ||33|| evamukta jagādāsau vacanaṃ nayasaṃgatam | tavāyuktamidaṃ vaktuṃ prāpyaṃ māṃ bhītibhedanam ||34|| yadi nāmaiṣa no sāmnā śamaṃ yāsyati durjanaḥ | tataḥ paśya praviṣṭo'yaṃ mṛtyorvaktraṃ madīritaḥ ||35|| sthāpayitveti viśrabdhaṃ priyāyāḥ sodaraṃ nṛpaḥ | utkṛṣṭavayaso dhīrān dūtān drutamajīgamat ||36|| uparyupari te gatvā krameṇedaṃ babhāṣire | puṣpottaraṃ mahāprājñā madhurālāpakovidāḥ ||37|| puṣpottara vadatyetadbhavantaṃ kīrtinirmalaḥ | asmadvadanavinyastaiḥ padairādarasaṃgataiḥ ||38|| mahākulasamutpanno bhavān vimalaceṣṭitaḥ | sarvasmin jagati khyātiṃ gataḥ śāstrārthakoṣidaḥ ||39|| āgatā gocaraṃ kā te na maryādā mahāmate | karṇajāha nidhīyeta yāsmābhiradhunā tava ||40|| śrīkaṇṭho'pi kule jātaḥ śaśāṅkakaranirmale | vittavān vinayopetaḥ kāntaḥ sarvakalānvitaḥ||41||
atithisatkāra kiyā ||26|| jabataka una donoṃke bīca kuśala-samācārakā praśna calatā hai ki tabataka baḍa़ī bhārī senāke sātha puṣpottara vahā~ jā pahu~cā ||27|| tadanantara kīrtidhavalane ākāśakī ora dekhā to vaha ākāśa saba orase vidyādharoṃke samahase vyāpta thā. viśāla tejase dedīpyamāna ho rahā thā ||28|| talavāra, bhāle ādi śastroṃse mahābhayaṃkara thā, baḍa़ā bhārī śabda usameṃ ho rahā thā, vidyādharoṃke samāgamase vaha senā aisī jāna paḍa़tī thī māno apane sthānase bhraṣṭa honeke kāraṇa hī usameṃ vaha mahāśabda ho rahā thā ||29|| vāyuke samāna vegavāle ghoḍa़oṃ, meghoṃkī upamā rakhanevāle hāthiyoṃ, baḍa़e-baḍa़e vimānoṃ aura jinakī garadanake bāla hila rahe the aise siṃhoṃse uttara diśāko vyāpta dekha kīrtidhavalane krodhamiśrita ha~sī ha~sakara mantriyoṃke lie yuddhakā ādeśa diyā ||30-31||
tadanantara apane akārya-khoṭe kāryake kāraṇa lajjāse avanata śrīkaṇṭhane śīghratā karanevāle kīrtidhavalase nimnāṃkita vacana kahe ||32|| ki jabataka maiṃ āpake āśrayase śatruko parāsta karatā hū~ tabataka āpa yahā~ mere iṣṭajana (strī) kī rakṣā karo ||33|| śrīkaṇṭhake aisā kahanepara kīrtidhavalane usase nītiyukta vacana kahe ki bhayakā bhedana karanevāle mujhako pākara tumhārā yaha kahanā yukta nahīṃ hai ||34|| yadi yaha durjana sāmyabhāvase śāntiko prāpta nahīṃ hotā hai to tuma niścita dekhanā ki yaha mere dvārā prerita hokara yamarājake hī mukhameṃ praveśa karegā ||35|| aisā kaha apanī strīke bhāīko to usane niścinta kara mahalameṃ rakhā aura śīghra hī utkṛṣṭa avasthāvāle dhīra-vīra dūtoṃko puṣpottarake pāsa bhejā ||36|| atiśaya buddhimāna aura madhurabhāṣaṇa karanemeṃ nipuṇa dūtoṃne lage hātha jākara puṣpottarase yathākrama nimnāṃkita vacana kahe|||37|| he paṣpottara ! hama logoṃke mukhameṃ sthāpita evaṃ ādarapūrṇa vacanoṃse kīrtidhavala rājā āpase yaha kahatā hai ||38|| ki āpa uccakulameṃ utpanna haiṃ, nirmala ceṣṭāoṃke dhāraka haiṃ, samasta saṃsārameṃ prasiddha haiṃ aura śāstrārthameṃ catura haiṃ ||39|| he mahābuddhimān ! kauna-sī maryādā āpake kānoṃmeṃ nahīṃ paḍa़ī hai jise isa samaya hama loga āpake kānoṃke samīpa rakheṃ ||40|| śrīkaṇṭha bhī candramākī kiraṇoṃke samāna nirmala kulameṃ utpanna huā hai, dhanavān hai, vinayase yukta hai, sundara hai, aura saba kalāoṃse sahita hai ||41|| 1. bhītibhedinam | 2. dhīro ma0 |

padmapurāṇe tasya yogyā guṇaiḥ kanyā rūpeṇa ca kulena ca | samānayoḥ samāyogaṃ karotu vidhiriṣyatām ||42|| na cāsti kāraṇaṃ kiṃcit senayoḥ saṃkṣaye kṛte | svabhāva evaṃ kanyānāṃ yatparāgārasevanam ||43|| dūto yāvadbravītyevaṃ tāvadūtī samāgatā | padmayā preṣitā tasya duhitredamabhāṣata ||44|| bravīti deva padmedaṃ kṛtvā caraṇavandanam | svayaṃ te gadituṃ śaktā apayā neti nāgatā ||45|| tāta svalpāpi nāstyatra śrīkaṇṭhasyāparādhitā | mayā karmānumāvena svayameva pracoditaḥ ||46|| yataḥ satkulajātānāṃ gatireṣaiva yoṣitām | vimucyainamato'nyasya narasya niyamo mama ||47|| iti vijñāpito dūtyā cintāmetāmasau śritaḥ | kiṃkartavyaṃ vimūḍhena cetasā viklavīkṛtaḥ ||48|| 'śuddhābhijanatā mukhyā guṇānāṃ varabhājinām | tasmi~śca saṃbhavatyeṣe pakṣaṃ ca balinaṃ śritaḥ ||49|| abhimānāttathāpyenaṃ vinetuṃ śaktirasti me | svayameva tu kanyāyai rocate kriyate'tra kim ||50|| abhiprāyaṃ tatastasya jñātvā te harṣanirbharāḥ | samaṃ dūtyā gatā dūtā śaśāsuśca yathoditam ||51|| sutāvijñāpanāt tyaktakrodhabhāro'bhimānavān | puṣpottaro gataḥ sthānamātmīyaṃ paramārthavit ||52|| śuklāyāṃ mārgaśīrṣasya pakṣatāvatha śobhane | muhūrte vidhinā vṛttaṃ pāṇigrahaṇametayoḥ ||53|| iti śrīkaṇṭhamāhedaṃ prītyātyantamudārayā| preritaḥ kīrtidhavalo vacanaṃ kṛtaniścayam ||54|| vairiṇo bahavaḥ santi vijayā girau tava | apramattatayā kālaṃ kiyantaṃ gamayiṣyasi ||55|| atastiṣṭha tvamatrava ramye ratnālayāntare | nijābhirucite sthāne svecchayā kṛtaceṣṭitaḥ ||56||
paryāpnoti parityaktaṃ na ca tvāṃ mama mānasam | matprītivāgurāṃ chitvā kathaṃ vā tvaṃ gamiṣyasi ||57|| tumhārī kanyā guṇa, rūpa tathā kula sabhī bātoṃmeṃ usake yogya hai| isa prakāra anukūla bhāgya, do samāna vyaktiyoṃkā saṃyoga karā de to uttama hai ||42|| jaba ki dūsareke gharakī sevā karanā yaha kanyāoṃkā svabhāva hī hai taba donoṃ pakṣakī senāoṃkā kṣaya karane meṃ koī kāraṇa dikhāī nahīṃ detā ||43|| dūta isa prakāra kaha hī rahā thā ki itane meṃ putrī padmābhāke dvārā bhejī huī dūtī ākara puṣpottarase kahane lagī||44|| ki he deva ! padmā āpake caraṇoṃmeṃ namaskāra kara kahatī hai ki maiṃ lajjāke kāraṇa āpase svayaṃ nivedana karaneke lie nahīṃ ā sakī hū~||45|| he tāta ! isa kāryameṃ śrīkaṇṭhakā thoḍa़ā bhī aparādha nahīṃ hai| karmoṃ ke prabhāvase maiṃne ise svayaṃ prerita kiyā thā ||46|| cūṃki satkulameṃ utpanna huī striyoṃkī yahī maryādā hai ataḥ ise choḍa़kara anya puruṣakā mere niyama hai-tyāga hai ||47|| isa prakāra dūtīke kahanepara 'aba kyā karanā cāhie' isa cintāko prāpta huā| usa samaya vaha apane kiṃkartavyavimūḍha़ cittase bahuta duḥkhī ho rahā thā ||48|| usane vicāra kiyā ki varameṃ jitane guṇa honā cāhie unameṃ śuddha vaṃśameṃ janma lenā sabase pramukha hai | yaha guṇa śrīkaṇṭhameṃ hai hī usake sivāya yaha balavān pakṣakī śaraṇameṃ ā pahu~cā hai ||49|| yadyapi isakā abhimāna dūra karanekī mujhameṃ śakti hai, para jaba kanyāke lie yaha svayaṃ rucatā hai taba isa viṣayameṃ kyā kiyā jā sakatā hai ? ||50|| tadanantara puṣpottarakā abhiprāya jānakara harṣase bhare dūta, dūtīke sātha vāpasa cale gaye aura sabane jo bāta jaisī thī vaisī hī rājā kīrtidhavalase kaha dī ||51|| putrīke kahanese jisane krodhakā bhāra choḍa़ diyā thā aisā abhimānī tathā paramārthako jānanevālā rājā pūṣpottara apane sthānapara vāpasa calā gayā ||52|| athānantara mārgaśīrṣa śukla pakṣakī pratipadāke dina śubhamuhūrta meṃ donoṃkā vidhipūrvaka pāṇigrahaṇa saṃskāra huā ||53|| eka dina udāra premase prerita kīrtidhavalane śrīkaṇṭhase niścayapūrṇa nimnāṃkita vacana kahe ||54|| cū~ki vijayā parvatapara tumhāre bahuta-se vairī haiṃ ataḥ tuma sāvadhānīse kitanā kāla bitā sakoge ||55|| lābha isīmeṃ hai ki tumheṃ jo sthāna rucikara ho vahīṃ svecchāse kriyā karate hue yahīṃ atyanta sundara ratnamayī mahaloṃmeṃ nivāsa karo ||56|| merā mana 1. śraddhābhijanitā ma. | 2. -tyeṣā ma. | 3. śritā | 4. pakṣe tāvatsuśobhane kha. |

śrīkaṇṭhamamidhāyaivaṃ saciva nijamabravīt | pitāmahakramāyātamānandākhyaṃ mahāmatim ||58|| sārāsāraṃ tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ madīyānāṃ ciraṃ purām | upadiśyatāmataḥ sāra śrīkaṇṭhāyātra yatpuram ||59|| ityuktaḥ sacivaḥ prāha sitena hṛdayasthitam | kūrcena svāminaṃ bhaktyā cāmareṇeva bījayan ||60|| narendra tava nāstyeva puraṃ yanna manoharam | tathāpi svayamanviṣya gṛhṇātu rucidarśanam ||61|| madhye sāgarametasmin dvīpāḥ santyatibhūrayaḥ | kalpadrumasamākāraiḥ pādapaiāptadiṅmukhāḥ ||62|| ācitā vividhai ratnaistuṅgaśṛṅgā mahaujasaḥ | girayo yeṣu devānāṃ santi krīḍanahetavaḥ ||63|| bhīmātibhīmadākṣiṇyātte cānyairapi vaḥ kule | anujñātāḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ pūrvamityevamāgamaḥ ||6|| purāṇi teṣu ramyāṇi santi kāñcanasamabhiḥ | saṃpūrṇāni mahāratnaiḥ karadaṣṭadivākaraiḥ ||65|| saṃdhyākāro manohādaḥ suvelaḥ kāñcano hariḥ | yodhano jaladhidhvāno haṃsadvīpo marakṣamaḥ||66|| arddhasvargotkaṭāvatī vighaṭo rodhano'malaḥ | kāntaḥ sphuṭataṭo ratnadvīpastoyāvalī saraḥ ||67|| alaṅghano namomānuḥ kṣemamityevamādayaḥ | āsan ye ramaṇodeśā devānāṃ nirupadravāḥ ||68|| ta eva sāṃprataṃ jātā bhūripuṇyairupārjitāḥ | purāṇāṃ saṃniveśā vo nānāratnavasuṃdharāḥ ||69|| dūto'varottare bhāge samudvapariveṣṭite | śatatrayamatikramya yojanānāmalaṃ pṛthuḥ ||7|| atiśākhāmṛgadvīpaḥ prasiddho bhuvanatraye | yasminnavāntaradvīpāḥ santi ramyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||7||
puṣparāgamaṇerbhābhiḥ kvacit prajvalatīva yaḥ | sasyairiva kvacicchanno harinmaṇimarīcimiḥ ||72|| tumheṃ choḍa़neko samartha nahīṃ hai aura tuma bhī mere premapāśako choḍa़kara kaise jāoge ||57|| śrīkaṇṭhase aisā kahakara kotidhavalane apane pitāmahake kramase āgata mahābuddhimān ānanda nāmaka mantrīko bulākara kahā ||58|| .ki tuma cirakālase mere nagaroṃkī sāratā aura asāratāko acchī taraha jānate ho ataḥ śrīkaṇṭhake lie jo nagara sārabhūta ho so kaho ||59|| isa prakāra kahanepara vṛddha mantrī kahane lagā| jaba vaha vṛddha mantrī kaha rahā thā taba usakī sapheda dāḍha़ī vakṣaḥsthalapara hila rahī thī aura usase aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā māno hṛdayameṃ virājamāna svāmīko camara hī ḍhora rahā ho ||60| usane kahā ki he rājan ! yadyapi āpake nagaroṃmeṃ aisā eka bhī nagara nahīṃ hai jo sundara na ho tathāpi śrīkaṇṭha svayaṃ hī khojakara icchānusāra-jo inheṃ rucikara ho, grahaṇa kara leṃ ||61|| isa samudrake bīcameṃ aise bahutase dvīpa haiṃ jahā~ kalpavṛkṣoṃke samāna ākāravāle vṛkṣoṃse diśāeṃ vyāpta
rahī haiṃ ||6|| ina dvīpoṃmeṃ aise aneka parvata haiṃ jo nānā prakārake ratnoṃse vyāpta haiṃ, ū~ce-ū~ce śikharoṃse suśobhita haiṃ, mahādedīpyamāna haiṃ aura devoṃkī krīḍāke kāraṇa haiṃ ||6|| rākṣasa bhīma, atibhīma tathā unake sivāya anya sabhī devoṃne āpake vaṃśajoṃke lie ve saba dvīpa tathā parvata de rakhe haiṃ aisā pūrva paramparāse sunate āte haiṃ ||64|| una dvīpoṃmeṃ suvarṇamaya mahaloṃse manohara aura kiraṇoṃse sūryako ācchādita karanevāle mahāratnoṃse paripūrṇa aneka nagara haiṃ || 65 || una nagaroṃke nāma isa prakāra haiṃ-sandhyākāra, manohlāda, suvela, kāṃcana, hari, yodhana, jaladhidhvāna, haṃsadvīpa, bharakṣama, ardhasvargotkaṭa, āvarta, vighaṭa, rodhana, amala, kānta, sphūṭataṭa, ratnadvīpa, toyāvalī, sara, alaṃghana, nabhobhānu aura kṣema ityādi aneka sundara-sundara sthāna haiṃ| ina sthānoṃmeṃ deva bhī upadrava nahīṃ kara sakate haiṃ ||66-68|| jo bahuta bhārī puṇyase prāpta ho sakate haiṃ aura jahā~kī vasudhā nānā prakārake ratnoṃse prakāśamāna hai aise ve samasta nagara isa samaya āpake ādhīna haiṃ || 69 || yahā~ paścimottara bhāga arthāt vāyavya diśāmeṃ samudrake bīca tīna sau yojana vistāravālā baḍa़ā bhārī vānara dvīpa hai| yaha vānara dvīpa tīnoṃ lokoṃmeṃ prasiddha hai aura usameṃ mahāmanohara hajāroṃ avāntara dvīpa haiṃ ||70-71|| yaha dvīpa kahīṃ to puṣparāga maṇiyoṃkī lāla-lāla prabhāse aisā jāna paḍa़tā hai 1. vaighaṭo| 2. maṇibhābhiḥ ma. |

indranīlapramājālaistamaseva citaḥ kvacit | padmākaraśriyaṃ dhatte padmarāgacayaiḥ kvacit ||73|| bhramatā yatra vātena gagane gandhacārugā | hṛtā jānanti no yasminpatāma iti pakṣiṇaḥ ||74|| sphaṭikāntaravinyastaiḥ padmarāgaiḥ samatviṣaḥ | jñāyante calanādyatra saraḥsu kamalākarāḥ ||75|| mattairmadhvāsavāsvādācchakuntaiḥ kalanādibhiḥ | saṃbhāṣata iti dvīpān yaḥ samīpavyavasthitān ||76|| yatrauṣadhiprabhājālaistamo dūraṃ nirākṛtam | cakre bahulapakṣe'pi samāveśaṃ na rātriṣu ||77|| yatracchatrasamākārāḥ phalapuṣpasamanvitāḥ | pādapā vipulaskandhāḥ kalasvanaśakuntayaḥ ||78|| sasyaiḥ svabhāvasaṃpannaivīryakāntivitāribhiḥ | caladbhirmandavātena mahī yatra sakanukā ||79|| cikacendīvarairyatra ṣaṭpadaughasamanvitaiḥ | nayanairiva vīkṣante' dīrghikā bhrūvilāsibhiḥ ||80|| pavana kampanādyasmin sātkāraśrotrahāribhiḥ | puṇḍreorvipulairvādaiḥ pradeśāḥ pavanojjhitāḥ || 81 || ratnakāñcanavistīrṇaśilāsaṃghātaśobhanaḥ | madhye tasya mahānasti kiṣkurnāma mahīdharaḥ || 82 || trikūṭeneva tenāsau śṛṅgabāhubhirāyataḥ | āliṅgitā diśaḥ kāntāḥ śriyamāropitāḥ parām ||83|| ānandavacanādeva sānandaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ | śrīkaṇṭhaḥ kīrtidhavalaṃ prāhaivamati bhāratīm ||84|| tataścaitrasya divase prathame maṅgalārcite | yayau saparivāro'sau dvīpaṃ vānaralānchitam ||85||

māno jala hī rahā ho, kahīṃ hare maṇiyoṃkī kiraṇoṃse ācchādita hokara aisā suśobhita hotā hai māno dhānake hare-bhare paudhoṃse hī ācchādita ho ||72|| kahīṃ indranīla maṇiyoṃke kāntise aisā lagatā hai māno andhakārake samūhase vyāpta hī ho, kahīṃ padmarāga maṇiyoṃkī kāntise aisā jāna paḍa़tā hai māno kamalākarakī śobhā dhāraṇa kara rahā ho || 73 || jahā~ ākāśameṃ bhramatī huī sugandhita vāyuse hare gaye pakṣī yaha nahīṃ samajha pāte haiṃ ki hama gira rahe haiṃ || 74|| sphaṭikake bīcabīcameṃ lage hue padmarāga maṇiyoṃke samāna jinakī kānti hai aise tālāboṃ ke bīca praphullita kamaloṃsamūha jahā~ halana calanarūpa kriyāke dvārā hī pahacāne jāte haiṃ || 75 || jo dvīpa makarandarūpī madirā ke āsvādana se manohara śabda karanevāle madonmatta pakṣiyoṃse aisā jāna paḍa़tā hai māno samīpameṃ sthita anya dvīpoṃse vārtālāpa hī kara rahā ho || 76 || jahā~ rātrimeṃ camakanevālī auṣadhiyoṃkī kāntike samūhase andhakāra itanī dūra khadeḍa़ diyā gayā thā ki vaha kṛṣṇa pakṣakī rātriyoṃ meṃ bhī sthāna nahīṃ pā sakā thā || 77|| jahā~ke vṛkṣa chatroṃke samāna ākāravāle haiṃ, phala aura phūloṃse sahita haiṃ, unake skandha bahuta moṭe haiṃ aura unapara baiṭhe hue pakṣī manohara śabda karate rahate haiṃ | 78|| svabhāvasampanna - padmapurāṇe evaṃ nānāvidhāstasmin deśā vividhapādapaiḥ | maṇḍitā yān samālokya svargabhūrapi nekṣyate ||10|| 'jīvaṃjīvakayugmānā vyaktavācāṃ samaṃ śukaiḥ | ālāpaḥ sārikābhiśca tasminnadbhutakāraṇam ||10|| tataḥ nānātarucchāyāmaṇḍalastheṣu hāriṣu | ratnakāñcanadeheṣu puṣpāmodānulepiṣu ||102|| śilātaleṣu viśrabdhaṃ niviṣṭaḥ senayā samam | karaṇīyaṃ ca niḥśeṣaṃ sa cakre vapuṣaḥ sukham ||103|| tato nānāprasūnānāṃ haṃsasārasanādinām | vimalodakapūrṇānāṃ sarasā mīnakampinām ||104|| kiratāṃ puṣpanikaraṃ tarūṇāṃ ca mahātviṣām | jayaśabdamivodāttaṃ kurvatāṃ pakṣiniḥsvanaiḥ ||105|| nānāratnacitānāṃ ca bhūmāgānāṃ suśobhayā | yuktaṃ bhramati sa dvīpamita ścetaśca taṃ sukhī ||106|| tataḥ sa viharaṃstasminvane nandanasaṃnibhe | yathecchaṃ krīḍato'paśyad vānarān bahuvibhramān ||107|| acintayacca dṛṣṭvaitāṃ sṛṣṭerativicitratām | tiryagyonigatā hyete kathaṃ mānuṣasaṃnibhāḥ ||108|| vadanaṃ pāṇipādaṃ ca śeṣāṃścāvayavānamī | dadhate mānuṣākārāṃśceṣṭāṃ teṣāṃ ca saṃnimām ||109|| tatastaimahatī rantaṃ prītirasya samucchritā | yathā sthiro'pyasau rājā nitāntaṃ pravaṇīkṛtaḥ ||110|| jagāda ca samāsannān puruṣān vadanekṣiṇaḥ | etānānayata kṣipramiti vismitamānasaḥ ||11|| ityuktaiḥ śataśastasya plavaṅgā gaganāyanaiḥ | upanītāḥ pramodena kṛtakelikalasvanāḥ ||112||

tadanantara vaha śrīkaṇṭha, nānā prakārake vṛkṣoṃkī chāyāmeṃ sthita, phūloṃkī sugandhise anulipta, ratnamaya tathā suvarṇamaya śilātaloṃpara senāke sātha baiṭhā aura vahīṃ usane śarīrako sukha pahuṃcānevāle samasta kārya kiye ||102-103|| tadanantara-jinameṃ nānā prakārake puṣpa phūla rahe the, haṃsa aura sārasa pakṣī śabda kara rahe the, svaccha jala bharā huā thā aura jo machaliyoṃke saṃcārase kucha-kucha kampita ho rahe the aise mālāoṃkī, tathā phūloṃke samūhakī varṣā karanevāle, mahākāntimān aura pakṣiyoṃkī bolīke bahāne māno jora-jorase jaya śabdakā uccāraṇa karanevāle vṛkṣoṃkī, evaṃ nānā prakārake ratnoṃse vyāpta bhūbhāgoṃ-pradeśoṃkī suṣamāse yukta usa vānara dvīpameṃ śrīkaṇṭha jahā~-tahā~ bhramaṇa karatā huā bahuta sukhī huā ||104-106|| tadanantara nandana vanake samāna usa vanameṃ vihāra karate hae śrīkaṇṭhane icchānusāra krīḍa़ā karanevāle aneka prakārake vānara dekhe||107|| saṣṭiko isa vicitratāko dekhakara śrīkaṇṭha vicāra karane lagā ki dekho ye vānara tiryaṃca yonimeṃ utpanna hue hai phira bhī manuṣyake samāna kyoṃ haiṃ ? ||108|| ye vānara mukha, paira, hātha tathā anya avayava bhī manuṣyake avayavoṃke samāna hī dhāraṇa karate haiṃ| na kevala avayava hī, inakī ceṣṭā bhī manuṣyoṃke samāna hai ||109|| tadanantara una vānaroṃke sātha krīḍa़ā karanekī śrīkaṇṭhake bahuta bhārī icchā utpanna huī| yadyapi vaha sthira prakṛtikā rājā thā to bhī atyanta utsuka ho uṭhā ||110|| usane vismita citta hokara mukhakī ora dekhanevāle nikaṭavartī puruṣoṃko ājñā dī ki ina vānaroṃko śīghra hī yahā~ lāo ||111|| kahanekī dera thī ki vidyādharoṃne saikaḍa़oṃ vānara lākara unake samīpa khaḍa़e kara diye| ve saba vānara harṣase kala-kala śabda kara rahe the ||112|| rājā śrīkaṇṭha uttama svabhāvake dhāraka una vānaroṃke sātha krīḍa़ā karane lagā| kabhī vaha tālī bajākara unheṃ nacātā thā, kabhī apanī bhujāoṃse unakā sparśa karatā thā aura kabhī 1. cakorayugalām | 2. mahatviṣām ma.| 3. -mivoddātaṃ ma.| 4. mānuṣākārāṃ ma.| 5. samutthitā ma. | 6. vadanekṣaṇa: ma. !

'vīkṣamāṇaḥ sitān dantān dāḍimopuṣpalohite | avaṭīṭe mukhe teṣāṃ bhāsvatkāñcanatārake || 114 || yūkāpanayanaṃ paśyan vinayena parasparam | premṇā ca kalahaṃ ramyaṃ kṛtakhotkāraniḥsvanam || 115 || śāliśukasamacchāyānmṛdimātiśayānvitān | vidhūtān mṛduvātena keśān sīmantamājinaḥ || 116 || karṇān vidūṣakāsaktaśravaṇākāradhāriṇaḥ | nitāntakomalaślakṣṇānacaladvapuṣāṃ spṛśan ||117|| vilomāni naya~ lomānyudare muṣṭamāpini | utkṣipaśca bhruvo'pāṅgadeśān rekhāvatastathā || 118 || tataste tena bahavaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ samarpitāḥ | mṛṣṭāśanādibhiḥ kartuṃ poṣaṇaṃ ratihetavaḥ || 119 || grāhayitvā ca tān kiṣkumārohadṛṣṭatamānasaḥ | prātrakūṭairlatābhiśca nirjharaistarubhistathā ||120|| tatrāpaśyat sa vistīrṇāṃ vaiṣamyarahitāṃ bhuvam | guptāṃ prānte mahāmānairgrāvabhiḥ sonnatadrumaiḥ ||121|| puraṃ tatra mahecchena khyātaṃ kiṣkupurākhyayā | niveśitamarātīnāṃ mānasasyāpi durgamam || 122 || pramāṇaṃ yojanānyasya caturdaśa samantataḥ | triguṇaṃ pariveṣeṇa leśataścādhikaṃ bhavet || 123 || saṃmukhadvāravinyāsā maṇikāñcanabhittayaḥ | pragrīvakasamāyuktā ratnastambhasamucchritāḥ || 124 || kapotapālyupānteṣu mahānīlavinirmitāḥ | ratnabhābhirnirastasya dhvāntasyevānukampitāḥ || 125 ||
anārake phūla ke samāna lāla, capaṭī nākase yukta evaṃ camakīlī sunahalī kanīnikāoṃse yukta unake mukhameṃ unake sapheda dā~ta dekhatā thā || 113 - 114|| ve vānara parasparameṃ vinayapūrvaka eka dūsare jue~ alaga kara rahe the, aura premase kho-kho śabda karate hue manohara kalaha karate the | rājā śrīkaṇṭhane yaha saba dekhā || 195 || una vānaroṃke bāla dhānake chilake ke samāna pīle the, atyanta komala the, manda manda vāyuse hila rahe the aura māṃgase suśobhita the | isī prakāra unake kāna vidūṣakake kānoṃke samāna kucha aṭapaṭā ākāravāle, atyanta komala aura cikane the | rājā śrīkaṇṭha unakā baḍa़e premase sparśa kara rahā thā aura isa mohanī surasurīke kāraṇa unake śarīra niṣkampa ho rahe the | 116-117|| una vānaroṃke kṛśa peṭapara jo-jo roma astavyasta the unheṃ yaha apane sparśaṃse ṭhīka kara rahā thā, sātha hī bhauṃhoṃko tathā rekhāse yukta kaṭākṣa- pradeśoṃ ko kucha-kucha ūpara kī ora uṭhā rahā thā || 118 || tadanantara śrīkaṇṭhane prītike kāraṇabhūta bahuta-se vānara madhura anna-pāna ādike dvārā poṣaṇa karaneke lie sevakoṃko sauṃpa diye || 119 || isake bāda pahāḍa़ ke śikharoṃ, latāoṃ, nirjharanoṃ aura vṛkṣoṃse jisakā mana harā gayā thā aisā śrīkaṇṭha una vānaroṃ ko livākara kiṣku parvatapara caḍha़ā || 120|| vahā~ usane lambī-cauḍa़ī, viṣamatārahita tathā antameṃ ū~ce-ū~ce vṛkṣoṃse suśobhita uttuṃga pahāḍa़oṃse surakṣita bhūmi dekhī || 121 || usī bhūmipara usane kiṣkupura nāmakā eka nagara basāyā| yaha nagara śatruoṃke śarīrakī bāta to dūra rahe manake lie bhī durgama thā || 122 || yaha nagara caudaha yojana lambā-cauḍa़ā thā aura isakī paridhi - golāī bayālīsa yojanase kucha adhika thī || 123 || isa nagara meṃ vidyādharoṃne mahaloṃkī aisī-aisī ū~cī śreṇiyā~ banākara taiyāra kī thīṃ ki jinake sāmane uttuṃga daravāje the, jinakī dīvāleṃ maṇi aura suvarṇase nirmita thīṃ, jo acche-acche baraṇḍoṃse sahita thīṃ, ratnoṃke khambhoṃpara khaḍa़ī thīṃ| jinakī kapotapālī ke samīpakā bhāga mahānīla maṇiyoṃse banā thā aura aisā jāna paḍa़tā thā ki ratnoṃkī kāntine jisa andhakārako saba jagahase khadeḍa़kara dūra kara kiyā thā māno use yahā~ anukampāvaśa sthāna hī diyā gayā thā| jina mahaloṃkī deharī padmarāgamaṇiyoṃse nirmita honeke kāraṇa lāla-lāla dikha rahī thīṃ isalie aisī jāna paḍa़tī thī māno tāmbūlake dvārā jisakī lālī baḍha़ gayī thī aisā oṭha hī dhāraṇa kara rahī hoṃ | jinake daravājoṃke ūpara aneka motiyoṃkī mālāeṃ laṭakāyī gayī thīṃ

atikrāntā~stato dṛṣṭvā mānuṣottaraparvatam | gīrvāṇanivahān sarvān paramaṃ śokamāgataḥ ||13|| paridevamatho cakre bhagnotsāho gatadyutiḥ | hā kaṣṭaṃ kṣudraśaktīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ dhigunnatim ||14|| nandīśvare jinendrāṇāṃ pratimānāṃ mahātviṣām | akṛtrimeṇa bhāvena kariṣyāmīti darśanam ||145|| pūjāṃ ca vividhaiḥ puṣpai— pairgandhaiśca hāribhiḥ | namaskāraṃ ca śirasā dharāsaṃsaktamaulinā ||16|| ye kṛtā mandamāgyena mayā cārumanorathāḥ | kathaṃ te karmabhirbhagnā aśubhaiḥ pūrvasaṃcitaiḥ ||17|| athavā śrutamevāsīnmayā mānuṣaparvatam | atikramya na gacchanti mānuṣā ityanekaśaḥ ||148|| tathāpi śraddhayā tanme nitāntaṃ vṛddhiyaktayā| vismṛtaṃ gantamadyakto yato'smi svalpaśaktikaḥ ||14|| tasmāt karomi karmāṇi tāni yairanyajanmani | yātuṃ nandīśvaraṃ dvīpaṃ gatimeṃ na vihanyate ||150|| iti niśvitya manasā nyasya rājyabharaṃ sute | abhūnmahāmunirdhārastyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ ||15|| vajrakaṇṭhastataḥ sārdhaṃ cāruṇyā śriyamuttamām | bhuktvā kiṣkupure ramye śrutvopākhyānakaṃ pituḥ ||152|| 'aiśvayaṃ tanaye kṣiptvā prāpa daigambarī kriyām | kīdṛśaṃ tadupākhyānamityukto gaṇabhṛjagau ||153|| vaṇijau bhrātarāvāstā prītī strībhyāṃ viyojitau | kanīyān durvidho jyeṣṭhaḥ svāpateyo gṛhītavāk||15|| śreṣṭhinaḥ saṃgamādeva prāptaḥ śrāvakatāṃ parām | mṛgayājīvinā bhrātrā paramaṃ duḥkhito'bhavat ||155||
priyā padmābhāke sātha baiṭhakara rājā śrīkaṇṭha ākāśamārgase jā rahā thā parantu jaba mānuṣottara parvatapara pahu~cā to usakā āge jānā ruka gayā ||143|| isakī gati to ruka gayī parantu devoṃke samūha mānuṣottara parvatako ullaṃgha kara āge nikala gaye| yaha dekha śrīkaṇṭha parama śokako prāpta huā ||144|| usakā utsāha bhagna ho gayā aura kānti naṣṭa ho gayī| tadanantara vaha vilāpa karane lagā ki hāya-hāya, kṣudraśaktike dhārī manuṣyoṃkī unnatiko dhikkāra ho ||145|| 'nandīśvara dvīpameṃ jo jinendra bhagavānkī mahākāntiśālī pratimāe~ haiṃ meṃ niśchalabhāvase usake darśana karūṃgā, nānā prakārake puṣpa, dhūpa aura manohārī gandhase unakī pūjā karū~gā tathā pṛthvīpara mukuṭa jhukākara śirase unheṃ namaskāra karūṃgā' mujha mandabhāgyane aise jo sundara manoratha kiye the ve pūrvasaṃcita aśubha karmoṃke dvārā kisa prakāra bhagna kara diye gaye ? ||146-147|| athavā yadyapi yaha bāta maiṃne aneka bāra sunī thī ki manuṣya mānuṣottara parvatakā ullaṃghana kara nahīṃ jā sakate haiṃ tathāpi atiśaya vṛddhiko prāpta huī śraddhāke kāraṇa maiṃ isa bātako bhūla gayā aura alpaśaktikā dhārī hokara bhī jāneke lie tatpara ho gayā ||148-149|| isalie aba maiṃ aise kārya karatā hū~ ki jisase anya janmameṃ nandīśvara dvīpa jāneke lie merī gati roko na jā sake ||150|| aisā hṛdayase niścaya kara śrīkaṇṭha, putrake lie rājya sauṃpakara, samasta parigrahakā tyāgī mahāmuni ho gayā ||151||
tadanantara śrīkaṇṭhakā putra vajrakaṇṭha apanī cāruṇo nāmaka vallabhāke sātha mahāmanohara kiṣkapurameṃ utkṛṣṭa rājyalakṣmīkā upabhoga kara rahā thā ki usane eka dina vṛddhajanoṃse apane pitāke pūrvabhava sune | sunate hī usakā vairāgya baḍha़ gayā aura putrake lie aiśvarya sauṃpakara usane jinadīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī| yaha sunakara rājā śreṇikane gautama gaṇadharase pūchā ki śrīkaṇṭhake pūrvabhavakā varṇana kaisā thā jise sunakara vanakaṇṭha tatkāla virakta ho gayā| uttara meṃ gaṇadhara bhagavān kahane lage ||152-153|| ki pūrvabhavameṃ do bhāī vaṇik the, donoṃmeṃ parama prīti thī parantu siyoṃne unheṃ pṛthakpṛthak kara diyā| unameṃ choṭā bhāī daridra thā aura baḍa़ā bhāī dhanasampanna thā| baḍa़ā bhāī kisī seṭhakā ājñākārī thā so usake samāgamase vaha śrāvaka avasthāko prāpta huā parantu choṭā bhāī śikāra ādi kuvyasanoṃmeṃ phaṃsā thā| choṭe bhāīkī isa daśāse baḍa़ā bhāī sadā duḥkhī rahatā thā 1. aiśvarya ma.| 2. tanayaṃ ma.| 3. prīte ma.| 4. svāpateyaṃ dhanamasti yasya sa svāpateyī dhanavānityarthaḥ | 5. gṛhītavān kha.|

caṃcala ho uṭhe, sabake dekhate-dekhate hī usakī ā~khoṃkī putaliyāṃ bhayase ghūmane lagīṃ, usake sāre śarīrase romāṃca nikala āye aura unase vaha aise jāna paḍa़ne lagī māno śarīradhārī bhayako hī dikhā rahī ho| usake lalāṭapara jo tilaka lagā thā vaha svedajalakī būṃdoṃse milakara phaila gayā| yadyapi vaha bhayabhīta ho rahī thī to bhī usakī ceṣṭāe~ uttama thīṃ| antameṃ vaha itanī bhayabhīta huī ki rājā amaraprabhase lipaṭa gayī ||168-170|| rājā amaraprabha pahale jina vānaroṃko dekhakara prasanna huā thā aba unhīṃ vānaroṃke prati atyanta krodha karane lagā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki strīkā abhiprāya dekhakara sundara vastu bhī rucikara nahīṃ hotī ||171|| tadanantara usane kahā ki hamāre vivāhameṃ aneka ākāroṃke dhāraka tathā bhaya utpanna karanevāle ye vānara kisane citrita kiye haiṃ ? ||172|| niścita hī isa kāryameṃ koī manuṣya mujhase īrṣyā karanevālā hai so śīghra hī usakī khoja kī jāye, maiṃ svayaṃ hī usakā vadha karū~gā ||173|| tadanantara rājā amaraprabhako krodharūpī gaharī guhāke madhya vartamāna dekhakara mahābuddhimān vṛddha mantrī madhura śabdoṃmeṃ kahane lage ||174|| ki he svāmin ! isa kāryameṃ āpase dveṣa karanevālā koī bhī nahīṃ hai | bhalā, āpake sātha jisakā dveṣa hogā usakā jīvana hī kaise raha sakatā hai ?
