catuḥsamudraparyante nāgamyantarasaṃkule | tiṣṭhatvatra yathācchandaṃ jambūdvīpatale bhavān ||342|| dvīpasyāsya samastasya vasitāhamakaṇṭakaḥ | yathepsitaṃ carestasminuddharan śatrusaṃhatim ||343|| prasanne mayi te vassa smṛtimātrapuraḥsthite | īpsitavyāhatau śakto na śakro'pi kuto'pare ||344|| drāṣiṣṭhaṃ jīva kālaṃ tvaṃ bhrātṛbhyāṃ sahitaḥ sukhī | varddhantāṃ bhūtayo divyā bandhusevyāḥ sadā tava ||345|| ityāśībhiḥ samānandha satyābhistān punaḥ punaḥ | jagāma svālayaṃ yakṣaḥ parivārasamanvitaḥ ||346|| taṃ ratnaśravasaṃ śrutvā vidyāliṅgitavigraham | sarvato rakṣasāṃ saṅghāḥ prāptāḥ kṛtamahotsavāḥ ||347|| unnataṃ nanṛtuḥ keciccakrurāsphoṭanaṃ tathā | kecit pramodasaṃpūrṇāḥ saṃbhūtā na svavigrahe ||348|| 'udāttaṃ naditaṃ kaiścicchatrupakṣamayaṃkaram | sudhayeva namaḥ kaiścilimpanirhasitaṃ ciram ||349|| sumālī mālyavān sūryarajā ṛkṣarajāstathā | āgatā nitarāṃ prītāḥ samāruhyottamān rathān ||350|| anye ca svajanāḥ sarve vimānairvājibhirgajaiḥ | svadeśebhyo viniṣkrāntāstrāsena parivarjitāḥ ||351|| atha ratnaśravāḥ putrasnehasaṃpūrṇamānasaḥ | vaijayantīmirākāśaṃ śuklīkurvanirantaram ||352|| vibhūtyā parayā yukto vandivṛndairabhiṣṭutaḥ | saṃprāpto rathamārūḍho mahāprāsādasaṃnimam ||353|| ekībhūya vrajanto'mī pañcasaṃgamaparvate | duḥkhena rajanīṃ ninyurarātimayayogataḥ ||354|| tato gurūn praṇāmena samāśleṣaṇataḥ sakhīn | snigdhena cakṣaṣā bhṛtyān jagṛhuḥ kaikasīsutāḥ ||355||
he mahābuddhiman ! maiṃ tumhāre vīryase bahuta prasanna hū~ ||341|| ataḥ jisake antameṃ pūrva, paścima, uttara, dakṣiṇa isa prakāra cāra samudra haiṃ tathā jo nāgakumāra aura vyantara devoṃse vyāpta hai aise isa jambūdvīpameṃ icchānusāra raho||342|| maiṃ isa samasta dīpakā adhipati hū~, merā koī bhī pratidvandvī nahīṃ hai ataḥ tumheṃ varadāna detā hū~ ki tuma śatrusamūhako ukhāḍa़te hue isa jambūdvīpameṃ icchānusāra sarvatra vicaraṇa karo ||343|| he vatsa ! maiṃ tujhapara prasanna haiṃ aura tere smaraṇa mātrase sadā tere sāmane khaḍa़ā rahū~gā| mere prabhāvase tere manorathameṃ bādhā pahuṃcāne ke lie indra bhī samartha nahīṃ ho sakegā phira sādhāraṇa manuṣyakī to bāta hī kyā hai ? ||344|| tū apane donoṃ bhāiyoṃke sātha sukhī rahatā huā dīrgha kāla taka jīvita raha | terī divya vibhūtiyā~ sadā baḍha़tī raheṃ aura bandhujana sadā unakā sevana karate raheṃ ||345|| isa prakāra yathārtha āśīrvādase una tīnoṃ bhāiyoṃko ānandita kara vaha yakṣa parivārake sātha apane sthānapara calā gayā ||346||
tadanantara daśānanako vidyāoṃse āliṃgita suna cāroṃ orase rākṣasoṃke samūha mahotsava karate hue usake samīpa āye ||347|| unameṃ koī to nṛtya karate the, koī tāla bajāte the, koī harṣase itane phūla gaye the ki apane śarīra meṃ hī nahīṃ samāte the ||348|| kitane hī loga śatrupakṣako bhayabhīta karanevālā jorakā siṃhanāda karate the, koī ākāśako cūnāse lipta karate hue ko taraha cirakāla taka ha~sate rahate the ||349|| prītise bhare sumālī, mālyavān, sūryaraja aura ṛkṣaraja uttamottama rathoṃpara savāra ho usake samīpa āye ||350|| inake sivāya anya sabhī kuṭumbījana, koī vimānoṃpara baiṭhakara, koī ghoḍa़oṃpara savāra hokara aura koī hāthiyoṃpara ārūḍha़ hokara āye| ve saba bhayase rahita the ||351|| athānantara putrake snehase jisakā mana bhara rahā thā aisā ratnaśravā patākāoṃse ākāśako nirantara śukla karatā huā baḍa़ī vibhūtike sātha āyā| bandījanoṃke samūha usakī stuti kara rahe the, aura vaha kisī baḍa़e rājamahalake samāna sundara rathapara savāra thā ||352-353|| ye saba milakara sātha hī sātha ā rahe the so mārga meṃ paṃcasaṃgama nāmaka parvatapara unhoṃne śatruke bhayake kāraṇa bahuta hī dukhase rātri bitāyī ||354|| tadanantara kekasīke putra daśānana 1. bhramaṇaṃ kuryāḥ | 2. śravajaṃ ma.| 3. praśaśaṃsuśca rāvaṇam ma.| 4. candrakānti tiraskurvat ma.| 5. mahāprasāda -ma.|

sumālī mālyavān sūryarajā ṛkṣarajāstathā | ratnaśravāśca tān snehādāliliṅguḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||369|| samaṃ bāndhavalokena bhṛtyavargeṇa cāvṛtāḥ | cakrurabhyavahāraṃ te svecchākalpitasaṃpadaḥ ||370|| gurupu prāptapūjeṣu tato vastrādidānataḥ | yathārha bhṛtyabarge ca saṃprāptapratimānane ||371|| viśrabdhā guravo'pṛcchaṃstān prītivikacekṣaṇāḥ | divasā niyato vatsāḥ sukhena susthitā iti ||372|| tataste mastake kṛtvā karayugmaṃ praṇāminaḥ | ūcunaḥ kuśalaṃ nityaṃ prasādād bhavatāmiti ||373|| mālinaḥ saṃkathāprāptaṃ kathayan maraṇaṃ tataḥ | sumālī śokabhāreṇa sadyo mūcchā samāgataḥ||374|| ratnaśravaḥsutenāsau tataḥ śītalapāṇinā | saṃspṛśya punarānīto jyeṣṭhena vyakacetanām ||375|| ānanditaśca tadvākyairūrjitairhimaśītalaiḥ | samastaśatrusaṃghātaghātabījāṅkurodgamaiḥ ||376|| puṇḍarīkekṣaṇaṃ paśyan sumālī taṃ tato'rbhakam | śokaṃ kṣaṇātsamutsṛjya punarānandamāgatāḥ ||377|| iti covāca taṃ hṛdyairvacobhirvitathetaraiḥ | aho vatsa tavodāraṃ sattvaṃ toṣitadaivatam ||378|| aho dyutiriyaṃ jitvā sthitā tava divākaram | aho gāmbhīryamutsāya sthitametannadīpatim ||379|| aho parākramaḥ kāntyā sahito'yaṃ jenātigaḥ | aho rakṣaḥkulasyāsi jātastāta viśeṣakaḥ ||380|| mandareṇa yathā jambūdvīpaḥ kṛtavibhūṣaṇaḥ | namastalaṃ śaśāṅkena yathā tigmakareṇa ca ||381|| suputreṇa tathā rakṣaḥkulametaddaśānana | tvayā lokamahāścaryakāriceṣṭena bhūṣitam ||382||

aṣṭamaṃ parva
athāsīdakṣiṇaśreṇyā bhāskarapratimo dyutau | suvīro'surasaṃgīte' pure mayakhageśvaraḥ ||1|| daityatvena prasiddhasya samaste tasya bhūtale| nāmnā hemavatī māryā yoṣidguṇasamanvitā ||2|| sutā mandodarī nāma sarvāvayavasundarī | tanūdarī viśālākṣī lāvaṇyajalaveṇikā ||3|| navayauvanasaṃpūrṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāmanyadā pitā | cintāvyākulitaḥ prāha dayitāmiti sādaram ||4|| ārūḍhā navatāruṇyaṃ vatsā mandodarī priye | guṇitevaitadīyā me cintāmānasamāśritā ||5|| kanyānāṃ yauvanārambhe saṃtāpāgnisamudbhave | indhanatvaṃ prapadyante pitarau svajanaiḥ samam ||6|| evamayaṃ dadatyasyā janmano'nantaraṃ budhāḥ | locanāñjalibhistoyaṃ duḥkhākulitacetasaḥ ||7|| aho bhinatti marmāṇi viyogo dehaniḥsṛtaiḥ | apatyairjanito nītairāgatyā saṃstutairjanaiḥ ||8|| tabrūhi taruṇī kasmai dadāmaitāṃ priye vayam | guṇaiḥ kulena kāntyā ca ka etasyāḥ samo bhavet ||9|| ityuktā prāha taṃ devī kanyānāṃ dehapālane | jananya upayujyante pitaro dānakarmaṇi ||10|| yatra te rucitaṃ dānaṃ mahyaṃ tatraiva rocate | bhartṛcchandānuvartinyo bhavanti kulabālikāḥ ||11|| ityukto mantribhiḥ sādhaṃ cakārāsau pradhāraṇam | kenacinmantriṇā kaściduddiṣṭaḥ khecarastataḥ ||12|| anyenendraḥ samudiṣṭaḥ sarvavidyādharādhipaḥ | tasmāddhi khecarāḥ sarve bibhyati pratikūlane ||13||
athānantara vijayārdha parvatakī dakṣiṇa śreṇīmeṃ asura-saṃgīta nāmakā nagara hai| vahā~ kānti meṃ saryakī upamā dhāraṇa karanevālā prabala yoddhā maya nāmakā vidyādhara rahatā thā| talameṃ daitya nāmase prasiddha thā| usakī hemavatī nāmakī strī thī jo striyoṃke samasta guṇoṃse sahita thī ||1-2|| usakī mandodarī nāmakī putrī thī| usake samasta avayava sundara the, udara kṛśa thā, netra viśāla the aura vaha saundaryarūpī jalakī dhārāke samāna jāna paḍa़tī thī||3|| eka dina navayauvanase sampūrṇa usa putrīko dekhakara pitā cintāse vyākula ho apanī strīse baḍa़e ādarake sātha bolā ki he priye ! putrī mandodarī navayauvanako prāpta ho cukī hai| ise dekha merī isa viṣayakī mānasika cintā kaī guṇī baḍha़ gayī hai ||4-5|| kisīne ṭhīka hī kahā hai ki santāparūpī agniko utpanna karanevāle kanyāoṃke yauvanārambhameṃ mātā-pitā anya parijanoṃke sātha hī sātha īndhanapaneko prāpta hote haiṃ ||6|| isīlie to kanyā janmake bāda duḥkhase ākulita hai citta jinakā aise vidvajjana isake lie netrarūpī aṃjalike dvārā jala diyā karate haiṃ ||7|| aho, jinheṃ aparicita jana ākara le jāte haiṃ aise apane śarīrase samutpanna santāna ( putrī ) ke sātha jo viyoga hotā hai vaha marmako bhedana kara detā hai ||8|| isalie he priye ! kaho, yaha tāruṇyavatī putrī hama kisake lie deveṃ | guṇa, kula aura kāntise kauna vara isake anurūpa hogā ||9|| patike aisā kahanepara rānī hemavatīne kahā ki mātāe~ to kanyāoṃke śarīrakī rakṣā karane meṃ hī upayukta hotī haiṃ aura unake dāna karane meṃ pitā upayukta hote haiṃ ||10|| jahā~ āpake lie kanyā denā rucatā ho vahīṃ mere lie bhī rucegā kyoṃki kulāṃganāe~ patike abhiprāyake anusāra hī calatī haiṃ || 11 || rānīke aisā kahane para rājāne mantriyoṃke sātha salāha kī to kisī mantrīne kisī vidyādharakā ullekha kiyā || 12|| tadanantara kisī dūsare mantrīne kahā ki isake lie indra vidyādhara ṭhīka hogā kyoṃ ki vaha samasta vidyādharoṃkā adhipati hai 1. saṃgītipure ma.| 2. samasti ma.| 3. niḥsute ma.|

tataḥ svayaṃ mayenoktaṃ yuṣmākaṃ vedmi no manaḥ | mahyaṃ tu rucitaḥ khyātaḥ siddhavidyo daśānanaḥ || 14 || bhavitāsau mahān ko'pi jagato'dbhutakāraṇam | anyathā jāyate siddhirvidyānāmāśu nālpake ||15|| tato'numenire tasya tadvākyaṃ pramudānvitāḥ | mārīcapramukhāḥ sarve mantriṇo mantrakovidāḥ || 16 || mantriṇo bhrātaraścāsya mārīcādyā mahābalāḥ | mārīco'sya tataścakre mānasaṃ tvarayānvitam ||17|| graheṣvabhimukhastheṣu saumyeṣu divase śubhe | krūragraheṣvapaśyatsu lagne kuśalatāvahe ||18 || kṛtyaṃ kālātipātena neti jñātvā tato mayaḥ | puṣpāntakavimānena prasthitaḥ kanyayānvitaḥ || 19|| tato maṅgalagītena pramadānāṃ namastalam | tūryanādasya vicchede' śabdātmakamivābhavat ||20|| puṣpāntakād viniṣkramya mīmāraṇye sthitā iti | yuvabhiḥ kathitaṃ tasya nirvṛtya prathamāgataḥ || 21 || taddeśavedibhiśvāraiḥ kathitaṃ tadvanaṃ tataḥ | calito'sāvapaśyacca meghānāmitra saṃcayam ||22|| cāraḥ kaściduvāceti paśyedaṃ deva sadvanam | snigdhadhvāntacayākāraṃ niviḍottuṅgapādapam || 23 || advervalāhakākhyasya sandhyāvartasya cāntare | mandāruṇamivāraṇyaṃ saṃmedāṣṭāpada gayoḥ || 24 || vanasya paśya madhye'sya śaṅkhaśubhra mahāgṛham | nagaraṃ śaradambhodamahāvṛndasamadyuti || 25 || samīpe ca purasyāsya paśya prāsādamunnatam | saudharmamiva yaḥ praṣṭumīhate śṛṅgakoṭibhiḥ || 26 ||

avatīrya namobhāgāt samīpe tasya veśmanaḥ | sānīkinī viśaśrāma cakāra ca yathocitam ||27|| tūryādiḍambaraṃ tyaktvā daityānāmadhipastataḥ | āptaḥ katipayairyukto vinītākalpaśobhitaḥ ||28|| abhimānodayaṃ muktvā sakanyaḥ prāptavismayaḥ| taṃ prāsādaṃ samārukṣatpratīhāraniveditaḥ ||29|| saptamaṃ ca talaṃ prāptaḥ krameṇa nibhṛtakramaḥ | vanadevīmivaikṣiṣṭa mūrtāmuttamakanyakām ||30|| athendunakhayā tasya kṛtābhyāgatesatkriyā | prapadyante paribhraṃśaṃ kulajñā nopacārataḥ ||31|| tataḥ sukhāsanāsīnaḥ sthitāṃ kanyocitāsane | apṛcchat praśrayādevaṃ tāṃ mayo vinayānvitām ||32|| vatse kāsi kuto vāsi kasmādvā kāraṇādiha | vasasi prabhaye'raṇye kasya cedaṃ mahāgṛham ||33|| ekākinyā kathaṃ cāsmin tirutpadyate tava | vapuruskṛṣṭametatte pīḍānāṃ naiva bhājanam ||34|| evaṃ pṛṣṭā satī bālā strīṇāṃ svābhāvikī trapā | mandaṃ vanamṛgī mugdhā jagādeti natānanā ||35|| ṣaṣṭhabhaktena saṃsādhya candrahāsamimaṃ mama | śailarājaṃ gato bhrātā vandituṃ jinapuṅgavān ||36|| daśavaktreṇa tenāhaṃ pālanārtha nirūpitā| ārya tiṣṭhāmi caitye'smin candraprabhavirājite ||37|| yadi ca syurbhavanto'pi draṣṭumeta samāgatāḥ | kṣaṇamātraṃ tato'traiva sthānaṃ kurvantu sajanāḥ ||38|| yāvadevaṃ samālāpo vartate madhurastayoḥ | tejasā maṇḍalaṃ

tadanantara daityoṃkā adhipati rājā maya turahī ādi vāditroṃkā āḍambara choḍa़kara tathā vinīta manuṣyoṃke yogya veṣa-bhūṣā dhāraṇakara kucha āptajanoṃke sātha usa mahalake samīpa pahu~cā| kanyā mandodarī usake sātha thī| mahalako dekhate hī rājā mayakā jahā~ ahaṃkāra chūṭā vahā~ use āścarya bhī kama nahīṃ haā| tadanantara dvārapālake dvārā samācāra bhejakara vaha mahalake ūpara ca ||28-29|| sāvadhānīse paira rakhatā huā jaba vaha kramase sātaveṃ khaṇḍameṃ pahu~cā taba vahā~ usane mūrtidhāriṇī vanadevīke samāna uttama kanyā dekhī ||30|| vaha kanyā daśānanakī bahana candranakhā thī so usane sabakā atithi-satkāra kiyā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki kulake jānakāra manuṣya yogya upacārase kabhī nahīṃ cūkate ||31|| tadanantara jaba maya sukhakārī āsanapara baiṭha gayā aura candranakhā bhī kanyāoṃke yogya āsanapara baiṭha cukī taba vinaya dikhātī huī usa kanyāse mayane baḍa़ī namratāse pūchā ||32|| ki he putri! tū kauna hai ? aura kisa kāraṇase isa bhayāvaha vanameṃ rahatī hai tathā yaha baḍa़ā bhārī mahala kisakā hai ? ||33|| isa mahalameṃ akelī rahate hue tujhe kaise dhairya utpanna hotā hai| terā yaha utkṛṣṭa śarīra pīḍākā pātra to kisī taraha nahīṃ ho sakatā ||34|| striyoṃke lajjā svabhāvase hī hotī hai isalie mayake isa prakāra pūchanepara usa satī kanyākā mukha lajjāse nata ho gayā| sātha hī vanakī hariṇīke samāna bholo thī hī ataḥ dhīre-dhīre isa prakāra bolī ki merā bhāī daśānana ṣaṣṭhopavāsa arthāt telāke dvārā isa candrahāsa khaḍgako siddha kara jinendra bhagavānko vandanā karane ke lie sumeru parvatapara gayā hai | daśānana mujhe isa khaḍgakī rakṣā karaneke lie kaha gayā hai so he ārya ! maiṃ candraprabha bhagavānse suśobhita isa caityālayameṃ sthita hū~| yadi āpa loga daśānanako dekhaneke lie āye haiṃ to kṣaṇa mātra yahīṃpara viśrāma kījie ||35-38||

vidyuddaṇḍena saṃyuktaṃ meghānāmiva taṃ cayam | avalokya samāsannamuttasthau saṃbhramānmayaḥ ||41|| kṛtvā yathocitācāramāsaneṣu punaḥ sthitāḥ' | maṇḍalāgrapramājālaśyāmalīkṛtavigrahāḥ ||42|| mārīcī vajramadhyaśca vajranetro namastaḍit | ugranako maruddhako medhāvī sāraṇaḥ śukaḥ ||43|| evamādyā gatāstoṣaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā daśānanam | ityūcurmaṅgalaṃ vākyaṃ daityanāthasya mantriṇaḥ ||44|| asmabhyaṃ tava daityeśa dhiṣaṇātigarīyasī | narāṇāmuttamo yena manasyeṣa niveśitaḥ ||45|| iti cāhurdaśagrīvamaho te rūpamujjvalam | aho praśrayasaṃbhāro vīyaṃ cātiśayānvitam ||46|| dakṣiṇasyāmayaṃ śreṇyāmasuraprathite pure | daityānāmadhipo nāmnā mayo bhuvanaviśrutaḥ ||47|| guṇaireṣa samākṛṣṭaḥ kumāra tava nirmalaiḥ | āyātaḥ kaṃ na kurvanti sajjanā darśanotsukam ||48|| svāgatādikamityāha tato ratnaśravaḥsutaḥ | satāṃ hi kulavidyeyaṃ yanmanoharabhāṣaṇam ||19|| sādhunā detyanāthena premadarśanakāriṇā | ucitena niyogena jano'yamanugṛhyatām ||50|| vacaḥ so'yaṃ tataḥ prāha tāta yuktamidaṃ tava | pratikūlasamācārā na bhavantyeva sādhavaḥ ||51|| dṛṣṭo'sī sacivestasya kautukākrāntamānaseḥ| kṛtānandaśca sadvākyaḥ punaruktaḥ samākulaiḥ ||52|| tato garbhagṛhaṃ ramyaṃ praviṣṭo'yaṃ subhāvanaḥ | cakāra mahatī pūjāṃ jinendrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||53|| stavāṃśca vividhānuktvā romaharṣaṇakāriṇaḥ | mastake'alimāsthāya cūḍāmaṇivibhūṣite ||54||
prabhāse sūryako niṣprabha karatā huā daśānana ā gayā hai ||40|| bijalīke sahita megharāśike samāna usa daśānanako nikaṭavartī dekha maya haḍa़baḍa़ākara āsanase uṭha khaḍa़ā huā ||41|| yathāyogya ācāra pradarśita karaneke bāda saṃba punaḥ āsanoṃpara ārūḍha़ hue| talavārakī kāntise jinake śarīra śyāmala ho rahe the aise mārīca, vajramadhya, vajranetra, nabhastaḍit, ugranaka, marudvaktra, medhāvī, sārasa aura śuka ādi mayake mantrī loga daśānanako dekhakara parama santoṣako prāpta hue aura nimnalikhita maṃgala vacana mayase kahane lage ki he daityarāja! āpakī buddhi hama sabase adhika śreṣṭha hai kyoṃki āpane hī isa puruṣottamako hṛdayameṃ sthāna diyā thā| arthāt hama logoṃkā isakī ora dhyāna nahīṃ gayā jabaki āpane isakā apane manameṃ acchī taraha vicāra rakhā ||42-45|| mayase itanā kahakara una mantriyoṃne daśānanase kahā ki aho tumhārā ujjvala rūpa āścaryakārī hai, tumhārā vinayakā bhāra adbhuta hai aura tumhārā parākrama bhī atiśayase sahita hai ||46|| yaha daityoṃkā rājā dakṣiṇaśreṇīke asarasaṃgīta nāmā nagarakā rahanevālā hai tathā saṃsārameṃ maya nāmase prasiddha hai| yaha āpake gaṇoṃse ākarṣita hokara yahā~ āyā hai so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki sajjana puruṣa kise darśanake lie utkaṇṭhita nahīṃ karate?||47-48|| taba ratnaśravāke putra daśānanane kahā ki āpakā svāgata hai| ācārya kahate haiṃ ki jo madhura bhāṣaṇa hai vaha satpuruṣoṃkī kulavidyā hai ||49|| daityoṃke adhipati uttama puruṣa haiṃ jinhoṃne ki hameṃ premapūrvaka darśana diye| maiṃ cāhatā hū~ ki ye ucita ādeśa dekara isa janako anugṛhīta kareṃ ||50|| tadanantara mayane kahā ki he tāta! tumheṃ yaha kahanā ucita hai kyoṃki jo uttama puruṣa haiṃ ve viruddha ācaraṇa kabhī nahīṃ karate ||51|| jinakā citta kautukase vyāpta thā aise mayake mantriyoṃne bhī daśānanake darśana kiye aura ākulatāse bhare tathā bāra-bāra kahe hue uttama vacanoṃse use ānandita kiyā ||52||

aṅgānāviṣayāṃ sṛṣṭi mapūrvāmiva karmaṇā | āhṛtya jagato'śeṣaṃ lāvaṇyamiva nirmitām ||6|| divākarakarasparśasvarbhānugrahabhītitaḥ | tārāpatiṃ parityajya kṣitiṃ kāntimivāgatām ||69|| sīmantamaṇibhājālaracitāsyāvaguṇṭhanām | hāreṇa vaktralāvaṇyasetuneva vibhūṣitām ||7|| karṇayorbālikālokānmuktāphalasamutthitā | sitasya sinduvārasya mañjarīmiva bibhratīm ||7|| kandarpadarpasaṃkṣobhaṃ sahate jaghanaṃ na yat | itīva veṣṭitaṃ kāñcyā maṇicakrakakāntayā ||72|| manojñāmapi tāṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhito'bhūt sa cintayā | nīyante viṣayaiḥ prāyaḥ satvavanto'pi vaśyatām ||73|| tasyāṃ mādhuryayuktāyāṃ dṛṣṭistasya gatā satī | abhavanmadhumatteva pratyānītāpi dhūrṇitā ||7|| acintayattadā nāma syādiyaṃ vanitottamā | hīḥ śrīlakṣmīrdhatiḥ kīrtiḥ prāptamūrtiḥ sarasvatī ||75|| kimūḍheyamutānūḍhā māyā vā kenacitkṛtā | aho sṛṣṭiriyaṃ mūrdhni sthitā nikhilayoṣitām ||76|| prāpnuyād yadi māmaitāṃ kanyāmindriyahāriṇīm | kṛtārtha nastato janma jāyate tṛṇamanyathā ||77|| cintayanta mimaṃ caivaṃ mayo'bhiprāyakovidaḥ | upanīya sutāmāha prabhurasyā bhavāniti ||78|| tena vākyena sikto'sāvamṛteneva tatkṣaṇāt | toṣasyevākarān jātān dadhe romāñcakaṇṭakān ||79|| tato'nayoḥ kṣaṇodbhutasarvavastusamāgamam | svajanānanditaṃ vṛttaṃ pāṇigrahaṇamaṅgalam ||8||
samaṃ tayā tato yātaḥ svayaṃprabhapuraṃ kṛtī | manyamānaḥ śriyaṃ prāptāṃ samastabhuvanāśritām ||81|| karmarūpī vidhātāne saṃsārake samasta saundaryako ikaṭṭhā kara usake bahāne strīviṣayaka apūrva sṛṣṭi hī māno racī thī ||68|| vaha sūryako kiraṇoṃkā sparśa tathā rāhugrahake ākramaṇake bhayase candramāko choḍa़kara pṛthvīpara āyī huī kāntike samāna jāna paḍa़tī thī ||69|| usane apane sīmanta ( mā~ga ) meṃ jo maṇi pahana rakhā thā usakī kāntikā samūha usake mukhapara ghūghaṭakā kāma detā thā| vaha jisa hārase suśobhita thī vaha mukhake saundaryake pravāhake samāna jāna paḍa़tā thā ||70|| usane apane kānoṃmeṃ motījaḍa़ita bāliyā~ pahana rakhī thīṃ so unakī prabhāse aisī jāna paḍa़tī thī māno sapheda sinduvāra (nirguṇḍī) kī maṃjarī hī dhāraṇa kara rahī ho ||71|| cūṃki jaghanasthala kāmake darpajanya kṣobhako sahana nahīṃ karatā thā isalie hī māno use maṇisamūhase suśobhita kaṭisūtrase veṣṭita kara rakhā thā ||72|| vaha mandodarī atyanta sundara thī phira bhī daśānana use dekha cintāse duḥkhī ho gayā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki dhairyavān manuṣya bhī prāyaḥ viṣayoṃke adhīna ho jāte haiṃ ||73|| mandodarī mādhuryase yukta thī isalie usapara paḍa़ī daśānanakī dṛṣṭi svayaṃ bhī māno madhuse matta ho gayī thī, yahī kāraṇa thā ki vaha usapara-se haṭā lenepara bhī naśāmeṃ jhūmatī thī ||74|| daśānana vicārane lagā ki yaha uttama strī kauna ho sakatī hai ? kyā hrī, śrī, lakṣmī, dhṛti, kīrti athavā sarasvatī hai ? ||75|| yaha vivāhita hai yā avivāhita ? athavā kisīke dvārā kī huī māyā hai ? aho, yaha to samasta striyoṃkī śirodhārya sarvaśreṣṭha sṛṣṭi hai ||76|| yadi maiṃ indriyoṃko haranevālī isa kanyāko prāpta kara sakū~ to merā janma kṛtakṛtya ho jāye anyathā tṛṇake samāna tuccha hai hī ||77|| isa prakāra vicāra karate hue daśānanase abhiprāyake jānanevāle mayane putrī mandodarīko pāsa le jākara kahā ki isake svāmī āpa haiṃ ||78|| mayake isa vacanase daśānanako itanā ānanda huā māno tatkṣaṇa amṛtase hī sīṃcā gayā ho| usake sāre śarīrameṃ romāṃca uṭha āye māno santoṣake aṃkura hī utpanna hue hoṃ ||79||
tadanantara jahā~ kṣaṇabharameṃ hī samasta vastuoṃkā samāgama ho gayā thā aura kuṭumbījana jahāṃ ānandase phūla rahe the aisā ina donoṃkā pāṇigrahaṇa-maṃgala sampanna huā ||80|| tadanantara daśānana kṛtakṛtya hotā huā mandodarīke sātha svayaṃprabhanagara gayā| vaha mandodarīko pākara aisā 1. -masarvā ma. | 2. jagatāśeṣa ma.| 3. lokāṃ ma.| 4. samutthitām ma.| 5. maṇicakrākāntayā kha.| 6. bhuvanadhitām ma.|

padmapurāṇe daśagrīveṇa sādha tāḥ punaḥ krīḍā pracakrire | anyonyāhaṃyutāṃ prāpya prathamopagamākulāḥ ||109|| saṃpratyeva hi sā krīḍā kriyate tena yā samam | śaśāṅkena vimuktānāṃ tārāṇāṃ kāmirūpatā ||110|| tataḥ kancukibhistāsāmāśu gatvā niveditam | janakebhya idaṃ vṛttaṃ ratnaśravasasaṃbhavam ||11|| tatasteḥ prahitāḥ krūrāḥ puruṣāstadvināśane | saṃdaṣṭauṣṭapuṭā baddhabhrakuṭīkoṭisaṃkaṭāḥ ||112|| vividhāni vimuñcantaste śastrāṇi samaṃ tataḥ | bhrakṣepamātrakeṇaiva kaikaseyena nirjitāḥ ||113|| bhayavepitasarvāṅgāstataste'marasundaram | vyajñāpayan samāgasya śastranirmuktapāṇayaḥ ||114|| gṛhāṇa jīvanaṃ nātha hara vā naḥ kulāṅganāḥ | chindhi tā caraṇī pāṇī grīvāṃ vāna vayaṃ kṣamāḥ ||115|| kanyānivahamadhyasthaḥ ko'pi dhīro virājate | sarendrasundaraḥ kāntyā samāno rajanīpateḥ ||11|| kraddhasya tasya no daṣṭi devāḥ śakrapurassarāḥ | saheran kimuta kṣudrā aspattalyāḥ śarīriṇaḥ ||117|| rathanapuranāthendraprabhṛtyuttamamānavāḥ| vīkṣitā bahavo'smābhirayaṃ tu paramādataḥ ||11|| evaṃ śrutvā mahākrodharaktāsyo'marasundaraḥ | nirait saṃnā saṃyukto budhena kanakena ca ||119|| anye ca bahavaḥ śūrāḥ patayo vyomagāminām | niścakramurviyaddīptaṃ kurvāṇāḥ śastraraśmibhiḥ ||12|| tatastānāyato dṛṣṭā tā bhayākulamānasāḥ | vidyādharasutā ūcuridaṃ ratnaśravaḥsutam ||121|| asmatprayojanānātha prāpto'syatyantasaṃśayam | puṇyahīnā vayaṃ kaṣṭaṃ sarvā apyapalakṣaṇāḥ ||122||
gandharva vidhise usa prakāra vivāha liyā ki jisa prakāra candramā tārāoṃke samūhako vivāha letā hai ||108||
tadanantara 'maiṃ pahale pahu~cū~, maiṃ pahale pahu~cū~' isa prakāra parasparameṃ hoḍa़ lagākara ve kanyāe~ daśānanake sātha punaḥ krīḍā karane lagīṃ ||109|| jo kanyā daśānanake sātha krīḍa़ā karatī thī vahī bhalī mālūma hotī thī so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki candramāse rahita tārāoṃkī kyā śobhā hai ? ||110|| tadanantara jo kaṃcukī ina kanyāoṃke sātha vāpikāpara āye the unhoṃne śīghra hī jākara kanyāoṃke pitāse daśānanakā yaha vṛttānta kaha sunāyā||111|| taba kanyāoṃke pitāne daśānanako naṣṭa karaneke lie aise krūra puruṣa bheje ki jo krodhavaśa oṭhoṃko ḍaṃsa rahe the tathā baddha bhauṃhoṃke agrabhāgase bhayānaka mālūma hote the ||112|| ve saba eka hī sātha aneka prakārake śastra calā rahe the para daśānanane unheṃ bhauṃha uṭhāte hī jīta liyā ||113|| tadanantara jinakā sārā śarīra bhayase kāṃpa rahā thā tathā jinake hāthase śastra chūṭa gaye the aise ve saba puruṣa rājā surasundarake pāsa jākara kahane lage ||114|| ki he nātha ! cāhe hamārā jīvana hara lo, cāhe hamāre hātha-paira tathā garadana kāṭa lo para hama usa puruṣako naṣṭa karanemeṃ samartha nahīṃ haiṃ ||115|| indrake samāna sundara tathā kāntise candramākī tulanā karanevālā koī eka dhīra-vīra manuṣya kanyāoṃke bīcameṃ baiṭhā huā suśobhita ho rahā hai ||116|| so jaba vaha kruddha hotā hai taba usakī dṛṣṭiko indra ādi deva bhī sahana nahīṃ kara sakate phira hamāre jaise kṣudra prāṇiyoṃkī to bāta hī kyā hai ? ||117|| rathanūpura nagarake rājā indra ādi bahuta-se uttama puruṣa hamane dekhe haiṃ para yaha una sabameṃ parama ādarako prāpta hai ||118||
yaha sunakara, bahuta bhārī krodhase jisakā muṃha lāla ho rahā thā aisā rājā surasundara rājā kanaka aura budhake sātha taiyāra hokara bāhara nikalā ||119|| inake sivāya aura bhī bahuta-se śūravīra vidyādharoṃke adhipati śastroṃkī kiraṇoṃse ākāśako dedīpyamāna karate hue bāhara nikale ||120|| tadanantara unheṃ ātā dekha, jinakā mana bhayase vyākula ho rahā thā aisī ve vidyādhara kanyāe~ daśānanase bolī ki he nātha ! āpa hamāre nimittase atyanta saṃśayako prāpta hue haiṃ| yathārthameṃ hama saba puṇyahīna tathā śubhalakṣaṇoṃse rahita haiṃ ||121-122||

uttiṣṭha śaraṇaṃ gaccha kaṃcinnātha prasīda naḥ | utpatya gaganaṃ kṣipraṃ rakṣa prāṇān sudurlabhān ||123|| asmin vā bhavane jaine bhūtvā pracchanna vigrahaḥ | tiṣṭha yāvadime karā nekṣante bhavatastanum ||124|| śrutvā vākyamidaṃ dīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca nikaṭaṃ balam | site kumudavattena netre padmanibhe kṛte ||125|| uvāca ca na māṃ nūnaṃ vicchayadvadathedaśam | kimemiḥ kriyate kākaiḥ saṃbhayāpi garutmataḥ ||126|| ekākī pṛthukaḥ siṃhaḥ prasphuratsitakesaraḥ | kiṃ vā nānayate dhvaṃsaṃ yūthaṃ samadadantinām ||127|| idaṃ tāḥ punarūcustaṃ yadyevaṃ nātha manyase | tato'smākaṃ pitṛna rakṣa bhrātaśca svajanāṃstathā ||128|| evamastu priyā yūyaṃ mā bhaiṣṭati sa sāntvanam | kurute yāvadetāsāṃ tāvabalamupāgatam ||129|| tato vimānamāruhya kṣaṇādvidyāvinirmitam | khamāruhya daśagrīvo dantadaṣṭaradacchadaḥ ||13|| ta evāvayavāstasya prāpya yuddhamahotsavam | duḥkhena mānamākāśe prāptā romāñcakarkaśāḥ ||531|| tasyopari tato yodhāścikṣipuḥ śastrasaṃhatīḥ| dhārā iva ghanasthūlāḥ parvatasya ghanāghanāḥ ||132|| tato'sau śastrasaṃghātaṃ kāmiścid vinyavārayat | kāmiścitta ripuvātaṃ śilābhirbhayamānayat ||133|| varākainihatairemiḥ khecaraiḥ kiṃ mametyasau | cintayitvā pradhānāṃstrīn tāṃścakre netragocaram ||134|| tāmasena tato'streṇa mohayitvā gatakriyāḥ | nāgapāśestrayo'pyete baddha vā tāsāmupāhṛtāḥ ||135|| mocitāste tatastābhiḥ pūjāṃ ca parilambhitāḥ | śūrasvajanasaṃprāpta saṃmadaṃ ca samāgatāḥ ||136||

padmapurāṇe uvācedaṃ tathā dūto vākyālaṅkārasaṃjñitaḥ | samakṣaṃ daśavaktrasya sumālinamiti kramāt ||165|| samastabhuvanavyāpikīrtivaiśravaṇaśrutiḥ' | vadatīdaṃ mahārājo bhavantaṃ kuru cetasi ||166|| paṇḍito'si kulīno'si lokajño'si mahānasi | akāryasaṃgabhīto'si deśako'si suvartmasu ||167|| evaṃvidhasya te yuktaṃ kurvantaṃ śiśucāpalam | pramattacetasaṃ pautraṃ nivārayitumātmanaḥ ||16|| tiraścāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca prāyo bhedo'yameva hi | kṛtyākṛtyaṃ na jānanti yadeke'nyattu tadvidaḥ ||169|| vismaranti ca no pūrva vṛttāntaṃ dṛḍhamānasāḥ | jātāyāmapi kasyāñcidbhūtau vidyutsamadyutau ||170|| śāntiaulivadhenaiva śeṣasya syāt kulasya te | ko hi svakulanirmūladhvaṃsahetukriyāṃ bhajet ||17|| samudrīcisaṃsaktaḥ śakrasya dhvastavidviṣaḥ | pratāpo vismṛtaḥ kiṃ te yato'nucitamīhate ||172|| sa tvaṃ krīḍasi maṇḍūko daṃṣṭrākaṇṭakasaṃkaṭe | vaktrarandhre bhujaṅgasya viṣāgnikaṇamocini ||173|| niyantumatha śaknoṣi naitaṃ taskaradārakam | tato mamārpayāyava karomyasya niyantraṇam ||17|| naivaṃ cet kurute paśya tataścārakaveśmani | nigaḍaiḥ saṃyutaṃ pautraṃ yātyamānamanekadhā ||175|| alaṃkārodayaṃ tyaktvā ciraṃ kālamavasthitaḥ | tadeva vivaraṃ bhūyaḥ praveṣṭumabhivānchasi ||176|| kupite mayi śake vā na te'sti śaraṇaṃ bhuvi | jalabudabudavadvātādacirādeva naśyasi ||177||

tataḥ śvāsān vimuñcantīmaśrubindūnanāratam | hariṣeṇaḥ samālokya jananomityavocata || 290|| mātaḥ kasmādidaṃ pūrva svapne'pi na niṣevitam | tvayā rodanamārabdhamamaṅgalamalaṃ vada || 291 || tayoktaṃ sa tataḥ śrutvā hetumevaṃ vyacintayat | kiṃ karomi guroḥ pīḍā prāpteyaṃ kathamoritā || 292 || pitāyaṃ jananī caiṣā dvāvapyetau mahāgurū | karomi kaṃ pratidveṣamaho magno'smi saṃkaṭe || 293|| asamarthastato draṣṭuṃ mātaraṃ sāśrulocanām | niṣkramya bhavanādyāto vanaṃ vyālasamākulam ||294|| tatra mūlaphalādīni bhakṣayan vijane vane | sarassu ca pivannambho vijahāra bhayojjhitaḥ || 295 || rūpametasya taṃ dṛṣṭvā paśavo'pi sunirdayāḥ | kṣaṇenopaśamaṃ jagmurbhavyaḥ kasya na saṃmataḥ || 296 || tatrāpi smaryamāṇaṃ tatkṛtaṃ mātrā prarodanam | 'vavādhe taṃ pralāpaśca kṛto gadgadakaṇṭhayā ||297|| ramyeṣvapi pradeśeṣu vane tatrāsya no dhṛtiḥ | babhūva kurvato nityaṃ bhramaṇaṃ mṛducetasā ||298|| vanadeva iti bhrānti kurvāṇo'sāvanāratam | dūravistāritākṣībhirmṛgīmiḥ kṛtavīkṣaṇaḥ || 299|| "samiyāyāṅgiraḥ śiṣyaśatamanyuvanāśramam | virodhaṃ dūramujjhitvā vanaprāṇibhirāśritam ||300|| campāyāmatha ruddhāyāṃ kālakalpākhyabhūbhṛtā | rudreṇa sādhanaṃ bhūri bibhratā purutejasā ||301|| yāvattena samaṃ yuddhaṃ cakāra janamejayaḥ | pūrvaṃ racitayā tāvatsudūragasuraṅgayā || 302 ||

cintayaniti cānyacca bahuduḥkhitamānasaḥ | vismṛto jananīśokaṃ sa babhrāma grahī yathā ||319|| paryaṭaśca bahūn deśān prāptaḥ sindhunadaṃ puram | tadavastho'pi vīryeṇa tejasā 'coruṇānvitaḥ ||320|| bahiḥ krīḍāviniṣkrāntastatra taṃ vīkṣya yoṣitaḥ | stammitā iva niśceṣṭāḥ spaṣṭākṣyaḥ śataśo'bhavan ||32|| puṇḍarīkekṣaṇaṃ merukaṭakodāravakṣasam | diṅmataṅgajakummāṃsamibhastambhasamorukam ||322|| unmattatvamupetānāmananyagatacetasām | paśyantīnāṃ na taṃ tṛptirbabhūva purayoṣitām ||323|| athāñjanagiricchāyaḥ pragaladdānanirbharaḥ | ājagāma gajastāsāṃ strīṇāmabhimukho balāt ||324|| na śaknomi gajaṃ dhatu kurutāśu palāyanam | yadi śaktiyutāḥ nārya ityāroheṇa coditam ||325|| naravṛndārakāsaktacetanāstā na tadvacaḥ | cakruḥ śravaṇayornāpi samarthāḥ prapalāyitum ||326|| muhuḥ pracaṇḍamārohe tato raṭati cetitam | vanitābhirbabhūvuśca bhavyavyākulacetasaḥ ||327|| tatastāḥ śaraṇaṃ jagmustaṃ naraṃ kṛtakampanāḥ | bhayenopakṛtaṃ tāsāṃ tatsamāgamacetasām ||328|| tataḥ sa karuṇāyukto hariṣeṇo vyacintayat | saṃbhrāntottamarāmāṅgasaṃgamāt pulakāñcitaḥ ||329|| itaḥ sindhurgabhīro'yamitaḥ śālo gajo'nyataḥ | saṃkaṭe tu pariprāpta karomi prāṇipālanam ||33|| vṛṣaḥ khanati valmīkaṃ śṛṅgābhyāṃ na tu bhūdharam | puruṣaḥ kadalīṃ chinte sāyakena śilā tu na ||33||
mṛduṃ parābhavatyeṣa lokaḥ prakhalaceṣṭitaḥ | uddhṛtyāpyasukhaṃ kartuṃ nābhivāñchati karkaśe ||332|| kabhīkā mara jātā| vāstavameṃ mere prāṇa usoke samāgamakī āśāse ruke hue haiṃ ||318|| jisakā mana atyanta duḥkhī thā aisā hariṣeṇa isa prakāra tathā anya prakārakī cintā karatā huā mātākā śoka bhūla gayā | aba to vaha bhūtākrānta mānavake samāna idhara-udhara ghūmane lagā ||319|| isa prakāra aneka deśoṃmeṃ ghūmatā huā sindhunada nāmaka nagarameṃ pahu~cā| yadyapi usakī vaisī avasthā ho rahī thī to bhī vaha bahata bhārī parākrama aura viśāla tejase yakta thā||320|| usa nagarakī ja krīḍa़ā karane ke lie nagarake bāhara gayī thīṃ ve hariṣeṇako dekhakara āścaryacakitakī taraha niśceṣṭa ho gayīṃ| ve saikaḍa़oṃ bāra āṃkheṃ phāḍa़-phāḍa़kara use dekhatī thīṃ||321|| jisake netra kamalake samāna the, jisakā vakṣaḥsthala meruparvatake kaṭakake samāna lambā-cauḍa़ā thā, jisake kandhe diggajake gaṇḍasthalake samāna the, aura jisakī jā~ghe hāthī bā~dhaneke khambheke samāna supuṣṭa thīṃ aise hariṣeṇako dekhakara ve striyā~ pāgala-sī ho gayīṃ, unake citta ṭhikāne nahīṃ rahe tathā use dekhane-dekhate unheṃ tṛpti nahīṃ huī ||322-323|| athānantara-aṃjanagirike samāna kālā aura jharate hue madase bharā eka hāthī balapūrvaka una striyoṃ ke sāmane āyā ||324|| hāthīkā mahāvata jora-jorase cillā rahā thā ki he striyo ! yadi tuma logoṃmeṃ śakti hai to śīghra hī bhāga jāo, maiṃ hāthīko rokanemeṃ asamartha hū~ ||325|| para striyā~ to śreṣṭha puruṣa hariṣeṇake dekhanemeṃ āsakta thīṃ isalie mahāvatake vacana nahīṃ suna sakī aura na bhāgane meṃ hī samartha huī ||326|| jaba mahāvatane bāra-bāra jorase cillānā śurū kiyā taba striyoṃne usa ora dhyāna diyā aura taba ve bhayase vyākula ho gayīṃ ||327|| tadanantara kā~patī huī ve striyā~ hariṣeṇakī śaraṇameṃ gayīṃ| isa taraha usake sātha samāgamakī icchā karanevālī striyoṃkā bhayane upakāra kiyā ||328|| tatpaścāt ghabaḍa़āyī huī uttama striyoṃke śarīrake samparkase jise romāṃca uṭha āye the aise hariṣeṇane dayāyakta ho vicāra kiyā ||329|| ki isa ora gahara hai. usa ora prākāra hai aura udhara hāthī hai isa taraha saṃkaṭa upasthita honepara maiṃ prāṇiyoṃkī rakṣā avaśya karū~gā ||330| jisa prakāra baila apane sīṃgoṃse vāmīko khodatā hai parvatako nahīṃ| aura puruṣa bāṇase keleke vṛkṣako chedatā hai śilāko nahīṃ ||331|| isī prakāra duṣṭa ceṣṭāoṃse bharā mānava 1. ca+ūruṇā = viśālena, cāruṇā ma.| 2. spaṣṭākṣāḥ | 2. śaknuvato ma.| 4. hastipake | 5. jñātam | 6. śālo'yamekataḥ ka. | 7. udvatyāpya ma.| 8. karkaśa: ka. |

klībāste tāpasā yena kṣamā teṣāṃ mayā kṛtā | sāraṅgasamavṛttīnāṃ nirvāsena kṛtāgasām || 333|| vasatāṃ gurugeheṣu kṣamātyantagarīyasī | kṛtā sā hi hitātyantaṃ saṃjātā paramodayā || 334 || uktameva tatastena tāraniṣṭhurayā girā | bho bho hastipakānyena naya deśena vāraṇam || 335|| tato hastipakenoktamaho te dhṛṣṭatā parā | yanmanuṣyaṃ gajaṃ vetsi svaṃ ca vetsi mataṅgajam ||336|| nūnaṃ mṛtyusamīpo'si yanmadaṃ vahase gaje | greheṇa vā gṛhīto'si brajāsmādāśu gocarāt ||337|| vihasya sa tataḥ kopāllīlayā kṛtanartanaḥ | sāntvayitvāṅganāḥ kṛtvā pṛṣṭato gajamabhyagāt || 338 || vidyudvilasitenāsau karuṇena tato nabhaḥ | utpatya daśane pādaṃ kṛtvā'rukṣanmataṅgajam ||339|| tataḥ krīḍitumārebhe gajena saha līlayā | dṛṣṭanaṣṭaiḥ samasteṣu gātreṣvasya punarbhuvi ||340|| pāramparyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā kṛtvā kalakalaṃ mahat | viniṣkrāntaṃ puraṃ sarva draṣṭumetanmahādbhutam ||341|| vātāyanagatāścekṣāṃcakrire taṃ mahāṅganāḥ | cakrurmanorathān kanyāstatsamāgamasaṃgatān ||342|| āsphālanairmahāśabdairmu hurgātravidhūnanaiḥ | kṛto'sau nirmadastena kṣaṇamātreṇa vāraṇaḥ || 343 || harmyapṛṣṭhagato dṛṣṭvā tadāścaryaṃ purādhipaḥ | sindhunāmākhilaṃ tasmai prajighāya paricchadam ||344|| tataḥ kuthākṛtacchāye nānāvarṇakamāsure | ārūḍhaḥ sa gaje tasmin vibhūtyā parayānvitaḥ || 345||

manāṃsi pauranārīṇāmuccinvan rūpapāṇinā| praviveśa puraṃ svedabindumuktāphalānvitaḥ ||346|| narādhipasya kanyānāṃ pariṇītaṃ tataḥ śatam | tena sarvatra cāsaktā hariṣeṇamayī kathā ||347|| mahāntamapi saṃprāptaḥ saṃmānaṃ sa nareśvarāt | strīratnena vinā mene tāṃ varṣamiva śarvarīma ||34|| acintayacca nūnaṃ sā mayā virahitādhunā | mṛgīvākulatā prāptā paramāṃ viṣame vane ||349|| sakṛdeṣā kathaṃciccet triyāmā kṣayameṣyati | gamiṣyāmi tato bālāmatāṃ dāganukampitum ||350|| vicintatyevametasmin śayanīye'tiśobhane | cireṇa nidrayā labdhaṃ padamatyantakṛcchutaḥ ||35|| svapne'pi ca sa tāmeva dadarśāmbhojalocanām | prāyo hi mānasasyāsya saiva gocaratāmagāt ||352|| atha vegavatī nāmnā kalāguṇaviśāradā | khecarādhipakanyāyāḥ sakhī tamaharat kṣaṇāt ||353|| tato nidrākṣaye dṛṣṭvā hriyamāṇaṃ svamambare | pāpe harasi māṃ kasmāditi vyāhṛtya kopataḥ ||354|| dṛṣṭaniḥśeṣatārākṣaḥ saṃdaṣṭaradanacchadaḥ | muṣṭiṃ babandha tāṃ hantuṃ vajramudgarasaṃnimām ||355|| tatastaṃ kupitaṃ dṛṣṭā puruṣaṃ cārulakṣaṇam | vidyābalasamṛdvāpi śaṅkitā setyabhāṣata ||356|| ārūḍhastaruśākhāyāṃ chinte tasyā yathā naraḥ | mūlaṃ tathā karoṣi tvaṃ mamāyuṣman vihiṃsanam ||257|| yadartha nīyate tāta vaṃ mayā tadgato bhavān | satyaṃ jñāsyasi nahyasya vapuṣastava duḥkhitā ||358|| acintayacca bhadreyaṃ vanitā cārubhāṣiṇī | ākṛtiḥ kathayatyasyāḥ parapīḍā nivṛttatām ||359||
ārūḍha़ huā ||345|| jo pasīnekī būṃdoṃke bahāne māno motiyoṃse sahita thā aisā hariṣeṇa apane saundaryarūpī hāthase nagarakī striyoṃkā mana saṃcita karatā huā nagarameṃ praviṣṭa huā ||34|| tadanantara usane rājākī sau kanyāoṃke sātha vivāha kiyā| isa prakārase jahā~ dekho vahīṃsarvatra hariṣeṇakī carcā phaila gayī ||347|| yadyapi usane rājāse bahuta bhārī sammāna prāpta kiyā thā to bhī tapasviyoṃke āśramameṃ jo strīratna dekhā thā usake binā usane eka rātako varṣake samāna samajhā ||348|| vaha vicāra karane lagā ki isa samaya niścaya hī vaha kanyā mere binā viṣama vanameṃ hariṇīke samāna parama ākalatāko prāpta hotī hogī ||349|| yadi yaha rātri kisī eka bāra bhī samāpta ho jāye to maiṃ śīghra hī usa bālāpara dayā karaneke lie dauḍa़ paḍa़eṃ gā ||350|| yaha atyanta suśobhita śayyāpara paḍa़ā huā aisā vicāra karatā rahā| vicāra karate-karate baḍa़ī dera bāda bahuta kaṭhināīse use nīṃda āyo ||351|| svapnameṃ bhī yaha usī kamala-locanāko dekhatā rahā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki prāyaḥ karake isake manakā vahī eka viṣaya raha gayī thī||352||

yathedaṃ spandate cakṣurdakṣiṇaṃ mama sāṃpratam | tathā ca kalpayāmyeṣā priyasaṃgamakāriṇī ||360|| punaścānena sā pṛṣṭā bhane vedaya kāraṇam | lalāmasaṃkathāsaṃgāta kareṃ tāvatpratapaya ||361|| jagāda ceti rājāsti pure sūryodaye vare | nāmnā śakradhanustasya bhāryā dhīriti kīrtitā ||362|| guṇarūpamadagrastā jayacandrā tayoḥ sutā | puruṣadveṣiṇī jātā pitṛvākyāpakarṇinī ||363|| yo yastasyā mayālikhya paṭake darśitaḥ purā | sakale bharatakṣetre nāsau tasyā rucau sthitaḥ ||364|| tato bhavān mayā tasyā darśitaḥ paṭṭakasthitaḥ| gāḍhākalpakaśalyena śalyitā cedamabravīt ||365|| kāmabhogopamānena samaṃ yadi na yujyate | mṛtyu tataḥ prapatsye'haṃ na tvanyamadhamaṃ varam ||366|| pratijñā ca purastasyā mayeyaṃ duṣkarā kṛtā | śokamatyutkaṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadguṇākṛṣṭacittayā ||367|| yadi taṃ nānaye śīghraṃ tvanmānasamalimlucam | jvālājaṭālamanilaṃ praviśāmi tataḥ sakhi ||368|| pratijñāyeti puṇyena prāpto'si mahatā mayā| tvatprasādākariṣyāmi pratijñāṃ phalasaṃgatām ||369|| sūryodayapuraṃ caiṣā prāptā sa ca niveditaḥ | ānītaḥ śakracāpāya kanyāyai ca manoharaḥ ||370|| tataḥ pāṇigrahaścakre tayoradbhutarūpayoḥ | vismayāpannacetomiḥ svajanairabhinanditaḥ ||371|| saṃpāditapratijñā ca prāptā vegavatī param | saṃmānaṃ rājakanyābhyāṃ pramadaṃ ca tathā yaśaḥ ||372|| tyaktvā nau dharaṇīvāso gṛhītaḥ puruṣo'nayā | iti saṃcintya kupitau tasyāmaithunikau ca tau ||373||
isakī ākṛti hī batalā rahī hai ki yaha para-pīḍa़āse nivṛtta hai arthāt kabhī kisīko pīḍa़ā nahīṃ pahuṃcātī ||359|| aura cū~ki isa samaya merī dāhinī ā~kha phaḍa़ka rahī hai isase niścaya hotā hai ki yaha avaśya hī priyajanoṃkā samāgama karāvegī ||360|| taba hariṣeṇane usase phira pūchā ki he bhadre ! tū ṭhīka-ṭhīka kāraṇa batā aura manohara kathā sunākara mere kānoṃko santuṣṭa kara ||361|| isake uttarameṃ vegavatīne kahā ki sūryodaya nāmaka śreṣṭha nagarameṃ rājā śakradhanu rahatā hai| usakī strī dhī nāmase prasiddha hai| una donoṃke jayacandrā nāmakī putrī hai jo ki guṇa tathā rūpake ahaṃkārase grasta hai, puruṣoṃke sātha dveṣa rakhatī hai aura pitāke vacanoṃkī avahelanā karatī hai ||362-363|| samasta bharata kṣetrameṃ jo-jo uttama puruṣa the una sabake citrapaṭa banākara maiṃne pahale use dikhalāye haiṃ para usakī rucimeṃ eka bhī nahīṃ āyā ||364|| taba maiṃne āpakā citrapaṭa use dikhalāyā so use dekhate hī vaha tīvra utkaṇṭhārūpī śalyase viddha hokara bolī ki kāmadevake samāna isa puruṣake sātha yadi merā samāgama na hogā to maiṃ mṛtyuko bhale hī prāpta ho jāū~gī para anya adhama manuṣyako prāpta nahīṃ hoū~gī ||365-366|| usake guṇoṃse jisakā citta ākṛṣṭa ho rahā thā aisī maiṃne usakā bahuta bhārī śoka dekhakara usake āge yaha kaṭhina pratijñā kara lī ki tumhāre manako curānevāle isa puruṣako yadi maiṃ śīghra nahīṃ le āū~ to he sakhi ! jvālāoṃse yukta agnimeṃ praveśa kara jāū~gī||367-368|| maiṃne aisī pratijñā kī hī thī ki baḍa़e bhārī puṇyodaya se āpa mila gaye | aba āpake prasādase apanī pratijñāko avaśya hī saphala banāū~gī ||369|| aisā kahatī huī vaha sūryodayapura ā pahu~cī| vahā~ ākara usane rājā śakradhanu aura kanyā jayacandrāke lie sūcanā de dī ki tumhāre manako haraṇa karanevālā hariṣeṇa ā gayā hai ||370|| tadanantara āścaryakārī rūpako dhāraṇa karanevāle donoṃ-varakanyākā pāṇigrahaṇa kiyā gayā| jinakā citta āścaryase bhara rahā thā aise sabhī ātmīya janoṃne unake usa pāṇigrahaṇakā abhinandana kiyā thā ||371|| jisakī pratijñā pūrṇa ho cukī thī aisī vegavatīne rājā aura kanyādonoṃkī orase parama sanmāna prāpta kiyā thā| usake harṣa aura suyaśakā bhī ṭhikānā nahīṃ thā ||372|| 'isa kanyāne hama logoṃko choḍa़kara bhūmigocarī puruṣa svīkṛta kiyā' aisā vicārakara 1. pitṛvākyāpakarṣiṇī ma. | 2. gāḍhākalpakaśilpena ma.| 3-4. ma. pustake'nayoḥ ślokayoḥ kramabhedo vartate | 5. maithunikācitau ma.|

alaṃkārodaya nagarako jaba rājā sūryarajane choḍa़ā thā taba candrodara nāmā vidyādhara tumhārī icchā ke pratikūla usa nagara meṃ jama gayā thā so use nikālakara mahābalavān kharadūṣaṇa tumhārī bahana ke sātha usameṃ raha rahā hai isa prakāra tumhāre svajana usase upakārako bhī prāpta hue haiṃ ||37-38 || yaha kahakara jaba mandodarī cupa ho rahī taba daśānanane kahā ki he priye ! yadyapi maiṃ yuddhase nahīṃ ḍaratā hū~ to bhī anya kāraṇoṃ ko dekhatā huā maiṃ tumhāre vacanoṃmeṃ sthita hū~ arthāt tumhāre kahe anusāra usakā pīchā nahīṃ karatā hū~ ||39|| athānantara karmoṃke niyogase candrodara vidyādhara kālako prāpta huā so usakī dīna-hīna anurādhā nāmakī garbhavatī strī śaraṇarahita ho tathā vidyāke balase śūnya ho hariṇīkī nāṃī bhayaṃkara vanameṃ idhara-udhara bhaṭakane lagī ||40 - 41|| vaha bhaṭakatī bhaṭakatī maṇikānta nāmaka parvatapara pahu~cī | vahā~ usane komala pallava aura phūloṃ ke samūhase ācchādita samaśilātalapara eka sundara putra utpanna kiyā || 42|| tadanantara jisakā citta nirantara udvigna rahatā thā, aura putrakī āśāse hī jisakā jīvana sthita thā aisī usa vanavāsinī mātāne kramakramase usa putrako baḍa़ā kiyā ||43|| cū~ki śatrune usa putrako garbhameṃ hī virādhita kiyā thā isalie bhogoṃ se rahita usa putrakā mātāne virādhita nāma rakhā || 44 || jisa prakāra apane sthāna - mastaka se cyuta hue keśakā koī ādara nahīṃ karatā usī prakāra usa virādhitakā pṛthivīpara koī bhī ādara nahīṃ karatā thā || 45|| vaha śatruse badalā lene meṃ samartha nahīṃ thā isalie manameṃ hī vaira dhāraṇa karatā thā aura kucha paramparāgata ācārakā pālana karatā huā icchita deśoṃ meṃ ghūmatā rahatā thā ||46|| vaha kulācaloṃ ke ūpara, manohara vanoṃ meṃ tathā jahā~ devoṃkā āgamana hotā thā aise atiśayapūrṇa sthānoṃ meṃ krīḍa़ā kiyā karatā thā ||47|| vaha dhvajā, chatra ādise sundara tathā hāthiyoṃ ādi vyāpta devoṃke sātha honevāle yuddhoṃ meṃ vīra manuṣyoṃkī ceṣṭāe~ dekhatā huā ghūmatā phiratā thā || 48 || athānantara utkṛṣṭa bhogoṃko prāpta karatā huā dedīpyamāna daśānana laṃkānagarī meṃ indrake samāna rahatā thā || 49 || so āścaryajanaka kārya karanevālī vidyāoṃse sevita balavān bālī usakī ājñākā atikrama karane lagā ||50|| tadanantara daśānanane bālīke pāsa mahābuddhimān dūta bhejā | so svāmīke garvako dhāraṇa karatā huā dūta bālīke pāsa jākara kahane lagā ki daśānana isa 1. -nurodhākhyā ma | 2 ato'yaṃ ma | 3. vṛttastho kha. |

ananyasadṛśaḥ kṣetre bharate'smin pratāpavān | mahābalo mahātejāḥ śrīmānnayaviśāradaḥ ||52 || mahāsādhanasaṃpanna ugradaṇḍo mahodayaḥ | ājñāpayati devastvāṃ śatrumardo daśānanaḥ || 53 ||
mārātiṃ samudvāsya bhavato'rkarajāḥ pitā | yayā kiṣkindhanāthatve sthāpito vānarānvaye ||54|| vismṛtya sukṛtaṃ kṛtyaṃ sa tvaṃ janayituḥ paramaṃ | kuruṣe pratyavasthānamiti sādho na yujyate || 55 || pituste sadṛśīṃ prītimadhikāṃ vā karomyaham | adyāpyehi praṇāmaṃ me kuru sthātuṃ yathāsukham ||56|| svasāraṃ ca prayacchemāṃ śrīprabhākhyāṃ mayā saha | saṃbandhaṃ prāpya te sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati sukhāvaham ||57|| ityukte vimukhaṃ jñātvā baliṃ praṇamanaṃ prati | ānanasya vikāreṇa dūtaḥ punarudāharat ||58|| kimatra bahunoktena kuru śākhāmṛga śrutau | madīyaṃ niścitaṃ vākyamalpalakṣmīviḍambiḥ || 99 || kuru sajjau karaṃ dātumādātuṃ vāyudhaṃ karau | gṛhāṇa caumaraṃ śīghraṃ kakubhāṃ vā kadambakam || 60 || śiro namaya cāpaṃ vā nayājñāṃ karṇapūratām | maurvī vā dussahārāvāmātmajīvitadāyinīm || 61 || matpādajaṃ rajo mūrdhni śirastramathavā kuru | ghaṭayāñjalimudvṛtya kariṇāṃ vā mahācayam ||62 || vimuñceṣaṃ dharitrīṃ vā majaikaṃ vetrakuntayoḥ | paśya me'ṅghrinakhe vaktramathavā khaḍgadarpaṇe || 63 || tataḥ paruṣavākyena dūtasyodrdhūtamānasaḥ | nāmnā vyāghravilambīti bamāṇa bhaṭasattamaḥ || 64 || samastadharaṇīvyāpiparākramaguṇodayaḥ | bālidevo na kiṃ yātaḥ karṇajāhaṃ kurakṣasaḥ ||65||
bharata kṣetrameṃ apanī śānī nahīṃ rakhatā | vaha atiśaya pratāpī, mahābalavān, mahātejasvī, lakṣmīsampanna, nītimeṃ nipuṇa, mahāsādhana sampanna, ugradaṇḍa denevālā, mahān abhyudayase yukta, aura śatruoṃkā māna mardana karanevālā hai | vaha tumheṃ ājñā detā hai ki ||51-53| maiṃne yamarūpī śatruko haṭākara āpake pitā sūryarajako vānaravaṃśameṃ kiṣkindhapurake rājapadapara sthāpita kiyā thā || 54 || tuma usa upakārako bhūlakara pitāke viruddha kārya karate ho | he satpuruṣa ! tumheṃ aisā karanā yogya nahīṃ hai ||55|| | maiṃ tere sātha pitāke samāna athavā usase bhī adhika pyāra karatā hū~| tū āja bhī ā aura sukhapūrvaka rahaneke lie mujhe praṇāma kara || 56 || athavā apanī śrīprabhā nāmaka bahana mere lie pradāna kara | yathārtha meṃ mere sātha sambandha prāpta kara lenese tere lie samasta padārtha sukhadāyaka ho jāyeṃge || 57 || itanā kahanepara bhī bālī daśānanako namaskāra karanemeṃ vimukha rahā | taba mukhakī vikṛti roṣa prakaṭa karatā huā dūta phira kahane lagā ki are vānara ! isa viṣaya meṃ adhika kahanese kyā lābha hai ? tū mere niścita vacana suna, tū vyartha hī thoḍa़ī-sī lakṣmī pākara viḍambanā kara rahā hai ||58-59 || tū apane donoṃ hāthoṃko yā to kara deneke lie taiyāra kara yā śastra grahaṇa karane ke lie taiyāra kara | tū yā to śīghra hī cāmara grahaṇa kara arthāt dāsa banakara daśānanake lie cāmara ḍhola yā diśāmaṇḍalako grahaṇa kara arthāt diśāoṃke anta taka bhāga jā || 60|| tū yā to śirako namra kara yā dhanuṣako namrībhūta kara | yā to ājñāko kānoṃmeṃ pūrṇa kara yā asahanīya śabdoṃse yukta tathā apanā jīvana pradāna karanevālī dhanuṣakī ḍorīko kānoṃmeṃ pūrṇa kara arthāt kānoṃ taka dhanuṣa kī ḍorī khīṃca || 61 || yā to merī caraṇarajako mastakapara dhāraṇa kara athavā sirakī rakṣā karanevālā ṭopa mastakapara dhāraṇa kara | yā to kṣamā mā~gane ke lie hātha joḍa़kara aṃjaliyā~ hāthiyoṃ baḍa़ā bhārī samūha ekatrita kara ||62|| yā to bāṇa choḍa़ yā pṛthivīko prāpta - kara | yā to vetra grahaṇa kara yā mālā grahaṇa kara | yā to mere caraṇoṃke nakhoṃmeṃ apanā mukha dekha yā talavārarūpī darpaṇa meṃ mukha dekha || 63|| tadanantara dūtake kaṭhora vacanoṃse jisakā mana udbhūta ho rahā thā aisā vyāghravilambī nāmaka pramukha yoddhā kahane lagā ||64 || ki re dūta ! jisake parākrama 1. ananyasadṛśe ma | sadṛśa kha | 2. kurute ma | 3. sādhorna ma | 4. viḍambita ma | 5. cāparaṃ ba., ma. | 6. karṇayoḥ samīpamiti karṇajāham 'taśya mūle kuṇabjāhacī' iti jāhac pratyayaḥ |

padmapurāṇe yadyevaṃ bhāṣate vyaktaṃ gṛhīto vā graheṇa saḥ | tvaṃ tu svasthaḥ kimityevaṃ dūtādhama vikatthase ||66|| krodhamūrcchita ityuktvā duḥprekṣyaḥ spaṣṭavepathuḥ | gṛhṇānaḥ sāyakaṃ ruddho bālineti ca coditaḥ ||67|| ki datena varākeṇa hatena preṣakāriṇā | kurvantyete hi nāthīyavacasaḥ pratiśabdakam ||68|| daśāsyasyaiva kartavyaṃ yadabhiprāyamāśritam | āyunūnamiyattasya kurute yatkubhāṣitam ||69|| tato bhīto bhṛśaṃ dūto gatvā vṛttāntavaṃdanāt | daśāsyasya paraṃ krodhaṃ cakraṃ duḥsahatejasaḥ ||70 sainyāvṛtaśca saṃnahya prasthitastvarayā puram | paramāṇubhirārabdhaḥ sa hi darpamayairiva ||71|| tataḥ parabaladhvānaṃ śrutvā vyomapidhāyinam | nirgantaṃ mānasaṃ cakre bāliḥ saṃgrāmadakṣiṇaḥ ||72|| tāvatsāgaravṛddhayādimantribhinayaśālibhiḥ | jvalatkrodhena nīto'sāviti vāgambumiḥ śamam ||73|| akāraṇena devāla vigraheṇa kṣamāṃ kuru | aneke hi kṣayaṃ yātāḥ svacchandaṃ saṃyugapriyāḥ ||74|| arkakīrtibhujādhārā rakṣyamāṇāḥ surairapi | aṣṭacandrāḥ kṣayaṃ prāptā megheśvaraśarotkaraiḥ ||75|| bahusainyaṃ durālokamasiratnagadādharam | atulāṃ saṃśayatulāṃ tato nāroḍhumarhasi ||76|| jagādeti tato bāliyuktaṃ nātmapraśaṃsanam | tathāpi paramārtha vo mantriṇaḥ kathayāmyaham ||77||
bhralatotkṣepamātreṇa daśavaktraṃ sasainyakam | śakto'smi kaṇaśaḥ katu vāmapāṇitalāhatam ||78|| ādi guṇoṃkā abhyudaya samasta pṛthivīmeṃ vyāpta ho rahā hai aisā bālī rājā kyā duṣṭa rākṣasake karṇamūlako prāpta nahīṃ huā hai ? arthāt usane bālīkā nāma kyā abhī taka nahīṃ sunā hai ? ||65|| yadi vaha rākṣasa aisā kahatā hai to vaha niścita hī bhūtoṃse ākrānta hai| are adhama dūta ! tū to svastha hai phira kyoṃ isa taraha tārīpha hā~ka rahā hai ? ||66|| isa prakāra kahakara vyāghravilambī kodhase macchita ho gayā| usakī ora dekhanā bhī kaṭhina ho gayā| usakā śarīra spaṣṭa rūpase kā~pane lagā| isī daśāmeṃ vaha dūtako mārane ke lie bāṇa uṭhāne lagā to bālīne kahā ||67|| ki kathita bātako kahanevāle becāre dūtake māranese kyā lābha hai ? yathārthameṃ ye loga apane svāmīke vacanoṃkī pratidhvani hī karate haiṃ ||68|| jo kucha manameṃ āyā ho vaha daśānanakā hī karanā cāhie| niścaya hī daśānanakī āyu alpa raha gayī hai isīlie to vaha kuvacana kaha rahā hai ||69||
tadanantara atyanta bhayabhīta dūtane jākara saba samācāra daśānanako sunāye aura duḥsaha tejake dhāraka usa daśānanake krodhako ddhigata kiyā ||70|| vaha baḍī śīghratāse taiyāra sātha le kiṣkindhapurakī ora calā so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki usakī racanā ahaṃkārake paramāṇuoṃse hī huī thī ||71|| tadanantara ākāśako ācchādita karanevālā śatrudalakā kala-kala śabda sunakara yuddha karane meṃ kuśala bāline mahalase bāhara nikalanekā mana kiyā ||72|| taba krodhase prajvalita bāliko sāgaravṛddhi ādi nītijña mantriyoṃne vacanarūpī jalake dvārā isa prakāra śānta kiyā ki he deva! akāraṇa yuddha rahane do, kṣamā karo, yuddhake premī anekoṃ rājā anāyāsa hī kṣayako prāpta ho cuke haiṃ||73-74|| jinheṃ arkakītikī bhajāoṃkā ālambana prāpta thā tathā deva bhī jinakī rakṣā kara rahe the aise aṣṭacandra vidyādhara jayakumārake bāṇoṃke samūhase kṣayako prāpta hue the ||75|| sātha hī jise dekhanā kaṭhina thā, tathā jo uttamottama talavāra aura gadāoṃko dhāraṇa karanevālī thī aisī bahuta bhārī senā bhī naṣṭa huī thī isalie saṃśayakī anupama tarājūpara ārūḍha़ honā ucita nahīṃ hai ||76|| mantriyoṃke vacana sunakara bālīne kahā ki yadyapi apanī praśaṃsā karanā ucita nahīṃ hai tathāpi he mantrigaṇo ! yathārtha bāta āpa logoṃko kahatā hū~ ||77|| maiṃ senāsahita daśānanako bhrakuṭirūpī latāke utkṣepamātrase bāyeṃ hastatalakī capeṭase hī cūrṇa karanemeṃ samartha hū~||78|| phira 1. bhāṣase ma., kha., ka.| 2. duḥprekṣaḥ ma. | 3. gṛhāṇa ma.| 4. bhītī ma. | 5. krodhaḥ ma. | 6. meghasvaraśarotkaraiḥ kha., jayakumārabāṇasamūhaiḥ |

kiṃ tarhi dāruṇaṃ kṛtvā krodhāgnijvalitaṃ manaḥ | karmaṇā yena labhyante bhogāḥ kṣaṇavinaśvarāḥ ||79|| prāpya tān kadalīstambhanissārān mohavāhitāḥ | patanti narake jīvā mahāduḥkhamahākule || 80 || hiṃsitvā jantusaṃghātaṃ nitāntaṃ priyajīvitam | duḥkhaṃ kṛtasukhābhikhyaṃ prāpyate tena ko guṇaḥ || 81 || 'araghaṭṭaghaṭīyantrasadṛśāḥ prāṇadhāriṇaḥ | śaśvadbhavamahākūpe bhramantyatyanta duḥkhitāḥ || 82 || pādayaṃ jinendrāṇāṃ mavanirgamakāraṇam | praṇamya kathamanyasya kriyate praṇatirmayā || 83 || prabuddhena satā ceyaṃ kṛtā saṃsthā mayā purā | anyaṃ na praṇamāmīti jinapādābjayugmataḥ ||84|| bhaṅgaṃ karomi nāsthāyā na ca prāṇinipātanam | gṛhṇāmi saṃganirmuktāṃ pravrajyāṃ muktidāyinīm || 85 || aau karau varanārīṇāṃ kṛtau stanataṭocitau | bhujau cāliṅgitau cāruratnakeyūralakṣaṇī || 86 || arāryaḥ prayuṅkte tau puruṣo'ñjalibandhane | aiśvaryaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tasya jīvitaṃ vā hatātmanaḥ || 87 || ityuktvāhūya sugrīvamuvāca śṛṇu bālaka | kuru tasya namaskāraṃ mā vo rājyapratiṣṭhitaḥ ||88|| svasāraṃ yaccha mā vāsmai na mamānena kāraṇam | eṣo'smi nirgato'dyaiva pathyaṃ yattava tatkuru || 89 || ityuktvā nirgato gehād babhūva ca nirambaraḥ | pārśva gaganacandrasya gurorguṇagarīyasaḥ || 90 || paramārthahitasvāntaḥ saṃprāptaparamodayaḥ | ekabhāvarato vīraḥ samyagdarśana nirmalaḥ || 91 || samyagjñānābhiyuktātmā samyak cāritratatparaḥ | anuprekṣābhirātmānaṃ bhāvayanmohavarjitaḥ ||92 ||
phira kaṭhina manako krodhāgnise prajvalita kiyā jāye to kahanā hī kyā hai ? phira bhī mujhe usa karmakī āvaśyakatā nahīṃ jisase ki kṣaṇabhaṃgura bhoga prāpta hote haiṃ || 79 || mohī jīva kelāke stambhake samāna niḥsāra bhogoṃko prāpta kara mahāduḥkhase bhare naraka meṃ paḍa़te haiṃ ||80|| jinheṃ apanā jīvana atyanta priya hai aise jīvoṃke samūhako mārakara sukha nāmako dhāraṇa karanevālā duḥkha hī prāpta hotā hai, ata: usase kyā lābha hai ? || 81 || ye prāṇī arahaṭa (rahaṭa ) kī ghaṭī ke samāna atyanta duḥkhī hote hue saṃsārarūpī kūpameṃ nirantara ghūmate rahate haiṃ || 82|| saṃsārase nikalane meṃ kāraṇabhūta jinendra bhagavān‌ke caraṇa yugalako namaskāra kara aba maiṃ anya puruṣake lie namaskāra kaise kara sakatā hū~ ? ||83 || jaba pahale mujhe samyagjñāna prāpta huā thā taba maiṃne pratijñā kī thī ki maiṃ jinendradeva ke caraṇakamaloṃke sivāya anya kisīko namaskāra nahīṃ karū~gā || 84|| maiṃ na to isa pratijñākā bhaṃga karanā cāhatā hū~ aura na prāṇiyoṃkī hiṃsā hī | maiṃ to mokṣa pradāna karanevālī nirgrantha dīkṣā grahaṇa karatā hū~ || 85 || jo hātha uttamottama striyoṃ ke stanataṭakā sparśa karanevāle the tathā manohara ratnamayī bājūbandoṃse suśobhita jo bhujāe~ uttamottama striyoṃkā āliṃgana karanevālī thīṃ unheṃ jo manuṣya śatruoṃ ke samakṣa aṃjali bā~dhane meṃ prayukta karatā hai usa adhamakā aiśvaryaṃ kaisā ? aura jīvana kaisā ? ||86-87|| isa prakāra kahakara usane choṭe bhāī sugrīvako bulākara kahā ki he bālaka ! tū rājyapara pratiṣṭhita hokara daśānanako namaskāra kara athavā na kara aura isake lie apanī bahana de athavā na de, mujhe isase prayojana nahīṃ| maiṃ to āja hī ghara se bāhara nikalatā hū~| jo tujhe hitakara mālūma ho vaha kara ||88-89|| itanā kahakara bālī gharase nikala gayā aura guṇoṃse śreṣṭha gaganacandra samīpa digambara ho gayā ||10|| aba to usane apanā mana paramārtha meṃ hī lagā rakhā thā | use aneka ṛddhi ādi abhyudaya prāpta hue the | vaha eka śuddha bhāvameṃ hī sadā rata rahatā thā, parīṣahoṃke sahana karanemeṃ śūravīra thā, samyagdarśanase nirmala thā arthāt śuddha samyagdṛṣṭi thā, usakī ātmā sadā samyagjñānameṃ līna rahatī thī, vaha samyak cāritrameṃ tatpara rahatā thā aura mohase rahita ho anuprekṣāoṃke dvārā ātmākā cintavana karatā rahatā thā | 91 - 92 || sūkṣma jīvoṃse rahita tathā nirmala ācārake dhārī mahāmuniyoṃse sevita dharmārādhanake yogya bhūmiyoṃmeṃ hī vaha vihāra karatā thā | 1. krodhāgni jvalitaṃ ma | 2. arahaṭṭa ba. | 3. sadṛśaṃ kha., sadṛśe ma. |

padmapurāṇe tataḥ saṃvartakābhikhyavāyunevākulīkṛte | bhuvane bhagavān bāliravadhijñātarākṣasaḥ ||145|| aprāptaḥ poḍanaṃ svasya dhīraḥ kopavivarjitaḥ | tathāvasthitasarvāṅgaścetasīdaṃ nyaveśayat ||146|| kāritaṃ bharatenedaṃ jināyatanamuttamam | sarvaratnamayaṃ tuṅgaṃ bahurūpavirājitam ||147|| pratyahaṃ bhaktisaṃyuktaiḥ kṛtapūrja surāsuraiḥ | mā vināśi calasyasmin parvate minaparvaṇi ||14|| dhyātveti caraṇāguṣṭhapīḍitaṃ girimastakam | cakāra śobhanadhyānādadūrīkṛtacetanaḥ ||149|| tato mahābharākrāntabhagnabāhuvano bhṛśam | duḥkhākulaścaladraktaspaṣṭamañjulalocanaḥ ||150|| bhagnamauliśirogāḍheniviṣṭadharaṇīdharaḥ | nimajadbhūtalanyastajānurnirbhugnajaṅakaḥ ||15|| sadyaḥ pragalitasvedadhārādhautarasātalaḥ | babhūva saṃkucadgātraḥ kūrmākāro daśānanaḥ ||152|| ravaṃ ca sarvayatnena kṛtvā rāvitavān jagat | yatastato gataḥ paścādrāvaṇākhyāṃ samastagām ||153|| śrutvā taṃ dīnabhārāvaṃ svāminaḥ pūrvamaśrutam | vidyādharavadhūloko vilalāpa samākulaḥ ||15|| mūḍhāḥ saṃnaddhamārabdhāḥ saṃbhrāntāḥ sacivā vṛthā | punaḥ punaḥ skhaladvāco gṛhītagaladāyudhāḥ ||155|| munivīryaprabhāveṇa suradundubhayo'nadan | papāta sumanovṛṣṭiḥ khamācchādya saṣaṭpadā ||156|| nanṛturgagane krīḍāśīlā devakumārakāḥ | gītadhvaniḥ surastrīṇāṃ vaṃśānugatamughayau ||157||

cakravartī bharatane ye nānā prakārake sarvaratnamayī ūṃce-ū~ce jina-mandira banavāye haiṃ| bhaktise bhare sura aura asura pratidina inakī pūjā karate haiṃ so isa parvatake vicalita ho jānepara kahīṃ 'tato mandodarī dīnā yayāceti munīśvaram | praṇamya bhartṛmikṣāṃ me prayacchādbhutavikrama ||158|| tato'nukampayāṅguṣṭhaṃ mahāmuniraśaślathat | rāvaṇo'pi vimucyādriṃ kleśakāntārato nirait ||159|| gatvā ca praṇatiṃ kṛtvā kṣamayitvā punaḥ punaḥ | yogeśaṃ stotumārabdhaḥ parijñātatapobalaḥ ||16|| jinendracaraṇau muktvā karomi na namaskṛtim | anyasyeti svayoktaṃ yatsāmarthyasyāsya tatphalam ||16|| aho niścayasaṃpannaṃ tapasaste mahadabalam | bhagavan yena śakto'si trailokyaṃ kartamanyathā ||16|| indrāṇāmapi sāmarthyamīdṛśaṃ nātha nekṣyate | yādṛk tapaḥsamṛddhānāṃ munīnāmalpayatnajam ||163|| aho guṇā ahorūpamaho kāntiraho balam | aho dīptiraho dhairyamaho śīlamaho tapaḥ ||16|| trailokyādatha niḥśeṣaṃ vastvāhṛtya manoharam | karmabhiḥ sukṛtādhāraṃ śarīraṃ tava nirmitam ||165||

uṭhane lagī ||157|| tadanantara mandodarīne dīna hokara munirājako praṇāma kara yācanā kī ki he adbhuta parākramake dhārī! mere lie patibhikṣā dījie ||158|| taba mahāmunine dayāvaśa pairakā aṃgūṭhā ḍholā kara liyā aura rāvaṇa bhī parvatako jahāṃkā tahā~ choḍa़ kleśarūpī aṭavīse bāhara nikalā ||159|| tadanantara jisane tapakā bala jāna liyā thā aise rāvaṇane jākara munirājako praṇāma kara bāra-bāra kṣamā mā~gī aura isa prakāra stuti karanā prārambha kiyā||160|| ki he pūjya ! āpane jo pratijñā kī thī ki maiṃ jinendradevake caraṇoṃko choḍa़kara anyake lie namaskāra nahīṃ karū~gā yaha usīkī sāmarthyakā phala hai ||161|| he bhagavan ! āpake tapakā mahāphala niścayase sampanna hai isīlie to āpa tīna lokako anyathā karane meṃ samartha haiṃ ||162|| tapase samṛddha muniyoṃko thoḍa़e ho prayatnase utpanna jaisī sāmarthya dekho jātī hai he nātha! vaiso sāmarthya indroṃkī bhī nahīṃ dekhī jātī hai ||163|| āpake guṇa, āpakā rūpa, āpakī kānti, āpakā bala, āpakī dīpti, āpakā dhairya, āpakā śola aura āpakā tapa sabhī āścaryakārī haiṃ ||164|| aisā jāna paḍa़tā hai māno karmoṃne tīnoṃ lokoṃse samasta sundara padārtha lā-lākara puṇyake ādhārabhūta āpake śarīrakī racanā kī hai ||165|| he satpuruṣa ! isa lokottara sāmarthyase yukta hokara bhī jo āpane pṛthivīkā tyāga kiyā hai yaha atyanta āścaryajanaka kārya hai ||166|| aisī sāmarthyase yukta āpake viṣayameṃ jo maiṃne anucita kārya karanā cāhā thā vaha mujha asamarthake lie kevala pāpa-bandhakā hī kāraṇa huā ||167|| mujha pāpīke isa śarīrako, hṛdayako aura vacanako dhikkāra hai ki jo ayogya kārya karaneke sammukha hue ||168|| he dveṣarahita ! āpa-jaise nara-ratnoṃ aura mujha-jaise duṣṭa puruṣoṃke bīca utanā ho antara hai jitanā ki meru aura sarasoṃke bīca hotā hai ||169|| he munirāja! mujha marate hueke lie āpane prāṇa pradāna kiye haiṃ so apakāra karanevālepara jisakī aisī buddhi hai usake viṣayameṃ kyā kahā jāve ? padmapurāṇe iti stutvā muni bhūyaḥ praṇamya triḥpradakṣiṇam | nitāntaṃ svaṃ ca ninditvā śūtkāramukharānanaḥ ||173| upakaṇṭhaṃ muneścaityabhavanaṃ trapayānvitaḥ | virako viṣayāsaṅge praviṣṭaḥ kaikasīsutaḥ ||174|| anādareṇa vikṣipya candrahāsamasiṃ bhuvi | āvṛto nijanārī miścakre jinavarārcanam ||175|| niṣkṛṣya ca snasātantroṃ bhuje vīṇāmavīvadat | bhaktinirbharabhāvaśca jagau stutiśatairjinam ||176|| namaste devadevāya lokālokāvalokine | tejasātītalokāya kṛtārthāya mahātmane ||177|| trilokakṛtapūjāya naṣṭamohamahāraye | vāṇīgocaratāmuktaguṇasaṃghātadhāriṇe ||178|| mahaiśvaryasametāya 'vimuktipathadeśine | sukhakāṣṭhāsamṛddhāya dūrībhūtakuvastave ||179|| niḥśreyasasya bhūtānāṃ hetave'bhyudayasya ca | mahākalyāṇamūlāya vedhase sarvakarmaṇām ||18|| dhyānanirdagdhapāpāya janmavidhvaṃsakāriṇe | gurave gurumuktāya praṇatāyānatātmane ||181|| ādyantaparimuktāya saṃtatādyantayogine | ajñātaparamārthāya paramārthāvabodhine ||182|| sarvaśūnyapratijñāya sarvāstikyopadeśine | sarvakṣaṇikapakṣāya kṛtsnanityatva śine ||183|| pṛthaktvaikatvavādāya sarvānekāntadeśine | jineśvarāya sarvasmā ekasmai śivadāyine ||184||
avasthāmeṃ hī viṣayoṃko choḍa़kara mokṣa-mārgameṃ sthita hue haiṃ ve puṇyātmā haiṃ, mahāśaktiśālī hai aura maktilakṣmīke samīpameṃ vicaranevāle haiṃ ||172| isa prakāra stuti kara usane manirājako praṇāma kara tīna pradakṣiṇāeṃ dīṃ, apane āpakī bahuta nindā kī aura duḥkhavaśa mu~hase sū-sū śabda kara rudana kiyā ||173|| munirājake samīpa jo jina-mandira thā lajjāse yukta aura viṣayoṃse virakta rāvaṇa usīke andara calā gayā ||174|| vahāṃ usane candrahāsa nāmaka khaḍgako anādarase pṛthivīpara pheṃka diyā aura apanī striyoṃse yukta hokara jinendradevakī pūjā kī ||175|| usake bhāva bhaktimeṃ itane līna ho gaye the ki usane apanī bhujākī nāḍa़īrūpī tantrīko khīṃcakara vīṇā bajāyī aura saikaḍa़oṃ stutiyoṃke dvārā jinarājakā guṇagāna kiyā ||176|| vaha gā rahā thā ki nātha ! āpa devoṃke deva ho, loka aura alokako dekhanevāle ho, āpane apane tejase samasta lokako atikrānta kara diyā hai, āpa kṛtakṛtya haiṃ, mahātmā haiṃ| tīnoṃ loka āpakī pūjā karate haiṃ, āpane moha rūpī mahā śatruko naṣṭa kara diyā hai, āpa vacanāgocara guṇoṃke samūhako dhāraṇa karanevāle haiṃ| āpa mahān aiśvaryase sahita haiṃ, mokṣamārgakā upadeśa denevāle haiṃ, sūkhakī parama sīmāse samaddha haiṃ, āpane samasta katsita vastuoṃko dūra kara diyā hai| āpa prāṇiyoṃke lie mokṣa tathā svargake hetu haiṃ, mahākalyāṇoṃke mūla kāraṇa haiṃ, samasta kāryoṃke vidhātā haiṃ| āpane dhyānāgnike dvārā samasta pāpoṃko jalā diyā hai, āpa janmakā vidhvaṃsa karanevāle haiṃ, guru haiṃ, āpakā koī guru nahīṃ hai, saba āpako praṇāma karate haiṃ aura āpa svayaṃ kisīko praṇāma nahīṃ karate| āpa ādi tathā antase rahita haiṃ, āpa nirantara ādi tathā antima yogī haiṃ, āpake paramārthako koī nahīṃ jānatā para āpa samasta paramārthako jānate haiṃ| ātmā rāgādika vikāroṃse śūnya hai aisā upadeśa āpane sabake lie diyā hai, 'ātmā hai', 'paraloka hai' ityādi āstikyavādakā upadeśa bhī āpane sabake lie diyā hai, paryāyārthika nayase saṃsārake samasta padārtha kṣaṇika haiṃ isa pakṣakā nirūpaṇa āpane jahā~ kiyā hai vahā~ dravyārthika nayase samasta padārthoṃko nitya bhī āpane dikhalāyā hai| hamārī ātmā samasta parapadārthose pṛthak akhaṇḍa eka dravya hai aisā kathana āpane kiyā hai, āpa sabake lie anekānta dharmakā pratipādana karanevāle haiṃ, kamarūpa śatruoṃko jītanevāloṃmeṃ śreṣṭha haiṃ, sarva padārthoṃ ko jānanevāle honese sarvarūpa haiṃ, avaṇḍa caitanya puṃjake dhāraka honese ekarūpa haiṃ aura mokṣa pradāna karanevāle haiṃ ataḥ āpako 1. vimuktapatha -ma.| 2. dūrobhūta-durīhita ba.| 3. na jñātaḥ paramārtho yasya sa tasmai | 4. deśine ma. | 5. -mādāya ka., ba, | 6. -daśine ka.|

ṛṣabhāya namo nityamajitāya namo namaḥ | saṃbhavāya namo'jasramaminandanarūḍhaye ||185|| namaḥ sumataye padmapramāya satataṃ namaḥ | supāśrvāya namaḥ śaśvannamaścandrasamatviṣe ||186|| namo'stu puṣpadantāya śītalāya namo namaḥ | śreyase vāsupūjyāya namo labdhātmatejase ||187|| vimalāya namastredhā namo'nantāya saṃtatam | namo dharmāya saukhyānāṃ namo malāya śāntaye ||18|| namaḥ kunthujinendrāya namo'rasvāmine sadā | namo mallimaheśāya namaḥ suvratadāyine ||189|| anyebhyaśca bhaviṣyadbhayo bhūtebhyaśca sumāvataḥ | namo'stu jinanāthebhyaḥ śramaṇebhyaśca sarvadā ||19|| namaḥ samyaktvayuktāya jñānāyakāntanāśine | darśanāya namo'jatraṃ siddhebhyo'nārataṃ namaḥ ||191|| pavitrāṇyakṣarāṇyevaṃ laṅkāsvāmini gāyati | calitaṃ nāgarājasya viṣṭaraṃ dharaṇaśruteḥ ||192|| tato'vadhikṛtālokastoṣavistāritekṣaṇaḥ | sphuratphaṇāmaṇicchāyādūradhvastatamaścayaḥ ||193|| sakalāmalatāreśaprasannamukhaśobhitaḥ | pātālādudyayau kṣi nāgarājaḥ sumānasaḥ ||194|| vidhāya ca namaskāraṃ jinendrāṇāṃ vidhānataḥ | pūjāṃ ca dhyānasaṃjātasamastadravyasaṃpadam ||195|| jagāda rāvaṇaṃ sādho sādhugītamidaṃ tvayā| jinendrastutisaṃbaddhaṃ romaharṣaṇakāraṇam ||196|| paśya topeṇa me jātaṃ pulakaṃ ghanakarkaśam | pātālasthasya yacchāntirnādyāpi pratipadyate ||197|| rākṣaseśvara dhanyo'si yaḥ stauṣi jinapuṅgavān | balādākṛṣya bhāvena tvadīyenāhamāhṛtaḥ ||198|| varaṃ vṛṇīṣva tuṣṭo'smi tava bhaktyā jinānprati | dadāmyabhīpsitaṃ vastu sadyaḥ kunaradurlabham ||199||
tataḥ kailāsakampana prokto'sau vidito mama | dharaṇo nāgarājastvaṃ pṛṣṭastāvanivedaya ||20|| namaskāra ho ||177-184|| ṛṣabha, ajita, sambhava, abhinandana, sumati, padmaprabha, supārśva, candraprabha, puṣpadanta, śītala, śreyonātha, vāsupūjya, vimala, ananta, dharma, saukhyoṃke mūla kāraṇa śāntinātha, kunthu jinendra, aranātha, malli mahārāja aura munisuvrata bhagavān ina vartamāna tīrthaṃkaroṃko mana-vacana-kāyase namaskāra ho | inake sivāya jo anya bhūta aura bhaviṣyat kāla sambandhī tīrthakara haiṃ unheṃ namaskāra ho | sādhuoṃke lie sadā namaskāra ho| samyaktvasahita jñāna aura ekāntavādako naṣṭa karanevāle darśanake lie nirantara namaskāra ho, tathā siddha parameśvarake lie sadā namaskāra ho ||185-191|| laṃkākā svāmī rāvaṇa jaba isa prakārake pavitra akṣara gā rahā thā taba nāgarāja dharaṇendrakā āsana kampāyamāna huā ||192|| tadanantara uttama hṛdayako dhāraṇa karanevālā nāgarāja śīghra hī pātālase nikalakara bāhara āyā| usa samaya avadhijñānarūpī prakāśase usakī ātmā prakāśamāna thī, santoṣase usake netra vikasita ho rahe the, ūpara uṭhe huai phaṇoṃmeṃ jo maṇi lage hue the unakī kāntise vaha andhakārake samūha dūra haṭā rahā thā aura pūrṇa tathā nirmala candramāke samāna prasanna mukhase śobhita thā ||193-194|| usane ākara jinendra bhagavānko namaskāra kiyā aura tadanantara dhyāna mātrase hī jisameṃ samasta dravyarūpī sampadā prāpta ho gayī thī aisī vidhipūrvaka pūjā kī ||195|| pūjāke bāda usane rāvaṇase kahā ki he satpuruṣa ! tumane jinendradevakī stutise sambandha rakhanevālā yaha bahuta acchā gīta gāyā hai| tumhārā yaha gīta romāṃca utpanna honekā kāraṇa hai ||196|| dekho, santoṣake kāraṇa mere śarīrameṃ saghana evaṃ kaṭhora romāṃca nikala āye haiṃ| maiṃ pātālameṃ rahatā thā phira bhī tujhe aba bhī śānti prāpta nahīṃ ho rahī hai ||197|| he rākṣaseśvara ! tū dhanya hai jo jinendra bhagavānkī isa prakāra stuti karatā hai| terī bhāvanāne mujhe balapūrvaka khīṃcakara yahā~ bulāyā hai ||198|| jinendradevake prati jo terī bhakti hai usase maiṃ bahuta santuṣṭa huā hū~| tū vara mā~ga, maiṃ tujhe śīghra hī kupuruṣoṃko durlabha icchita vastu detā hū~ ||199|| tadanantara

kṛtvāñjaliṃ namasyāṃ ca saṃbhāṣitadaśānanaḥ | jagāma dharaṇaḥ sthānaṃ nijaṃ prakaṭasaṃmadaḥ ||215|| kailāsako kampita karanevāle rāvaṇane kahā ki mujhe mālūma hai-āpa nāgarāja dharaṇendra haiṃ| so maiṃ āpase hī pūchatā hū~ bhalā āpa hī batalāie ||200|| ki jina-vandanāke samāna aura kauna-sī śubha vastu hai jise dene ke lie udyata hue āpase maiṃ mā~gū ||201|| taba nāgarājane kahā ki he rāvaṇa! suna, jinendra-vandanāke samāna aura dūsarī vastu kalyāṇakārī nahīṃ hai ||202|| jo jina-bhakti acchī taraha upāsanā karanepara nirvāṇa sukha pradāna karatī hai usake tulya dūsarī vastu na to huī hai aura na hogī ||203|| yaha sana rāvaṇane kahā ki jaba jinendra-vandanāse baḍhakara aura kucha nahīṃ hai aura vaha mujhe prāpta hai taba he mahābuddhimān ! tumhīṃ kaho isase adhika aura kisa vastukī yācanā tumase karūṃ ||204|| nāgarājane phira kahā ki tumhārā yaha kahanā saca hai| vāstavameṃ jo vastu jina-bhaktise asādhya ho vaha hai hī nahīṃ ||205|| tumhāre samāna, hamāre samāna aura indra ādike samāna jo bhī sukhake ādhāra haiṃ ve saba jina-bhaktise hī hue haiṃ ||206|| yaha saṃsārakā sukha to atyanta alpa tathā bādhāse sahita hai ataḥ ise rahane do, jina-bhaktise to mokṣakā bhī uttama sukha prāpta ho jātā hai ||207|| yadyapi tū tyāgī hai, mahāvinayase yukta hai, vīryavān hai, uttama aiśvaryase sahita hai aura guṇoṃse vibhūṣita hai tathāpi tere lie merā jo amogha darśana huā hai vaha vyartha na ho isalie maiṃ tujhase kucha grahaṇa karanekī yācanā karatā hū~ ||208209|| he laṃkeśa ! jisase manacāhe rūpa banāye jā sakate haiṃ aisī amoghavijayā śakti nāmakī vidyā maiṃ tujhe detā hū~ so grahaṇa kara, merā sneha khaṇḍita mata kara ||210|| he bhalemānuṣa ! eka hī daśāmeṃ kisakā kāla bītatā hai ? vipattike bāda sampatti aura sampattike bāda vipatti sabhīko prāpta hotī hai ||211|| isalie yadi kadācit kisī kāraṇavaśa vipatti tere samīpa āyegī to yaha vidyā śatruko bādhā pahu~cātī huī terī rakṣaka hogī ||212|| manuṣya to dūra raheṃ agnikī jvālāoṃse vyāpta isa śaktise vipula śaktike dhāraka deva bhī bhayabhīta rahate haiṃ ||213|| ākhira, rāvaṇa nāgarājake isa snehako bhaṃga nahīṃ kara sakā aura usane baḍa़ī kaṭhināīse grahaṇa karanevāleko laghutā prāpta kī ||214|| tadanantara hātha joḍa़kara aura pūjā kara rāvaṇase 1. jinendrājñā ba. | 2. sajjanaḥ ma. | 3. bhājanam ma. |

223 māsamātra daśāsyo'pi sthitvā kailāsamūrdhani | preṇipatya jinaṃ deśaṃ prayayāvabhivāñchitam ||216|| vijñāya manasaḥ kṣobhādātmānaṃ baddhaduṣkṛtam | prāyaścittaṃ gurordeśaṃ gatvā bāliraśiśriyat ||217|| nirgatasvāntaśalyaśce babhūva sukhitaḥ punaḥ | bāliniyamanaṃ kṛtvā yathā viṣṇumahāmuniḥ ||218|| cāritrād guptito dharmādanuprekṣaṇataḥ sadā | samitibhyaḥ parābhūteḥ parīṣahagaṇasya ca ||219|| mahāsaṃvaramāsādya karmāpūrvamanarjayan | nāśayaṃstapasā cāttaṃ prāptaḥ kevalasaṃgatam ||220|| karmāṣṭakavinirmukto yayau trailokyamastakam | sukhaṃ nirupama yasminnavasāna vivarjitam ||221|| indriyāṇāṃ jaye śakto yastenāsmi parājitaḥ | iti vijñāya laṅkaśaḥ sādhūnāṃ praṇato'bhavat ||222|| samyagdarśanasaṃpanno dṛḍhabhaktirjineśvare | atṛptaḥ paramaingairatiṣṭhat sa yathepsitam ||223||
rathoddhatāvṛttam bāliceṣṭitamidaṃ śṛṇoti yo bhāvatatparamatiḥ śubho janaḥ |
naiṣa yāti parataḥ parāmavaṃ prāpnute ca ravimāsuraṃ padam ||224|| ityārṣe raviṣeṇācāryaprokta padmacarite bālinirvāṇābhidhānaṃ nāma navamaṃ parva ||9||
vārtālāpa karatā huā nāgarāja baḍa़e harṣase apane sthānapara calā gayā ||215|| rāvaṇa bhī eka māha taka kailāsa parvatapara rahakara tathā jinendradevako namaskāra kara icchita sthalako calā gayā ||216|| munirāja bālīne manameṃ kṣobha utpanna honese apane āpako pāpa karmakā bandha karanevālā samajha garuke pāsa jākara prāyaścitta grahaṇa kiyā ||217|| jisa prakāra viṣṇakumāra mahāmuni prāyaścitta kara sukhī hae the usī prakāra bālī manirāja bhī prāyaścitta dvārā hṛdayakī śalya nikala jānese sukhī hue ||218|| cāritra, gupti, dharma, anuprekṣā, samiti aura parīṣaha sahana karanese bālī munirāja mahāsaṃvarako prāpta hue | navīna karmokā ajaṃna unhoṃne banda kara diyā aura pahaleke saṃcita karmokā tapake dvārā nāśa karanā śurū kiyā| isa taraha saṃvara aura nirjarāke dvārā ve kevalajñānako prāpta hue ||219-220|| anta meṃ āṭha karmoko naṣṭa kara ve tīna lokake usa śikharapara jā pahuṃce jahāṃ ananta sukha prāpta hotā hai ||221|| jo indriyoṃko jītane meṃ samartha hai maiṃ usase hārā hū~ yaha jānakara aba rāvaṇa sādhuoṃke samakṣa namra rahane lagā ||222|| jo samyagdarśanase sampanna thā, aura jinendra devameṃ jisakī dṛḍha़ bhakti thī aisā rāvaṇa parama bhogoṃse tṛpta na hotā huā icchānusāra rahane lagā ||223|| gautama svāmī rājā śreṇikase kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! jo uttama manuṣya śubhabhāvoṃmeṃ tatpara hotā huā bālī munike isa caritrako sunatā hai vaha kabhī parase parābhavako prāpta nahīṃ hotā aura sūryake samāna dedīpyamāna padako prāpta hotā hai ||224||
isa prakāra ārṣanāmase prasiddha raviṣeṇācārya viracita padmacaritameṃ bāli

daśamaṃ parva
evaṃ tāvadidaṃ vṛtaṃ tava śreṇika veditam | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu te paramīhitam || 1|| hutāśanaśikhasyāsīt sutā 'jyotiḥpure varā | hīsaṃjñāyāṃ samutpannā yoṣiti strīguṇānvitā ||2|| sutāreti gatā khyātiṃ śobhayā sakalāvanau | padmavāsaṃ parityajya lakṣmīriva samāgatā ||3|| cakrāṅkatanayo'paśyat paryaṭan svecchayānyadā | tāṃ sāhasagatirnāmnā duṣṭo'numatisaṃbhavaḥ ||4|| tato'sau kāmaśalyena śalyito'tyantaduḥkhitaḥ | sutārāṃ manasā nityamuvāhonmattavibhramaḥ ||5|| uparyupari yātaiśca tāṃ sa dūtairayācata | sugrīvo'pi tathaivaitāṃ yācate sma manoharām ||6|| dvaidhībhāvamupetena hutāśanaśikhena ca | pṛṣṭo munirmahājñānī niścayavyākulātmanā ||7|| uktaṃ ca municandreṇa na sāhasagatiśviram | jīviṣyati cirāyustu sugrīvaḥ paramodayaḥ || 8 || cakrāpakṣasaṃprītyā hutāśastu viniśvayaḥ | dīpau vṛṣau gajendrau ca nimittamakarod dṛḍham ||9|| tato munigiraṃ jñātvā niyatāmamṛtopamām | sugrīvāya sutā dattānīya pitrā samaṅgalam ||10|| kṛtvā pāṇigṛhītāṃ tāṃ sugrīvaḥ puṇyasaṃcayaḥ | iyāya kāmaviṣayaṃ sāravattaṃ susaṃpadam || 11|| tataḥ kramāttayoḥ putrau jātau rūpamahotsavau | jyāyānaṅgo'nujastasya prathito'ṅgadasaṃjñayā ||12||
1
athānantara—— gautamasvāmī rājā śreṇikase kahate haiṃ ki he śreṇika ! isa taraha tumane bālīkā vṛttānta jānā | aba isake āge tere lie sugrīva aura sutārākā śreṣṭha carita kahatā hū~ so suna ||1|| jyotiḥpura nāmā nagara meṃ rājā agniśikhakī rānī hrī devīke udarase utpanna eka sutārā nāmakī kanyā thī | śobhāse samasta pṛthivīmeṃ prasiddha thī aura aisī jāna paḍa़tī thī māno kamalarūpī āvāsako choḍa़kara lakṣmī hī ā gayī ho ||2- 3 || eka dina rājā cakrāṃka aura anumati rānīse utpanna sāhasagati nāmaka duṣṭa vidyādhara apanī icchāse idhara-udhara bhramaṇa kara rahā thā so usane sutārā dekhī ||4|| use dekhakara vaha kāmarūpī śalyase viddha hokara atyanta du:khī huā | vaha sutārāko nirantara apane manameṃ dhāraṇa karatā thā aura unmatta jaisī usakī ceṣṭā thī ||5|| idhara vaha ekake bāda eka dūta bhejakara usakī yācanā karatā thā udhara sugrīva bhī usa manohara kanyāko yācanā karatā thā || 6 || 'apanī kanyā do meṃ se kise dū~' isa prakāra dvaidhībhāvako prāpta huā rājā agniśikha niścaya nahīṃ kara sakā isalie usakī ātmā nirantara vyākula rahatī thī | ākhira mahājñānī munirāja se pūchā ||7|| taba mahājñānī municandrane kahā ki sāhasagati cirakāla taka jīvita nahīṃ rahegā - alpāyu hai aura sugrīva isake viparīta parama abhyudayakā dhāraka tathā cirāyu hai ||8|| rājā agniśikha, sāhasagatike pitā cakrāṃkakā pakṣa prabala honese municandra ke vacanoṃkā niścaya nahīṃ kara sakā taba municandrane do dīpaka, do vṛṣa aura gajarājoṃko nimitta banākara use apanī bātakā dṛḍha़ niścaya karā diyā ||9|| tadanantara munirājake amṛta tulya vacanoṃkā niścaya kara pitā agniśikhane apanī putrī sutārā lākara maṃgalācārapūrvaka sugrīvake lie de dī ||10|| jisakā puṇyakā saṃcaya prabala thā aisā sugrīva usa kanyāko vivāha kara baḍa़ī sampadāke sātha śreṣṭha kāmopabhogako prāpta huā ||11|| tadanantara sugrīva aura sutārāke kramase do putra utpanna hue| donoṃ hī atyanta sundara the | unameṃ se baḍa़e putrakā nāma aṃga thā aura choṭā putra aṃgadake nāmase prasiddha thā || 12|| 1. parva ma. | 2. dyotiḥpure ma, ba | 3. duṣṭānumati ma. | 4. yuktaṃ ca ma | 5. nītvā ma | 6. susaṃmadam ma., ka., kha. |

rāvaṇa ! yadi bhogoṃ meṃ kucha sāra hotā to uttama buddhike dhāraka pitājīne hī unakā tyāga nahīṃ kiyā hotā || 167|| aisā kahakara usane dṛḍha़ niścayake sātha putrake lie rājya sauṃpā aura daśānana
kṣamā yācanā kara pitā śatabāhuke samīpa dīkṣā dhāraṇa kara lī ||| 168 || sahasraraśmine apane mitra ayodhyā ke rājā anaraṇyase pahale kaha rakhā thā ki jaba maiṃ digambara dīkṣā dhāraṇa karū~gā taba tumhāre lie khabara dū~gā aura anaraṇyane bhī sahasraraśmise aisā hī kaha rakhā thā so isa kathana ke anusāra sahasraraśmine khabara deneke lie anaraṇyake pāsa ādamī bheje || 169 - 170 || gaye hue puruṣoṃne jaba anaraṇya se sahasraraśmike vairāgyako vārtā kahī to use sunakara usake netra ā~suoṃse bhara gaye | usa mahāpuruṣake guṇoṃkā smaraṇakara vaha cirakāla taka vilāpa karatā rahā || 171 | | jaba viṣāda kama huā to mahābuddhimān anaraṇyane kahā ki usake pāsa rāvaṇa kyā āyā māno śatruke veṣameṃ bhāī hī usake pāsa āyā || 172 || vaha rāvaṇa ki jisane atyanta anukūla hokara viṣayoṃse mohita ho cirakāla taka aiśvaryarūpī pijaḍa़eke andara sthita rahanevāle isa manuṣyarūpī pakṣīko mukta kiyā hai ||173|| māhiṣmatī ke rājā sahasraraśmiko dhanya hai jo rāvaṇa ke samyagjñānarūpī jahājakā āśraya le saṃsārarūpī sāgarako tairanā cāhatā hai || 174 || jo antameṃ atyanta duḥkha denevāle rājya nāmaka pāpako choḍa़kara jinendrapraṇīta vratako prāpta huā hai aba usakī kṛtakṛtyatākā kyā pūchanā || 175 ||

237 abhinanyeti saṃvignaḥ kṣiptvā lakṣmī śarīraje | sutena jyāyasā sākamanaraṇyo'bhavanmuniḥ ||176||
rathoddhatāvṛttam yena kenacidudāttakarmaṇā kāraṇena ripuṇetareṇa vā| nirmitena samavāpyate matiḥ śreyasī na tu nikṛṣṭakarmaṇā ||177|| yaḥ prayojayati mānasaṃ śubhe yasya tasya paramaḥ sa bāndhavaḥ | bhogavastuni tu yasya mānasaṃ yaḥ karoti paramārirasya saḥ ||178|| māvayanniti sahasradīdhitiṃ yo'naraṇyanṛpati śṛṇoti ca | saṃyutaṃ śramaṇaśīlasaṃpadā sa bajatyamalatāṃ yathā raviḥ ||179||

nāma daśamaṃ parva ||10||
isa prakāra sahasraraśmikī praśaṃsākara anaraṇya bhī saṃsārase bhayabhīta ho putrake lie rājyalakṣmī sauṃpa baḍa़e putrake sātha muni ho gayā ||176||
gautama svāmī rājā śreṇikase kahate haiṃ ki he rājan ! jaba utkṛṣṭa karmakā nimitta milatā hai taba śatru athavā mitra kisīke bhī dvārā isa jīvako kalyāṇakārī buddhi prāpta ho jātī hai para jabataka nikṛṣṭa karmakā udaya rahatā hai tabataka prāpta nahīṃ hotī ||177|| jo jisake manako acche kāryameṃ lagā detā hai yathārtha meṃ vahī usakā bāndhava hai aura jo jisake manako bhogopabhogako vastuoṃmeṃ lagātā hai vahī usakā vāstavika śatru hai ||178|| isa prakāra sahasraraśmikā dhyāna karatā huā jo manuṣya muniyoṃke samāna śīlarūpī sampadāse yukta rājā anaraṇyakā caritra sunatā hai vaha sūryake samāna nirmalatāko prāpta hotā hai ||179||
isa prakāra ārṣanāmase prasiddha raviṣaṇācārya ke dvārā kathita padmacaritameṃ daśānanake prayāṇa ke samaya
rājā sahasraraśmi aura anaraṇyakī dīkṣākā varṇana karanevālā daśama parva pūrṇa huā ||10||

ekādaśa parva
atha kailāsasaṃkṣomo yān yān mānavato nṛpān | śṛṇoti dharaṇīyātāṃstāṃstānsarvānanīnamat || 1|| vaśīkṛtaiśca saṃmānaṃ prāpitairveṣṭito nṛpaiḥ | paśyan sphītapurāmurvī subhūmaścakrabhṛdyethā || 2 || nānādeśasamutpannairnānākārairnarairvṛtaḥ | nānābhūṣādharairnānāmāṣairvividhavāhanaiḥ ||3|| kārayan 'jīrṇacaityānāṃ saṃskārān paramāṃ tathā | pūjāṃ devādhidevānāṃ jinendrāṇāṃ subhāvitaḥ ||4|| dhvaṃsayan jinavidveṣakāriṇaḥ khalamānavān | 'durvidhān karuṇāyukto dhanena paripūrayan ||5|| samyagdarśanasaṃśuddhān vatsalaḥ pūjayañjanān | praṇaman śramaṇān bhaktyā rūpamātraśritānapi || 6 || udīcīṃ prasthitaḥ kāṣṭhāṃ pratāpaṃ dussahaṃ kiran | yathottarāyaṇe mānuḥ puṇyakarmānubhāvataḥ ||7|| balavāṃśca śrutastena rājā rājapurādhipaḥ | abhimānaṃ paraṃ bibhratparapraṇativarjitaḥ ||8|| "janmaprabhṛti duścetā laukikonmārgamohitaḥ | praviṣṭaḥ prāṇividhvaṃsaṃ yajñadīkṣākhyapātakam ||9|| atha yajñadhvaniṃ śrutvā śreṇiko gaṇapālinam | ityapṛcchad vibho tāvadāstāṃ rāvaṇakīrtanam ||10|| utpatti bhagavannasya yajñasyecchāmi veditum | pravṛtto dāruṇo yasmin jaino jantuvināśane ||11|| uvāca ca gaṇādhīśaḥ śṛṇu śreṇika śobhanam | bhavatā pṛṣṭametena bahavo mohitā janāḥ ||12||
athānantara rāvaṇane pṛthvīpara jina-jina rājāoṃko mānī sunā una sabako namrībhūta kiyā ||1|| jina rājāoṃko isane vaśa kiyā thā unakā sammāna bhī kiyā aura aise una samasta rājāoṃse veṣṭita hokara usane baḍa़e-baḍa़e grāmoṃse sahita pṛthvīko dekhate hue subhūmacakravartīke samāna bhramaṇa kiyā ||2|| isake sātha nānā deśoṃmeṃ utpanna hue nānā ākāra ke manuṣya the | ve manuṣya nānā prakāra ke ābhūṣaṇa pahane hue the, nānā prakārakī unakī ceṣṭāe~ thīṃ aura nānā prakārake vāhanoṃpara ve ārūḍha़ the || 3 || vaha jīṇaṃ mandiroṃkā jīrṇoddhāra karātā jātā thā aura devādhideva jinendradevakī baḍa़e bhāvase pūjā karatā thā ||4|| jainadharmake sātha dveṣa rakhanevāle duṣṭa manuṣyoṃko naṣṭa karatā thā aura daridra manuṣyoṃko dayāse yukta ho dhanase paripūrṇa karatā thā ||5|| samyagdarśanase śuddha janoṃkī baḍa़e snehase pūjā karatā thā aura jo mātra jainamudrāko dhāraṇa karanevāle the aise muniyoṃ ko bhī bhaktipūrvaka praṇāma karatā thā || 6 || jisa prakāra uttarāyaṇake samaya sūrya duḥsaha pratāpa bikheratā huā uttara diśākī ora prasthāna karatā hai usī prakāra rāvaṇane bhī puṇya karmake udayase duḥsaha pratāpa bikherate hue uttara diśākī ora prasthāna kiyā ||7||
athānantara rāvaṇane sunā ki rājapurakā rājā bahuta balavān hai | vaha bahuta bhārī ahaṃkārako dhāraṇa karatā huā kabhī kisīko praṇāma nahīṃ karatā hai ||8|| janmase hī lekara duṣṭa- citta hai, laukika mithyā mārgase mohita hai, aura prāṇiyoṃkā vidhvaṃsa karānevāle yajña dīkṣā nāmaka mahāpāpako prāpta hai arthāt yajñakriyāmeṃ pravṛtta hai ||9|| tadanantara yajñakā kathana suna rājā śreṇikane gautama gaṇadhara se pūchā ki he vibho ! abhī rāvaṇakī kathā rahane dījie| pahale maiṃ isa yajñakī utpatti jānanā cāhatā hū~ ki jīvoṃkā vighāta karanevāle jisa yajñameṃ duṣṭajana pravṛtta hue haiṃ ||10-11|| taba gaṇadhara bole ki he śreṇika ! suna, tūne bahuta acchā praśna kiyā hai | isa yajñake dvārā bahuta se jana mohita ho rahe haiṃ || 12 ||
1. cakravadyathā ma. | 2. śīrṇa ka., kha., ma. | 3. sabhāvitaḥ ka, kha | subhāvitām ma | 4. daridrān | 5. janmanaḥ prabhṛti ma | 6. duśceto -ka., kha. | 7. janā ma. |
